endpoints.summary: Authorization code grant: Retrieve access token
endpoints.description:
Get an access token issued by calling our token endpoint and passing the authorization code from the previous call. The issued access token will have an expiry, and it will be valid only for the scope for which the consent has been provided by the customer. You can call the APIs by passing this token in Authorization header. You also get a refresh token that can be used to get a new access token in case the original one expires.
AccessTokens are valid for 10 minutes

specs.title: Broker API
specs.description:
Open brokerage accounts, enable stock, options and crypto trading. Manage the ongoing user experience and brokerage customer lifecycle with the Alpaca Broker API

Contact Support:
 Name: Alpaca Support
 Email: support@alpaca.markets

endpoints.description:
Retrieves the first 1000 accounts that match the query parameters.
Sorting is based on creation time.
The created_after/created_before query parameters can be used to paginate the results.
To further limit the size of the response, the entities query parameter can be used to specify which properties are included in the response.

Submit an account application with KYC information. This will create a trading account for the end user. The account status may or may not be ACTIVE immediately and you will receive account status updates on the event API.

**Multi-Live Accounts (MLA)**: To open an additional account for an existing account holder, supply `primary_account_holder_id` at the top level instead of `contact`/`identity` data. In that case, supplying `contact` or `identity` returns HTTP 400. Only `account_type` of `trading` and `ira` are supported via this flow.
You can query a specific account that you submitted to Alpaca by passing into the query the account_id associated with the account you're retrieving.

This operation updates account information.

If all parameters are valid and updates have been made, it returns with status code 200. The response is the account model.

**Multi-Live Accounts (MLA)**: The `primary_account_holder_id` field is read-only after the account is created. Omitting it or supplying the value already associated with the account is a no-op; supplying a different value returns HTTP 400.

This operation closes an active account. The underlying records and information of the account are not deleted by this operation.

**Before closing an account, you are responsible for closing all the positions and withdrawing all the money associated with that account. Learn more in the Positions Documentation.**

endpoints.operationId: Request options trading for an account (BETA)
endpoints.summary: Request options trading for an account (BETA)
endpoints.description:
This endpoint requests options trading for an account.
Following submission, an assigned administrator will review the request.
Upon approval, the account's options_approved_level parameter will be modified, granting the account the ability to participate in options trading.
Note: This endpoint is only available for partners who have been enabled for Options BETA.

endpoints.operationId: Retrieve Bank Relationships for an Account
endpoints.summary: Retrieve Bank Relationships for an Account
endpoints.description: Retrieves Bank Relationships for an account

endpoints.operationId: Create a Bank Relationship for an Account
endpoints.summary: Create a Bank Relationship for an Account
endpoints.description: If successful, retrieves Bank Relationships for an account

Create a new transfer to deposit money into or withdraw money from an account.

Two `transfer_type` values are accepted, and both are available in sandbox and production:

- **`ach`** — supports both `INCOMING` (deposit) and `OUTGOING` (withdrawal) directions. A `relationship_id` from a previously created [ACH Relationship](https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/createachrelationshipforaccount) is required.
- **`wire`** — supports the `OUTGOING` (withdrawal) direction only. Incoming wires cannot be initiated through this endpoint; they are pushed in by the sending bank and recorded automatically. A `bank_id` from a previously created [Bank Relationship](https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/createrecipientbank) is required, and the bank must be in `APPROVED` status before the transfer will progress past `QUEUED`.

In the sandbox environment, ACH deposits and withdrawals settle instantly against virtual funds. Outgoing wire withdrawals are accepted and simulated end-to-end — no funds are transmitted to a bank, but the transfer progresses to `COMPLETE` and the account is debited against virtual funds. Sandbox wire withdrawals are asynchronous (not instant) and auto-complete on weekdays only; transfers submitted on a weekend will not progress until Monday. For more on funding accounts in sandbox, see [this tutorial](https://alpaca.markets/learn/fund-broker-api/).

Returns a list of activities

Notes:
* Pagination is handled using the `page_token` and `page_size` parameters.
* `page_token` represents the ID of the last item on your current page of results.
   For example, if the ID of the last activity in your first response is `20220203000000000::045b3b8d-c566-4bef-b741-2bf598dd6ae7`, you would pass that value as `page_token` to retrieve the next page of results.

* If specified with a `direction` of `desc`, for example, the results will end before the activity with the specified ID.
* If specified with a `direction` of `asc`, results will begin with the activity immediately after the one specified.
* `page_size` is the maximum number of entries to return in the response.
* If `date` is not specified, the default and maximum value is 100.
* If `date` is specified, the default behavior is to return all results, and there is no maximum page size.

endpoints.description:
Returns a single account activity (V2) event for the specified account by ULID `event_id`, delivered as a server-sent event message.

endpoints.operationId: Retrieve a List of Account Documents
endpoints.summary: Retrieve a List of Account Documents
endpoints.description:
This endpoint allows you to query all the account document based on an account ID. You can filter by date, or type of document.

These account documents are tax statements, trade confirmations, etc, generated by the Alpaca system. They are distinct from the owner documents you upload and later access via the account object's documents property.

This endpoint downloads an account document based on the document ID. The document will be in PDF format.

The operation returns a pre-signed downloadable link as a redirect with HTTP status code 301 if one is found.

You can retrieve a JSON version of a monthly statement by passing in the header accept: application/json header.

These account documents are tax statements, trade confirmations, etc, generated by the Alpaca system. They are distinct from the owner documents you upload and later access via the account object's documents property.

endpoints.operationId: Upload Owner Documents for an Existing Account
endpoints.summary: Upload Owner Documents for an Existing Account
endpoints.description:
Upload documents for the primary account owner of an account.

Documents are binary objects whose contents are encoded in base64. Each encoded content size is limited to 10MB if you use Alpaca for KYCaaS. If you perform your own KYC there are no document size limitations.

As a convenience, documents of type w8ben may be uploaded as a JSON object using the content_data request property. The Alpaca system will then generate a formatted W-8 BEN document for subsequent downloads.

Note that these owner documents are distinct from the account documents generated by Alpaca, such as tax statements and trade confirmations.

endpoints.operationId: Download the W8BEN document for the primary owner of an account
endpoints.summary: Download the W8BEN document for the primary owner of an account
endpoints.description:
This endpoint allows you to download a W-8 BEN document for the primary owner of an account based on the document_id passed as a path parameter. The returned document is in PDF format.

For certain individuals, a W-8 BEN form should be submitted at onboarding. If the individual is not a registered U.S. taxpayer (not subject to a W-9), the W-8 BEN form may need to be submitted. The IRS explains which individuals this applies to and provides instructions on completing the form. Every three years, in addition to the calendar year it was signed, a new W-8 BEN form must be submitted.

The form can be submitted in JSON, JSONC, PNG, JPEG or PDF. If submitting it in JSON, please see the W-8 BEN completed with the corresponding field names for the API here.

Note: The dates collected on the form are in a slightly different format than how they need to be submitted via Accounts API. It is requested by the user on the form in MM-DD-YYYY, but should be submitted as YYYY-MM-DD.

This endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in the future. Please use the [GET /v1/reporting/eod/positions endpoint](https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/get-v1-reporting-eod-positions) instead.

endpoints.operationId: Update Trading Configurations for an Account
endpoints.summary: Update Trading Configurations for an Account
endpoints.description: You can also set the margin settings for your users' account by passing a PATCH request. By default any account with funds under $2,000 is set a margin multiplier of 1.0, and accounts with over $2,000 are set to 2.0.

endpoints.operationId: Retrieve real-time Trading Limits for an Account
endpoints.summary: Retrieve real-time Trading Limits for an Account
endpoints.description:
This endpoint is only available to accounts with the trading limits feature enabled, and not on JIT.
The daily trading limit is set at the correspondent level (or the account level) and is used as the limit for the total amount due to Alpaca on the date of settlement.
The limit in use returns the real time usage of this limit, based on the setup it uses the usage is calculated differently.
If the limit in use reaches the `daily_net_limit` or `available` is zero, further purchasing activity will be halted, however, the limit can be adjusted by reaching out to Alpaca with the proposed new limit and the reason for the change.

endpoints.description: Attempts to cancel all open orders. A response will be provided for each order that is attempted to be cancelled.

Retrieves a list of orders for the account, filtered by the supplied query parameters.

Endpoint defaults to open orders if no parameters are provided.

endpoints.operationId: Create an Order for an Account
endpoints.summary: Create an Order for an Account
endpoints.description:
Creating an order for your end customer. Each trading request must pass in the account_id in the URL.

- Note that when submitting crypto orders, `market`, `limit` and `stop_limit` orders are supported while the supported `time_in_force` values are `gtc`, and `ioc`.
- For equities and crypto we accept fractional orders as well with either `notional` or `qty` provided.
- Note that submitting an options order is only available for partners who have been enabled for Options BETA.
- In case of Fixed Income, only `market` and `limit` order types with `day` `time_in_force` are supported, and order replacement is not supported.
Note that submitting Fixed Income orders is only available for partners who have been enabled for Fixed Income.
- Note that submitting DMA orders (using `advanced_instructions` with `algorithm: DMA`) is only available for partners/correspondents who have been enabled for DMA.
- For IPO indications of interest (`asset_class: "ipo"`), the `symbol` is the offering reference returned by [`GET /v1/ipos`](#operation/listIPOOfferings) (e.g. `FI111225`). IPO orders are notional-only (`notional` required, `qty` must be omitted), buy-side, `market` type, and `gtc` time_in_force. Indications of interest can be replaced or canceled while the offering is open via [`PATCH /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/orders/{order_id}`](#operation/replaceOrderForAccount) and [`DELETE /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/orders/{order_id}`](#operation/deleteOrderForAccount).

Attempts to cancel an open order. If the order is no longer cancelable (for example if the status is "filled"), the server will respond with status 422, and reject the request.

Upon acceptance of the cancel request, it returns status 204.

Replaces a single order with updated parameters. Each parameter overrides the corresponding attribute of the existing order. The other attributes remain the same as the existing order.

A success return code from a replaced order does NOT guarantee the existing open order has been replaced. If the existing open order is filled before the replacing (new) order reaches the execution venue, the replacing (new) order is rejected, and these events are sent in the trade_updates stream channel found [here](https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/subscribetotradev2sse).

While an order is being replaced, the account's buying power is reduced by the larger of the two orders that have been placed (the old order being replaced, and the newly placed order to replace it). If you are replacing a buy entry order with a higher limit price than the original order, the buying power is calculated based on the newly placed order. If you are replacing it with a lower limit price, the buying power is calculated based on the old order.

Note: Order cannot be replaced when the status is `accepted`, `pending_new`, `pending_cancel` or `pending_replace`.

Note: Notional orders for non-IPO asset classes cannot be replaced. Any attempt to modify a non-IPO notional order via this endpoint will be rejected; cancel it and submit a new one instead.

Note: IPO indications of interest (`asset_class: "ipo"`) **are** notional and **can** be replaced via this endpoint by providing a new `notional` value. `qty` and `notional` are mutually exclusive on a single replace request.

Note that submitting DMA orders (using `advanced_instructions` with `algorithm: DMA`) is only available for partners/correspondents who have been enabled for DMA.

Order estimation endpoint will display, based on user's account balance, the estimated quantity and price they will receive for their notional order.

For LCT - customer's order will include the Alpaca swap_fee, while correspondent side swap_fee is configurable in the API call. Utilising this API does not result in a real order and after the calculation - the user's buying power reverts to the previous state.

Responses and Errors are the same as with the Orders API

Please note that the estimation is based on the market condition at the time of submission and a live order will differ. The output should be considered indicative.

**Note:** This does not support Crypto or non-market orders at this time.

According to the SSE specification, any line that starts with a colon is a comment which does not contain data.  It is typically a free text that does not follow any data schema. A few examples mentioned below for comment messages.

**Common events**

These are the events that are the expected results of actions you may have taken by sending API requests.

The meaning of the timestamp field changes for each type; the meanings have been specified here for which types the timestamp field will be present.

- `accepted` Sent when an order is received and accepted by Alpaca
- `pending_new` Sent when the order has been received by Alpaca and routed to the exchanges, but has not yet been accepted for execution.
- `new` Sent when an order has been routed to exchanges for execution.
- `fill` Sent when your order has been completely filled.
  - timestamp: The time at which the order was filled.
- `partial_fill` Sent when a number of shares less than the total remaining quantity on your order has been filled.
  - timestamp: The time at which the shares were filled.
- `canceled` Sent when your requested cancellation of an order is processed.
  - timestamp: The time at which the order was canceled.
- `expired` Sent when an order has reached the end of its lifespan, as determined by the order's time in force value.
  - timestamp: The time at which the order expired.
- `done_for_day` Sent when the order is done executing for the day, and will not receive further updates until the next trading day.
- `replaced` Sent when your requested replacement of an order is processed.
  - timestamp: The time at which the order was replaced.

**Rarer events**

These are events that may rarely be sent due to unexpected circumstances on the exchanges. It is unlikely you will need to design your code around them, but you may still wish to account for the possibility that they will occur.

- `rejected` Sent when your order has been rejected.
  - timestamp: The time at which the rejection occurred.
- `held` For multi-leg orders, the secondary orders (stop loss, take profit) will enter this state while waiting to be triggered.
- `stopped` Sent when your order has been stopped, and a trade is guaranteed for the order, usually at a stated price or better, but has not yet occurred.
- `pending_cancel` Sent when the order is awaiting cancellation. Most cancellations will occur without the order entering this state.
- `pending_replace` Sent when the order is awaiting replacement.
- `calculated` Sent when the order has been completed for the day - it is either filled or done_for_day - but remaining settlement calculations are still pending.
- `suspended` Sent when the order has been suspended and is not eligible for trading.
- `order_replace_rejected` Sent when the order replace has been rejected.
- `order_cancel_rejected` Sent when the order cancel has been rejected.
- `trade_bust`: Sent when a previously reported execution has been canceled ("busted") by the upstream exchange.
- `trade_correct`: Sent when a previously reported trade has been corrected. For example, the exchange may have updated the price, quantity, or another execution parameter after the trade was initially reported.
- `restated`: Sent when the order is manually modified.

- `suspended` Sent when the order has been suspended and is not eligible for trading.
- `order_replace_rejected` Sent when the order replace has been rejected.
- `order_cancel_rejected` Sent when the order cancel has been rejected.
- `trade_bust`: Sent when a previously reported execution has been canceled ("busted") by the upstream exchange.
- `trade_correct`: Sent when a previously reported trade has been corrected. For example, the exchange may have updated the price, quantity, or another execution parameter after the trade was initially reported.
- `restated`: Sent when the order is manually modified.

Create a new transfer to deposit money into or withdraw money from an account.

Two `transfer_type` values are accepted, and both are available in sandbox and production:

- **`ach`** — supports both `INCOMING` (deposit) and `OUTGOING` (withdrawal) directions. A `relationship_id` from a previously created [ACH Relationship](https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/createachrelationshipforaccount) is required.
- **`wire`** — supports the `OUTGOING` (withdrawal) direction only. Incoming wires cannot be initiated through this endpoint; they are pushed in by the sending bank and recorded automatically. A `bank_id` from a previously created [Bank Relationship](https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/createrecipientbank) is required, and the bank must be in `APPROVED` status before the transfer will progress past `QUEUED`.

In the sandbox environment, ACH deposits and withdrawals settle instantly against virtual funds. Outgoing wire withdrawals are accepted and simulated end-to-end — no funds are transmitted to a bank, but the transfer progresses to `COMPLETE` and the account is debited against virtual funds. Sandbox wire withdrawals are asynchronous (not instant) and auto-complete on weekdays only; transfers submitted on a weekend will not progress until Monday. For more on funding accounts in sandbox, see [this tutorial](https://alpaca.markets/learn/fund-broker-api/).

attributes.name: RoutingNumber
attributes.documentation: The routing number is used synonymously as ABA routing number and routing transit number.  The routing number consists of 9 digits, for example XXXXYYYYC where XXXX is Federal Reserve Routing Symbol, YYYY is ABA Institution Identifier, and C is the Check Digit.  The first two digits of the nine digit routing number must be in the ranges 00 through 12, 21 through 32, 61 through 72, or 80.  The digits are assigned as follows: 00 is used by the United States Government; 01 through 12 are the normal routing numbers; 21 through 32 were assigned only to thrift institutions (e.g. credit unions and savings banks) through 1985, currently are still used by the thrift institutions, or their successors; 61 through 72 are used for electronic transactions; 80 is used for traveler's checks.  The first two digits correspond to the 12 Federal Reserve Banks.  [reference: http://www.tfp.com/text/aba_policy.pdf]

attributes.name: AgencyFormName
attributes.documentation: The name an agency assigns to an agency form.

attributes.name: AgencyFormNumber
attributes.documentation: The number an agency assigns to an agency form.

attributes.name: AgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the department, agency or establishment of the U.S. Government that is responsible for the TAS.  Agency Identifer is also used apart from the TAS to identify a major department or independent agency of the Federal government.

attributes.name: AgencyLocationCode
attributes.documentation: The identifier for an accounting office within an agency that reports disbursements and collections to Treasury.

attributes.name: OfficeLocationCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies an agency location more specifically than an Agency Location Code.

attributes.name: AgencyLocationTypeCode
attributes.documentation: A code that distinguishes the type of Agency Location (e.g., Regional Finance Center, Non-Treasury Disbursing Office subject to Audit).

attributes.name: SuccessorCode
attributes.documentation: An Agency Location Code defined as the valid replacement for an existing Agency Location Code upon its dissolution.

attributes.name: ReportingCode
attributes.documentation: An Agency Location Code that is designated as the parent for one of more children Agency Location Codes, responsible for reporting accounting transactions for those children.

attributes.name: OrganizationalIdentifier
attributes.documentation: A number that uniquely identifies an Organizational Unit of the United States Federal Government.  (Organization Identifier of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: OrganizationalDisplayName
attributes.documentation: A short or abbreviated name for the Organizational Unit.  (Display Name of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: OrganizationEstablishedDate
attributes.documentation: The date on which the Organizational Unit came into being.  (Established Date of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: OrganizationDissolvedDate
attributes.documentation: The date on which the Organizational Unit ceased to exist.  (Dissolved Date of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTimestamp
attributes.documentation: Date and time on which the Organizational Unit was created or last modified in the system of record for Agency organization reference data.  (Last Updated Timestamp of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: LastUpdatedUserName
attributes.documentation: The identier of the user that created or last modified the Organizational Unit in the system of record for Agency organization reference data.  (Last Updated User of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: SourceDocumentReferenceNumber
attributes.documentation: The reference number of the document authorizing changes to the Agency Location Code.

attributes.name: AgencySiteIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the agency site that processes a transaction.

attributes.name: AgencySiteName
attributes.documentation: The name of the agency site that processes a transaction.

attributes.name: AgencyCheckText
attributes.documentation: Information provided by the agency for printing on check.

attributes.name: AgentBankAccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The account number of a deposit account at a financial agent or depositary that the bank uses for transactions involving public money.

attributes.name: AgentRoutingNumber
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) associated with an agent or depositary.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.documentation: The transaction amount.

attributes.name: BankAccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The account number for the financial institution involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: BankAccountTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of account associated with the transaction, such as checking or savings.

attributes.name: TransferMechanismCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates the financial instrument used to concentrate funds into the Treasury's General Account.

attributes.name: DFI_AccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The account number of the payment recipient at the receiving bank.

attributes.name: BeneficiaryIdentifier
attributes.documentation: An ISO identification code for both financial and non-financial institutions that is used when transferring money, particularly for international wire transfers.  It is also used for the exchange of non-monetary messages.

attributes.name: BankName
attributes.documentation: The name of the financial institution.

attributes.name: BranchIdentifier
attributes.documentation: An identifier assigned by a bank to its branches that is unique for any given Routing Number.

attributes.name: BudgetAgencyCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies a department, agency or establishment of the U.S. Government that is responsible for the budget account.

attributes.name: BudgetBureauCode
attributes.documentation: The Office of Management and Budget code that identifies a major sub-organization of the agency, sometimes called an administration, service, or agency. (Not all agencies have bureaus.)

attributes.name: BureauName
attributes.documentation: The name of a bureau.

attributes.name: BusinessEventTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies the type of activity (gross disbursement, offsetting collection, investment in Treasury securities, etc.) and the effect of a transaction on the Fund Balance With Treasury (FBWT).  Is used in combination with the Treasury Account Symbol to classify transactions reported to Treasury through all Governmentwide Accounting (GWA-compliant) financial management systems.

attributes.name: BusinessEventTypeName
attributes.documentation: The name associated with a Business Event Type Code value.

attributes.name: AccountSuspendDate
attributes.documentation: Only populated if the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) and Business Event Type Code (BETC) combination is suspended.

attributes.name: AccountEffectiveDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the date when the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) and Business Event Type Code (BETC) became available for use.

attributes.name: AccountEndDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the date when the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) and Business Event Type Code (BETC) became completely inactive.

attributes.name: ChannelBatchIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Identifies the input batch in which the transaction was reported to the channel application.

attributes.name: InitialLocation
attributes.documentation: Initial location of the point of deposit; i.e., a bank branch identifier.

attributes.name: CollectionBusinessDate
attributes.documentation: The date that collections information is centralized prior to subsequent reporting.

attributes.name: IsIntragovernmental
attributes.documentation: Identifies transactions where both payer and payee are federal government entities.

attributes.name: AgentInitialIdentifier
attributes.documentation: An identifier for the Financial Agent that initially received the transaction.

attributes.name: SourceSubProgramText
attributes.documentation: The initial Fiscal Service subprogram that processes a transaction.  There can be up to four subprograms associated with a transaction.

attributes.name: SourceProcessingProgramText
attributes.documentation: The initial Fiscal Service program that processes the transaction.  There can be up to four programs associated with a transaction.

attributes.name: ReportingSubProgramText
attributes.documentation: There are subprograms at more than the reporting and source level. There could be up to four subprograms involved in a transaction.

attributes.name: ReportingProgramText
attributes.documentation: There are programs at more than the reporting and source level.

attributes.name: BusinessTransactionTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether this record is either a Payment, Collection, Intragovernmental Payment and Collection (IPC), or Non-Treasury Disbursing Office (NTDO) Payment.

attributes.name: CashFlowIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a class of agency transactions that share the same purpose, assigned on a program-specific basis. For example, collections associated with an agency form constitute a cash flow.

attributes.name: CashFlowName
attributes.documentation: The name for the class of agency transactions that share the same purpose, assigned on a program-specific basis. For example, collections associated with an agency form constitute a cash flow.

attributes.name: ProgramCashFlowName
attributes.documentation: A name for agency transactions that share the same purpose, assigned on a program-specific basis.

attributes.name: ProgramCashFlowIdentifier
attributes.documentation: An identifier for agency transactions that share the same purpose, assigned on a program-specific basis.

attributes.name: DirectoryAccessDistinguishedName
attributes.documentation: The X500 Distinguished name contained in the digital certificate used to sign the schedule certification.

attributes.name: ChangeType
attributes.documentation: Populated only for Partner Profiles requesting Reference Data changes to be distributed, Action is the reason for the change (e.g., new, modify).

attributes.name: ChannelInitiationDate
attributes.documentation: The date that the public or an agency (on behalf of a public remitter or as a remitter itself) initiates or sends a transaction to an agent or depositary.

attributes.name: ChannelReceiptDate
attributes.documentation: The date that an agent or depositary receives a transaction.

attributes.name: ChannelTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the channel through which an agent or depositary receives a transaction.

attributes.name: CheckTraceNumber
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for traceability within Check21 processing.

attributes.name: CheckSerialNumber
attributes.documentation: The serial number of a check; i.e., the number that typically resides in the top right-hand corner of a check.

attributes.name: CheckTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of check, e.g., personal, business, money order, etc.

attributes.name: IsCheckElectronic
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the check was settled electronically via image or non-electronically via paper.

attributes.name: ProcessingMethodCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies whether a check is presented by a check writer who is present at the agency location.

attributes.name: ResearchRequiredIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the transaction has been flagged for research.

attributes.name: MICR_Unparsed
attributes.documentation: The Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) information from a check, captured as a single string.

attributes.name: RedundancyCheckNumber
attributes.documentation: A form of redundancy check used for error detection and consists of a single digit computed from the other digits in the amount field.

attributes.name: CheckPaymentEnclosureCode
attributes.documentation: Code denoting special name, address, and stub characteristics of a check payment.  It is also used to denote a foreign payment.

attributes.name: DisbursingOfficeSymbol
attributes.documentation: A number assigned to the agency which is disbursing funds from the Treasury General Account (TGA).

attributes.name: IsCourtesyCheck
attributes.documentation: A code that indicates whether the check is a regular check or a check that is reissued as a special service to certain agencies by a Regional Financial Center (RFC).

attributes.name: CheckBatchCreationDate
attributes.documentation: The date the set of checks was printed.

attributes.name: CheckSymbolNumber
attributes.documentation: A number within the range of 1000 and 9998 which uniquely identifies the agency issuing the US Treasury Check.

attributes.name: CheckFirstSerialNumber
attributes.documentation: The first serial number in a set of checks.

attributes.name: CheckAccountingMonthAndYear
attributes.documentation: The accounting month under which the check issues in the batch will be reported to Governmentwide Accounting (GWA).

attributes.name: SpecialHandling
attributes.documentation: Used for manual handling of checks such as the designated agent.  Requires agency / Fiscal Service collaboration prior to use.

attributes.name: IsVoidedCheck
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the check has been voided in the process of printing.

attributes.name: CheckIssueDate
attributes.documentation: The date of payment inscribed on the check.

attributes.name: ClassificationKeyName
attributes.documentation: The name associated with a Classification Key (C-Key) value. For example, the C-Key Name could be 'Tax Class', and the C-Key Values could be '01', '02', etc.

attributes.name: ClassificationKeyValue
attributes.documentation: The value associated with a Classification Key (C-Key) name. For example, the C-Key Name could be 'Tax Class', and the C-Key Values could be '01', '02', etc.

attributes.name: Code
attributes.documentation: The transaction code, for example, indicates the standard entry class codes in an ACH transaction.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.documentation: The type of transaction, for example, indicates the Fedwire type for this record.

attributes.name: SummaryReportLocation
attributes.documentation: Indicates the location of the report.

attributes.name: CollectionsAccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The six-digit identifier representing a Central Accounts Receivable System (CARS) account profile that includes a legacy CA$HLINK account type, routing number (RTN), deposit account, deposit funds availability, and cost code information, as well as potentially other factors.

attributes.name: BusinessTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a business transaction.

attributes.name: CollectionsTransactionTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The high-level categorization that identifies the type of transaction activity the financial transaction represents.

attributes.name: InputBatchIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a batch of transactions received by a program.

attributes.name: InstallmentInstanceNumber
attributes.documentation: The number denoting a particular installment within a series of installments.

attributes.name: InternetProtocolAddress
attributes.documentation: The Internet protocol (IP) address associated with a transaction.

attributes.name: IntragovernmentalIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether a payer and payee in a transaction are both federal government entities.

attributes.name: NotificationOfChangeUpdateResultText
attributes.documentation: The result of a notification of change (NOC) request against, for example, a payer profile.

attributes.name: RecurringFrequencyCode
attributes.documentation: The frequency of a recurring collection.

attributes.name: RemittanceCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of remittance documents.

attributes.name: TotalInstallmentCount
attributes.documentation: The total count of installments in a related series of installments.

attributes.name: AgentBankName
attributes.documentation: The name of the agent or depositary.

attributes.name: BankBranchIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a financial institution branch.

attributes.name: BulkProviderName
attributes.documentation: The name of a payroll provider that makes tax payments through an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) compatible system.

attributes.name: ChainIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier assigned to each account by a plastic card provider. Some agencies have more than one Chain to differentiate between major lines of business; ChainIdentifer is associated to DivisionIdentifier.

attributes.name: ChannelElectronicIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the Fiscal Service program received the transactions electronically.

attributes.name: CollectionsBusinessDate
attributes.documentation: The date that collections information is centralized in a data repositary prior to subsequent reporting.

attributes.name: CollectionsStatusCode
attributes.documentation: The code that denotes the status of a transaction; i.e., where it is in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: DivisionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier assigned to each account by a plastic card provider that represents a deposit into the Collections Information Repository (CIR), when combined with a Chain.

attributes.name: InitialProcessingSiteIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for initial agent or depositary site that receives a transaction. For example, each lockbox processing site can have its own identifier.

attributes.name: LockboxAccountIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the lockbox activity received by a lockbox processing site.

attributes.name: ManualEntryIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an entry was captured through manual entry by an agent.

attributes.name: NonTreasuryCollectionCode
attributes.documentation: The identifier that indicates whether a collection is the responsibility of a non-governmental agency or a government agency that holds cash outside of Treasury.

attributes.name: ReportingProgramName
attributes.documentation: The name of a reporting program; i.e., the name of a Fiscal Service program that reports transactions to a central repository.

attributes.name: SummaryIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the summary record. A receiving system can use this value to reconcile updates to an existing record and qualify new records. A sending system can use this value to reconcile acknowledgements for the submitted records.

attributes.name: InformationalOnlyTransactionCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of non-accountable transactions.

attributes.name: SummaryTotalIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether totals represent summarized or detailed transactions.

attributes.name: TotalCreditAmount
attributes.documentation: The total absolute dollar amount of credits.

attributes.name: TotalCreditCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of credit items.

attributes.name: TotalDebitAmount
attributes.documentation: The total absolute dollar amount of debits.

attributes.name: TotalDebitCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of debit items.

attributes.name: CommercialBankIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the item was settled through a commercial depositary.

attributes.name: ConfirmedDate
attributes.documentation: The date that an agent or depositary electronically records or confirms a transaction.

attributes.name: ControlNumber
attributes.documentation: Provides a reference to the Payment Request File.

attributes.name: CostCenterWorkUnitCode
attributes.documentation: The cost center work unit assoicated with FRB vouchers and transactions.

attributes.name: CUI_Indicator
attributes.documentation: [Pending Security Metadata vote]

attributes.name: OriginalCurrencyCode
attributes.documentation: The code that defines the enumerated types of standard 3-letter ISO 4217 currency codes.

attributes.name: OriginalCurrencyCodeText
attributes.documentation: The non-standard currency code.

attributes.name: DenominatorCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies the type of US currency.

attributes.name: ValueAmount
attributes.documentation: Represents the amount value of items of the specified denominator.

attributes.name: CreditIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an item is a debit or credit.

attributes.name: BankPostingDate
attributes.documentation: The date that an agent or depositary credits or debits funds to or from a Treasury account (either a deposit account or routing number (RTN)).

attributes.name: DepositaryDetailRoutingNumber
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) from which the funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury general Account (TGA).

attributes.name: ChecksMoneyOrdersSubtotalAmount
attributes.documentation: Represents the total value of the checks and money orders contained within a deposit.

attributes.name: CheckCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of checks in a deposit.

attributes.name: MoneyOrderCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of money orders within a deposit.

attributes.name: PaperCurrencySubtotalAmount
attributes.documentation: Represents the value of paper currency contained within the deposit.

attributes.name: CoinCurrencySubtotalAmount
attributes.documentation: Represents the total value of coins contained within the Deposit.

attributes.name: CurrencySubtotalAmount
attributes.documentation: Represents the value of coin and paper currency contained within a deposit.

attributes.name: DUNS_Number
attributes.documentation: The Dunn and Bradstreet Identification Number is a unique nine-character number that identifies an organization.

attributes.name: ElementName
attributes.documentation: The name which identifies the content of the data element.

attributes.name: EmailAddressText
attributes.documentation: The email address for the party involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: OriginalAgencyTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The Agency Transaction Identifier an agency assigned for the original transaction.

attributes.name: OriginalBankPostingDate
attributes.documentation: The bank posting date associated with the original transaction.

attributes.name: OriginalChannelTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier a channel assigned for the original transaction.

attributes.name: OriginalSettlementTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The Settlement Transaction Identifier a settlement provider assigned for the original transaction.

attributes.name: OriginalVoucherDate
attributes.documentation: The voucher date of a voucher that a subsequent voucher adjusts, corrects, or rescinds.

attributes.name: OriginalVoucherIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The voucher identifier of a voucher that a subsequent voucher adjusts, corrects, or rescinds.

attributes.name: OriginalVoucherNumber
attributes.documentation: The voucher number of a voucher that a subsequent voucher adjusts, corrects, or rescinds.

attributes.name: ExceptionTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The type of change to a previously reported transaction.

attributes.name: FedwireTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code used to identify the type of Fedwire Message, e.g., funds transfer, foreign transfer, etc.

attributes.name: FedwireProductCode
attributes.documentation: A code that identifies the type of payment recipient (either customer or bank)

attributes.name: PaymentReference
attributes.documentation: Optional Reference for Payment Information. Formerly RFB.

attributes.name: IMAD
attributes.documentation: The Input Messaging Accountability Data (IMAD) is a combination of a date, source identifier, and sequence number assigned to a Fedwire message when it is processed by the Federal Reserve Bank Funds Transfer application.

attributes.name: OMAD
attributes.documentation: The Output Messaging Accountability Data (OMAD) is a combination of a date, destination identifier, and sequence number assigned to a Fedwire message when it is processed by the Federal Reserve Bank Funds Transfer application.

attributes.name: FedwireSubTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code used in combination with the FedwireType Code to identify the type of Fedwire Message.

attributes.name: BusinessFunctionCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of business the message represents, e.g., bank transfer, drawdown response, etc.

attributes.name: OriginalIMAD
attributes.documentation: The original Input Messaging Accountability Data (IMAD) associated with an earlier Fedwire Message, also known as 'Previous IMAD'.

attributes.name: IncomingTransactionIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the Fedwire message represents a transaction received into the Treasury's Fedwire account or sent from the Treasury's Fedwire account.

attributes.name: BankText
attributes.documentation: The text supplied by the financial institution, in addition to the agency supplied text.

attributes.name: FundsAvailableDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the date the deposited funds can be immediately disbursed or otherwise withdrawn.

attributes.name: FinancialReportingEntityCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies the Public Debt Accounting Reporting System (PARS) Reporting Entity for the collection and disbursement activity related to Treasury securities.

attributes.name: AgencyTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier an agency provides for a transaction.

attributes.name: SettlementTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a transaction within the settlement service.

attributes.name: ChannelTransactionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a transaction within the channel.

attributes.name: PayerMechanismCode
attributes.documentation: The payment medium for the transaction.

attributes.name: GatewayReceiptDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the date that a settlement gateway or provider receives financial data for processing.

attributes.name: SettlementStatusCode
attributes.documentation: The settlement status code that identifies how the transaction was settled.

attributes.name: FiscalYear
attributes.documentation: Fiscal Year is a term that is used to differentiate a budget or financial year from the calendar year. The U.S. Government's Fiscal Year runs from October 1 of the prior year through September 30 of the next year. For example, FY 2006 was from October 2005 through September 2006; FY 2007 runs from October 2006 through September 2007, and; FY 2008 is from October 2007 through September 2008.

attributes.name: FiscalMonth
attributes.documentation: The numbered month of a fiscal year, which does not necessarily match the calendar year.

attributes.name: ForecastSummaryIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the summary record. A receiving system can use this value to reconcile updates to an existing record and qualify new records. A sending system can use this value to reconcile acknowledgements for the submitted records.

attributes.name: ExchangeRate
attributes.documentation: The market price for which one currency can be exchanged for another.

attributes.name: ConversionMethodCode
attributes.documentation: The code indicating how a foreign currency exchange was converted.

attributes.name: ForeignCurrencyAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount of currency in a foreign denomination.

attributes.name: FRB_DistrictCode
attributes.documentation: The code denoting the general area of coverage for a Federal Reserve Bank. The Federal Reserve System assigns district codes.

attributes.name: FRB_OfficeCode
attributes.documentation: The code denoting a particular Federal Reserve Bank location within a given Federal Reserve Bank district.

attributes.name: FRB_AccountKeyCode
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a program assigned within FRB CA$H-LINK, known within that system as an account key. The FRB CA$H-LINK account key is similar to the Collections Account Number (CAN), but is only used for financial activity involving Federal Reserve Banks.

attributes.name: CustomerAccountsReceivableSystemNumber
attributes.documentation: A CARS/Bank Management Service defined number identifying an account.

attributes.name: NonTreasuryFundCode
attributes.documentation: An identifier used to indicate whether funds are a non-governmental agency or a government agency that holds cash outside of Treasury.

attributes.name: IsCommercialBank
attributes.documentation: Indicates if the item was settled through a commercial depositary.

attributes.name: AgencyGroupingIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a logical grouping of similiar business units.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: An identifier for the record.  For a receiving system, this value can be used to reconcile updates to an existing record and qualify new records.  For a sending system, this value can be used to reconcile acknowledgements for the submitted records.

attributes.name: CheckImageTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifes whether a check image is the front or back of the check.

attributes.name: ImageAddressIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The address that provides the unique location for the image content.

attributes.name: ImageLengthNumber
attributes.documentation: The size of an image in bytes.

attributes.name: ImageOffsetNumber
attributes.documentation: The starting point in bytes for a particular image within a batch.

attributes.name: ImageReferenceIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for an image.

attributes.name: InputSystemText
attributes.documentation: The sending trading partner that provides information to a receiving trading partner.

attributes.name: SystemDocumentNumber
attributes.documentation: A document number reference established by other system.

attributes.name: OwningAgencyCode
attributes.documentation: Owning agency of a STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: CoOwningAgencyCode
attributes.documentation: Co-owning agency of a STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: MainAccount
attributes.documentation: Main account of a STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: SubAccountSymbol
attributes.documentation: Sub account symbol of a STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: SubClassificationSymbol
attributes.documentation: Sub-classification of a STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: InternalAccountSymbolText
attributes.documentation: The STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: FiscalYearText
attributes.documentation: The fiscal year for the STAR Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: IRS_TaxIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an item is an IRS tax transaction.

attributes.name: Count
attributes.documentation: Indicates the number of items represented by this record.

attributes.name: LegalTransactionAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount that should have been reported on the original transaction.  For an encoded error, this amount equals the amount of the adjustment transaction plus the OriginalRecordedAmount.

attributes.name: MerchantNumber
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier of the plastic card merchant, as assigned by the settlement provider.  For collections activities this identifier currently uniquely represents an Agency within the plastic card settlement provider.

attributes.name: MerchantCategoryCode
attributes.documentation: The code that designates the type of merchant business (food, department store, etc.) for a plastic card transaction.

attributes.name: MerchantStoreNumber
attributes.documentation: The nine digit number assigned by the plastic card settlement provider to identify a merchant's store.

attributes.name: FedwireTagCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies a section within a Fedwire Message and briefly describes what the Fedwire transaction represents.

attributes.name: BusinessTransmissionCategory
attributes.documentation: The business line that processed the transaction.

attributes.name: EOD_Indicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether a file is considered the end-of-day file.

attributes.name: RunningDailyCount
attributes.documentation: A running total count for a given day. (A day is determined from the end of day indicator of the prior day to the current end of day.)

attributes.name: RunningDailyAmount
attributes.documentation: A cumulative absolute amount, including the items within a transmission, within a given day. (A day is determined from the end of day indicator of the prior day to the current end of day.)

attributes.name: VersionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Indicates an identifier assigned to a version for this transmission.

attributes.name: TransmissionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for a transmission.

attributes.name: StandardEntryClassCode
attributes.documentation: The code identifying the NACHA payment type.

attributes.name: EffectiveEntryDate
attributes.documentation: The intended settlement date, as provided by the originator.

attributes.name: CompanyEntryDescriptionText
attributes.documentation: The description detailing the purpose of the entry or transaction.

attributes.name: ServiceClassCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies whether the ACH entries in the batch are debits, credits, or both.

attributes.name: AddendaCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of addendum records associated with a transaction.

attributes.name: ACH_TransactionCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies various types of debit and credit ACH transactions. Portions of the code value can also be used to identify the account type associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: ACH_TraceNumber
attributes.documentation: The number used to identify an individual ACH entry within a batch.

attributes.name: ACH_OriginalTraceNumber
attributes.documentation: The Trace Number as originally included on the entry being returned or acknowledged, or on the Prenotification being rejected or corrected.

attributes.name: NonDomesticIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the entity or transaction is considered non domestic.

attributes.name: NonDomesticBankIndicator
attributes.documentation: The identifier denoting whether the Fiscal Service considers an entity to be non-domestic.

attributes.name: NonDomesticCollectionIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the transaction associated with a collection is considered non domestic.

attributes.name: NSS_ReferenceIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The reference information in a National Settlement Service (NSS) transfer entry that assists a receiver of the entry in understanding the reason for the transfer.

attributes.name: OMB_ControlNumber
attributes.documentation: The number assigned by the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to uniquely identify a government form.

attributes.name: TaxAmount
attributes.documentation: The taxable amount of the order

attributes.name: OrganizationalName
attributes.documentation: The official name by which an Organization Unit of the United States Federal Government is referred.  (Title of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: InternalOrganizationCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the entity that manages resources below the agency and bureau level, such as an office or a division.

attributes.name: OrganizationLevelIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a particular level within an organizational unit of the Federal Government.

attributes.name: OriginalRecordedAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount originally recorded for the transaction.

attributes.name: OtherSecondaryRoutingNumber
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) used to segregate transaction activity, that is reported to the Treasury's Master Account through a Subaccount RTN, to accommodate reporting and operational needs. It is also referred to as an Other Secondary Customer Identification Number (CIN) by the Federal Reserve or as a Tier 3 RTN by Treasury.

attributes.name: PartyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identification number for the party involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: PartyName
attributes.documentation: The name of the party involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: PartyTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The party type, e.g., individual, business or government.

attributes.name: TIN
attributes.documentation: A Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) is an identification number used by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) in the administration of tax laws. It is issued either by the Social Security Administration (SSA) or by the IRS. A Social Security number (SSN) is issued by the SSA whereas all other TINs are issued by the IRS.

attributes.name: TIN_Code
attributes.documentation: Indicates the type of Tax Identification Number.

attributes.name: IsRepresentativePayee
attributes.documentation: Identifies whether the recipient is a representative for the beneficiary.

attributes.name: ConfirmationDate
attributes.documentation: The date the payment transaction was accepted - the actual pay date.

attributes.name: PaymentDocumentTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates the type of payment in the payment schedule.

attributes.name: BeginSerialNumber
attributes.documentation: Lower limit of a range of check numbers.

attributes.name: EndSerialNumber
attributes.documentation: Upper limit of a range of check numbers.

attributes.name: CheckSymbol
attributes.documentation: Part of the unique identifier of a check.

attributes.name: PaymentID
attributes.documentation: Identifier assigned by the agency that is unique within the Schedule.  When combined with the Schedule Number, AgencyLocationCode, and Fiscal Year, this makes a globally unique identifier for the payment.

attributes.name: AgencyPaymentTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Internal agency code used to identify the type of payment within the specific agency.

attributes.name: DiscretionaryText
attributes.documentation: Free-form field for agency’s use in reconciling the payment using PACER.

attributes.name: PayeeName
attributes.documentation: The person to which the payment instrument is made payable.

attributes.name: PayeeIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Account number used internally by an agency to identify a payee.

attributes.name: PaymentDetailTypeCode
attributes.documentation: A Payment Type code at the transactional level.  This is used in coordination with PaymentTypeCode and SubPaymentTypeCode.

attributes.name: PaymentTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Code denoting the type of payment.

attributes.name: SubPaymentTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Subcode of PaymentTypeCode that further denotes the type of payment.

attributes.name: FullName
attributes.documentation: Contains the full name of a person.

attributes.name: PhoneNumber
attributes.documentation: A number assigned to a telephone line for a specific location that is used to call that location.

attributes.name: PhoneNumberExtension
attributes.documentation: An extension to the phone number assigned to a telephone line for a specific location that is used to call that location.

attributes.name: PhoneType
attributes.documentation: The type of phone: cell, phone, fax.

attributes.name: MonthYearExpireDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the month/year value of a card's expiration date.

attributes.name: CardNumber
attributes.documentation: The credit card or debit card number.

attributes.name: MaskedCardNumber
attributes.documentation: The masked credit card or debit card number.

attributes.name: CardSecurityCode
attributes.documentation: The 3 or 4 digit value printed on the card or signature strip but not available on the magnetic strip.

attributes.name: OriginalInterchangeCode
attributes.documentation: The code assigned by the plastic card service provider that provides the business type for the transaction.

attributes.name: InterchangeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of transaction that the interchange fee applies to and dictates the interchange fee amount applied to the transaction.

attributes.name: InterchangeReimbursementFeeAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount that the merchant must pay to the network carrier (i.e. Visa, MasterCard, AMEX, Discover) representing the true cost of a plastic card transaction.

attributes.name: InterchangeReimbursementFeeAmountSignIndicator
attributes.documentation: The sign of the Interchange Reimbursement Fee Amount.

attributes.name: InterchangeAdjustmentReasonCode
attributes.documentation: The one character code that defines why the surcharge, downgrade or adjustment was done.

attributes.name: InterchangeAdjustmentAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount over paid or under paid for each transaction based on the base qualification rate.  If the base rate is 1.43% + $0.05 and the transaction qualifies for a rate 1.85% + $0.05 this amount would be .42% of the transaction amount, indicating overpayment by .42% because the transaction did not qualify for the optimal rate.

attributes.name: InterchangeAdjustmentAmountSignIndicator
attributes.documentation: The sign of the Interchange Adjustment Amount.

attributes.name: AuthorizationCharacteristicsCode
attributes.documentation: The code that defines if the card was presented for authorization, whether the merchant name and location were provided, or what authorization was used when the card was not provided.

attributes.name: AuthorizationCode
attributes.documentation: The code assigned by the plastic card issuer to identify the approval for a specific authorization request.

attributes.name: AuthorizationSourceCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the authorization source for the card transaction, such as 'Automated Referral Service Response.'

attributes.name: AVS_ResponseCode
attributes.documentation: The Address Verification Service (AVS) response code is the code that the merchant received when processing the transaction that is related to the processing of the address information.

attributes.name: CardProductTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The three character code that provides information on the type of plastic card, valid only for Visa, Discover and MasterCard, e.g., 'MDG' refers to a Gold MasterCard Debit Card.

attributes.name: ClientBatchNumber
attributes.documentation: The number which identifies the sequential position of a batch within a file.

attributes.name: CashBackAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount of money that is added to the total purchase price of a transaction (paid by debit card), which the customer receives in cash along with their goods.

attributes.name: CardNetworkTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The type of network the plastic card used for a payment, e.g., VISA, MCRD, AMEX, etc.

attributes.name: CardProductCode
attributes.documentation: The type of card used for the transaction, e.g., AX (American Express).

attributes.name: NetworkResponseCode
attributes.documentation: The code detailing the card provider's response, which is formatted based on the card network.

attributes.name: ChargebackReferenceNumber
attributes.documentation: The network reference number related to the chargeback.

attributes.name: CardResponseCode
attributes.documentation: The code used for credit and gift cards that specifies how and if the card security code was processed.

attributes.name: ChargebackRecordNumber
attributes.documentation: The number assigned to any single customer transaction that is questioned, used to relate all disputes and subsequent records.

attributes.name: DraftLocatorNumber
attributes.documentation: The number associated with data matching, supplied by the customer.

attributes.name: CAT_Code
attributes.documentation: The code that provides the type of Cardholder Activated Terminal (CAT) used in the transaction.

attributes.name: OrderIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for plastic card order-level data.

attributes.name: POS_EntryMode
attributes.documentation: The code that defines how the authorization for the card was read.  The first two positions refer to how the card was read and the third position refers to the capture of the PIN.

attributes.name: RegisterNumber
attributes.documentation: The number which identifies the register where the plastic card transaction occurred.

attributes.name: StorePersonIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The idenitifer, supplied by the merchant, that represents the person who originated the transaction.

attributes.name: TaxableAmount
attributes.documentation: The taxable amount of the transaction.

attributes.name: TerminalNumber
attributes.documentation: The number which identifies the terminal where the plastic card transaction occurred.

attributes.name: TransactionTimeZoneCode
attributes.documentation: The code representing the time zone of the merchant. For example, 'EST' represents 'Eastern Standard Time'.

attributes.name: TransactionTime
attributes.documentation: The date and time the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: ChannelCutoffTime
attributes.documentation: The time that determines the end of a 24 hour day for plastic card payments, when a transaction will be sent for settlement, as defined by the agency.

attributes.name: CardEventTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The event type of the plastic card transaction, e.g., Sale, Authorization, Void Sale, etc.

attributes.name: AuthorizationRequestResponseCode
attributes.documentation: The code that indicates whether the transaction is approved or declined.  If declined, it will indicate why it was declined.

attributes.name: PlasticTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of plastic card medium used, e.g., credit card, gift card, etc.

attributes.name: AdjustmentTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code identifying the type of change to a previous transaction.

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.documentation: Determines if this record is primary communication means.

attributes.name: ProcessingProgramName
attributes.documentation: The name of a source processing program; i.e., the name of a Fiscal Service program that first processes a transaction.

attributes.name: ProcessingSubprogramName
attributes.documentation: The name of a subprogram or component of a source processing program.

attributes.name: ProcurementInstrumentIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for each contract, agreement or order.

attributes.name: ProcurementModificationNumber
attributes.documentation: An identifier issued by an agency that uniquely identifies one modification for one contract, agreement, order, etc.

attributes.name: ProcurementTransactionNumber
attributes.documentation: Tie Breaker for legal, unique transactions that would otherwise have the same key.

attributes.name: ProcurementSolicitationIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Identifier used to link transactions in FPDS-NG to solicitation information.

attributes.name: ProcurementAgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: This is a code for a governmental agency, but it does not necessarily represent the agency that issued the contract. Instead, it serves only as part of the unique identification for Federal Procurement Data System awards records.

attributes.name: ContractingOfficeProcurementAgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: A code for the governmental agency or bureau that executed or is otherwise responsible for the transaction.

attributes.name: IDV_ProcurementInstrumentIdentifier
attributes.documentation: When reporting orders under Indefinite Delivery Vehicles (IDV) such as a GWAC, IDC, FSS, BOA, or BPA, report the Procurement Instrument Identifier (Contract Number or Agreement Number) of the IDV. For the initial load of a BPA under a FSS, this is the FSS contract number. Note: BOAs and BPAs are with industry and not with other Federal Agencies.

attributes.name: IDV_ProcurementAgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: This is a code for an agency, but it does not necessarily represent the agency that issued the contract. Instead, it serves as part of the unique identification for Federal Procurement Data System IDV records. For awards records, it partially identifies a linked IDV record.

attributes.name: BillAccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The account number that links the instance of a bill to a user. Account numbers control which bills a user can view, update, and pay.

attributes.name: BillDate
attributes.documentation: The date a bill instance is created for an Agency cash flow.

attributes.name: CorrespondenceCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of correspondance documents.

attributes.name: FormRevisionFileName
attributes.documentation: The name that identifies the version of the form used for the transaction.

attributes.name: PageCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of pages for all documents.

attributes.name: RemittanceIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifer for the remittance document provided.

attributes.name: RemittanceName
attributes.documentation: The name of the remittance document provided.

attributes.name: UserDataCount
attributes.documentation: The count of User Data occurrences for a specific remittance.

attributes.name: ProgramTraceIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier a financial agent provides to support traceability throughout a collection lifecycle.

attributes.name: PublicMoneySymbolNumber
attributes.documentation: An 8-digit number used to identify bank activity reported by commercial banks, Federal Reserve Banks (FRBs) and Treasury offices.  The activity represents deposits of tax collections, customs duties, miscellaneous receipts, public debt receipts, other revenues, Treasury checks paid, etc.

attributes.name: ReasonCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the reason for an exception transaction.

attributes.name: ReasonText
attributes.documentation: The descriptive reason for an exception transaction.

attributes.name: ReceiptMechanismCode
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the format of a financial instrument when a collections channel program receives it.

attributes.name: ReceiptsFromDate
attributes.documentation: The starting date of one or more collections summarized into a voucher.

attributes.name: ReceiptsToDate
attributes.documentation: The ending date of one or more collections summarized into a voucher.

attributes.name: RecurringIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the item is a recurring transaction.

attributes.name: ReferenceCode
attributes.documentation: The reference code for the data record.

attributes.name: ReferenceIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The reference identifier for the data record.

attributes.name: ReferenceName
attributes.documentation: The reference name for a data record.

attributes.name: ReferenceNumber
attributes.documentation: A reference number for a data record.

attributes.name: ReporterIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The Identifier of the person or entity submitting the transaction to the channel application.

attributes.name: ReportingBusinessLineCode
attributes.documentation: The business line of the program that processes the transaction (as opposed to the business line of a transaction's content, which is not always the same).

attributes.name: ReportingSubprogramName
attributes.documentation: The name of a subprogram or component of a reporting program.

attributes.name: SummariesTimestamp
attributes.documentation: The date and time of the ReportingSummaries container.

attributes.name: SummaryAccountingDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates a specific date related to a business line within a Reported Summaries container.

attributes.name: ScheduleNumber
attributes.documentation: The schedule number assigned by the agency to identify this set of payments .

attributes.name: FederalProgramAgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: This is an organizational identifier to identify agency payment offices

attributes.name: IsExpeditedHandling
attributes.documentation: Indicator used to request expedited handling of the Payments in the Schedule.

attributes.name: RequestedPaymentDate
attributes.documentation: Requested date of payment for this schedule.

attributes.name: EIN
attributes.documentation: An Employer Identification Number (EIN) is also known as a federal tax identification number, and is used to identify a business entity.

attributes.name: ACH_AgencyText
attributes.documentation: Used to identify the agency responsible for the payments.

attributes.name: CheckScheduleEnclosureCode
attributes.documentation: Code denoting special name, address, and stub characteristics of a check payment.  It is also used to denote a foreign payment.

attributes.name: GarnishmentIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether all the payments are eligible for garnishment with a value of '1'.  If not eligible, then the value is '0'.

attributes.name: SecondaryProcessingProgramName
attributes.documentation: The name of an additional processing program; i.e., the name of a Fiscal Service program that is involved in processing a transaction.

attributes.name: SecondaryProcessingSubprogramName
attributes.documentation: The name of a subprogram or component of an additional processing program.

attributes.name: SequenceNumber
attributes.documentation: The number of the item in reference to a sequential number of items.

attributes.name: ServicedALC
attributes.documentation: The Agency Location Code (ALC) of the agency that receives services from another agency.

attributes.name: ServicingALC
attributes.documentation: The Agency Location Code (ALC) of the agency that provides services to another agency.

attributes.name: SettlementMechanismCode
attributes.documentation: The mechanism by which a financial institution settles a transaction.

attributes.name: SettlementReceiptDate
attributes.documentation: The date that a settlement gateway or provider receives financial data for processing.

attributes.name: SubAccountRoutingNumber
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) used to segregate transaction activity, that is reported directly to the Treasury Master Account, to accommodate reporting and operational needs.  It is also referred to as a SubAccount Customer Identification Number (CIN) by the Federal Reserve or as a Tier 2 RTN by Treasury.

attributes.name: SummarizedDetailCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of financial transactions represented by a summary.

attributes.name: SummaryType
attributes.documentation: The type of summary record.

attributes.name: IsDepositTicket
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether this record is a deposit ticket or debit voucher.

attributes.name: IsChannelElectronic
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the Fiscal Service program received the transactions electronically.

attributes.name: Deferred1DayAmount
attributes.documentation: A decimal value representing the amount of the deposit that is deferred for one day.

attributes.name: Deferred2DayAmount
attributes.documentation: A decimal value representing the amount of the deposit that is deferred for two days.

attributes.name: ImmediateAmount
attributes.documentation: The deposit amount that is immediately available for cash concentration into the Treasury General Account.

attributes.name: SummaryDate
attributes.documentation: The date for the summary record.  The date that is represented can vary depending on the value of Summary Type.  For example, if the Summary Type value is 'Voucher', then this date would represent the Voucher Date.  If the Summary Type value is 'Transfer', then this date would represent the Transfer Date.

attributes.name: SummaryNumber
attributes.documentation: The number of the summary record, for example the deposit ticket number or the debit voucher number.

attributes.name: BusinessIdentifierCode
attributes.documentation: The Business Identifier Code (BIC) is an established international standard (ISO 9362).  It provides an identifier for institutions within the financial services industry to facilitate automated processing of telecommunication messages in banking and related financial transaction environments.

attributes.name: BusinessEntityCode
attributes.documentation: The Business Entity Identifier (BEI) is an extension of the ISO 9362 standard.  It provides an identifier for non financial institutions to facilitate automated processing of telecommunication messages in banking and related financial transaction environments.

attributes.name: FiscalServiceTaxSubClassCode
attributes.documentation: The subclass within a class of tax transactions, as defined by the Fiscal Service.

attributes.name: FiscalServiceTaxClassCode
attributes.documentation: The classification of a tax transaction, as defined by the Fiscal Service.

attributes.name: NAICS_Code
attributes.documentation: The code that the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) uses to classify business establishments for the purpose of collecting, analyzing, and publishing statistical data on the U.S. economy.

attributes.name: TaxBusinessCount
attributes.documentation: The total count of tax business items associated with a Tax Breakdown.

attributes.name: TaxPayerTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The type of entity remitting or receiving a tax payment.

attributes.name: TaxTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The four-digit code defined by the IRS that corresponds to an IRS form number.

attributes.name: TaxSubTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The single alpha-numeric character defined by the IRS that reflects a reason for the tax payment.

attributes.name: TaxBreakdownCount
attributes.documentation: The total count of Tax Breakdown items.

attributes.name: IsTax
attributes.documentation: Indicates if the item is a tax transaction.

attributes.name: IsTOP_Offset
attributes.documentation: Indicates the payment eligibility of the payment offset.

attributes.name: EligibleForOffsetAmount
attributes.documentation: Indicates the amount of the payment that is eligible for offset.  This is sent to TOP for offsetting purposes.

attributes.name: TotalAmount
attributes.documentation: The total absolute dollar amount of items.

attributes.name: TotalCount
attributes.documentation: The total number of items.

attributes.name: IsProgramData
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether this record is program data.

attributes.name: CollectionStatusCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies the status of a transaction; i.e., where it is in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: CollectionTransactionType
attributes.documentation: Standard transaction types which represent a high-level categorization of a financial transaction that is used to help identify what type of transaction activity the financial transaction represents.

attributes.name: BatchDate
attributes.documentation: The date for the batch.
