attributes.name: BatchNumber
attributes.documentation: Container to further identify this batch record, for example, the Cash Link Account Number or LockBox Number.

attributes.name: TransferAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount of funds (to be) transferred between a deposit account at an agent or depositary and a routing number (RTN) that the Federal Reserve maintains for Treasury.

attributes.name: DepositaryDetailAccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The account number from which the funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury general Account (TGA).

attributes.name: DepositaryDetailRoutingNumber
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) from which the funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury general Account (TGA).

attributes.name: ExpectedFundsAvailabilityDate
attributes.documentation: The date that deposited funds are expected to be available for immediate disbursement or withdrawal.

attributes.name: TransferDate
attributes.documentation: The banking date that funds are transferred into or out of the Treasury Generanl Account (TGA).

attributes.name: TransferDetailCount
attributes.documentation: The count of Transfer Detail occurrences for a specific Transfer Summary.

attributes.name: DepositaryDetailMechanismCode
attributes.documentation: The mechanism by which funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury General Account (TGA).

attributes.name: SummaryTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The code that denotes the type of summary record.

attributes.name: TransferSummaryIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for a Transfer Summary.

attributes.name: EchoID
attributes.documentation: Identifies the unique original Transmission message level identifier.

attributes.name: TransmissionTimestamp
attributes.documentation: The date and time of a transmission.

attributes.name: Sub-levelPrefixCode
attributes.documentation: When populated, represents a programmatic breakdown of the account for Treasury publication purposes.

attributes.name: AllocationTransferAgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the agency receiving funds through an allocation transfer.

attributes.name: BeginningPeriodOfAvailability
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the first year of availability under law that an account may incur new obligations, in annual and multiyear accounts.

attributes.name: EndingPeriodOfAvailability
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the last year of availability under law that an account may incur new obligations, in annual and multiyear accounts.

attributes.name: AvailabilityTypeCode
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies no-year accounts (X), clearing/suspense accounts (F), Treasury central summary general ledger accounts (A), and merged-surplus accounts (M).

attributes.name: ATB_AvailabilityTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies no-year accounts (X), clearing/suspense accounts (F), Treasury central summary general ledger accounts (A), and merged-surplus accounts (M).  This data element adds a 'C' data type required for adjusted trial balance (ATB) reporting of canceled TAS assets.

attributes.name: MainAccountCode
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that represents the type and purpose of the fund.

attributes.name: Sub-accountCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies an available receipt or other Treasury-defined subdivision of the main account.

attributes.name: TreasuryAccountSymbolText
attributes.documentation: Contains the concatenated version of the Treasury Account Symbol.

attributes.name: AccountSymbolText
attributes.documentation: Treasury Account Symbol (i.e., "string TAS")

attributes.name: AccountSymbolName
attributes.documentation: The full name of the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS).

attributes.name: AccountSymbolStartDate
attributes.documentation: The date the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) was created.

attributes.name: AccountSymbolEndDate
attributes.documentation: The date the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) was inactivated.

attributes.name: IsValidAccountSymbol
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether or not a Treasury Account is considered valid. Valid accounts are active and pass all classification rules.

attributes.name: AccountSymbolEvaluatedDate
attributes.documentation: Denotes the date on which the IsValidAccountSymbol value last changed.

attributes.name: TAS_AccountTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Establishes the characteristics for the use of a Treasury account and includes primarily the Receipt and Expenditure accounts.

attributes.name: AccountTypeDescription
attributes.documentation: The description for the code that establishes the characteristics for the use of a Treasury account and includes primarily the Receipt and Expenditure accounts.

attributes.name: FundTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Establishes how the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) will be funded.

attributes.name: FundTypeDescription
attributes.documentation: The description for the code that establishes how the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) will be funded.

attributes.name: PaymentTypeB_Code
attributes.documentation: Type B Schedule Payment Type Code. (This attribute is deprecated and may no longer be used in versions after GWA Reporter conversion is complete.)

attributes.name: UnstructuredDataIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the value element contains unstructured content.

attributes.name: UpdateIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an item is an original transaction or an update.

attributes.name: CorrectiveTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates that the transaction represents a corrective action to a previously reported transaction and categorizes the type of correction action.

attributes.name: UserDataFieldIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the user data field, which corresponds to the number of the user data field within a channel application.

attributes.name: UserDataFieldLabel
attributes.documentation: The label an agency provides that describes what the UserDataField element contains.  For example: "Claim Number" or "Name."

attributes.name: ReportingPeriod
attributes.documentation: Designates the month for which the data is being submitted. This is is a 2 digit numer that starts with 01 for October and goes through 12 for September.

attributes.name: USSGL_AccountNumber
attributes.documentation: A six-digit number used to identify a specific U.S. Standard General Ledger account.  The USSGL account must be in the USSGL chart of accounts.

attributes.name: BeginEndIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the balance or an USSGL account/attribute combination is at the start of the fiscal year or at the end of a period.

attributes.name: AuthorityTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Distinguishes among the types of budgetary resources, where it is not possible to do so by the USSGL Account Number Code. For example, the USSGL rescission accounts (USSGL accounts 4392 and 4393) do not distinguish between rescissions of appropriations or contract authority.

attributes.name: ReimbursableFlagIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether amounts for goods, services, and joint project support are financed by offsetting collections.

attributes.name: ApportionmentCategoryCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies OMB apportionments by quarters (Category A) or by other specified time periods, programs, activities, projects, objects, or combinations of these (Category B), or are not subject to apportionment (Category E).

attributes.name: ApportionmentCategoryB_ProgramCode
attributes.documentation: The code representing the category A/B and B program used on the SF 132 apportionment schedule. Apportionment Category B Program Code is the four digit number from 6011-6159 that represents a line on the apportionment schedule. The category B program code is required if the apportionment category is A/B or B. Category B programs are subject to the Anti-Deficiency Act.

attributes.name: ProgramReportCategoryCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies a program report category that agencies use when reporting their obligations in their detailed financial information. Agencies may use this code when reporting either Category A or Category B obligations. Unlike the Apportionment Category B Program, this code is NOT subject to the Anti-Deficiency Act.

attributes.name: FederalNonFederalCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates the type of entity involved in transactions with the reporting entity: other Federal entities (F); non-Federal entities such as private/local/state/tribal/foreign governments (N), exceptions for other non-Federal partners (E), or General Fund only, G.

attributes.name: TradingPartnerAgencyIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Represents the agency identifier of the other department, agency, or establishment of the U. S. government involved in transactions with the reporting entity. Required if the Fed/Non-Federal Indicator = F or G.

attributes.name: TradingPartnerMainAccountCode
attributes.documentation: Represents the treasury main account code of the other department, agency, or establishment of the U. S. Government involved in transactions with the reporting entity. Required if the Fed/Non-Federal Indicator = F.

attributes.name: YearOfBudgetAuthorityIndicator
attributes.documentation: Identifies whether outlays are from the new budget authority (NEW) or from budget authority carried forward from the prior year (BAL). Used for expenditure TAS that are not credit financing TAS.

attributes.name: AvailabilityTimeIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether a budgetary resource is available for new obligations in the current period, or in a subsequent period within the current fiscal year or after being reapportioned in a future fiscal year.

attributes.name: BEA_CategoryCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the Budget Enforcement Act (BEA) category is mandatory or discretionary.

attributes.name: BEA_CategoryIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the Budget Enforcement Act (BEA) category is mandatory, discretionary, Government, net interest, or split.

attributes.name: BorrowingSourceCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether borrowing took place from the public, Treasury, or a Federal financing bank.

attributes.name: ExchangeNonExchangeCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the revenue, gains or losses balances being reported is exchange (X), nonexchange (T) or (E) exchange revenue with little or no associated costs.

attributes.name: CustodialNonCustodialIndicator
attributes.documentation: Custodial amounts are reported on the Statement of Custodial Activity (SCA) or on the custodial footnote. Noncustodial amounts are not reported on the SCA nor on the custodial footnote.

attributes.name: BudgetaryImpactIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether financing resources and non-exchange revenue have an impact on the budget.

attributes.name: PriorYearAdjustmentCode
attributes.documentation: Changes to obligated or unobligated balances that occurred in the previous fiscal year but were not recorded in the appropriate TAFS as of October 1 of the current fiscal year. Exclude upward and downward adjustments to current-year/prior-year obligations and most reclassifications from clearing accounts.

attributes.name: CreditCohortYear
attributes.documentation: Fiscal year when direct loans are obligated or guarantees committed by a program, even if disbursements occur in subsequent fiscal years.

attributes.name: ProgramIndicator
attributes.documentation: The amount of cost or revenue directly or indirectly traceable to programs

attributes.name: NormalBalanceIndicator
attributes.documentation: Normal condition of the balance in an USSGL account (debit or credit).

attributes.name: BudgetaryProprietaryCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates if a USSGL account is reported on a budgetary, proprietary statement or both. For example USSGL account 101000 Fund Balance With Treasury is reported on the Balance Sheet and the FMS 2108. USSGL account 101000 domain value will be B.

attributes.name: AnticipatedIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates that the transaction is expected or antipated to occur in the current fiscal year.

attributes.name: GTAS_FundTypeCode
attributes.documentation: A classification established in law that describes an OMB account's relationship to the Government, and the source of the receipts that the account is provided. The first digit (and sometimes second digit, as well) of the Treasury Account Main Code is also used to designate fund category (ITFM 2-1500).

attributes.name: TAS_StatusCode
attributes.documentation: Expired - time period the budget authority is no longer available for new obligations but is still available for disbursement. Unexpired - time period the budget authority is available for incurring "new" obligations. Annual budget authority lasts for up to one fiscal year. Multi-year authority lasts for longer periods. No-year authority last indefinitely. Canceled - time period after the last expired year, the account is closed, and the balances are canceled. The authority to disburse is canceled and is no longer available for any purpose.

attributes.name: FinancingAccountCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the Federal account symbol is a Direct Loan Financing Account, a Guaranteed Loan Financing Account, or is not a financing account as defined by the Federal Credit Reform Act of 1990.

attributes.name: TAS_StatusTransitioningCode
attributes.documentation: Expiring - Applies to annual and multi year accounts only. TAS Status Transitioning Flag is set to expiring in period 12 of the ending year of availability. Canceling - Applies to annual, multi and no-year accounts. For annual and multi year accounts, the TAS Status Transitioning Flag is set to cancelling in period 12 of the 5th expired year. For no-year accounts, the TAS Status Transitioning Flag is set to cancelling when the account has been discontinued.

attributes.name: FinancialReceiptCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates at the Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) level activity related to non-Federal ownership interest or statutory dedication of specifically identified revenues to designated activities.

attributes.name: TAS_AccountType
attributes.documentation: Indicates what type of account the TAS is.

attributes.name: AppropriationFlagCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates if the TAS appropriation is definite or indefinite.

attributes.name: AuthorityDurationCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether a TAS is an annual year account (A), multiyear account (M), receipt account (R), clearing/suspense account (F), no-year account (X), or canceled account (C).

attributes.name: FMS_OrganizationCode
attributes.documentation: Fiscal Service and FPAs maintain and use the current two-digit distribution codes to group Treasury Account Symbols (TAS) by bureaus, according to congressional legislation and, in some instances, programs below the bureau level. The new Fiscal Service Org Code will serve the same purpose as distribution codes. Fiscal Service will establish a Fiscal Service Org Code if a Government organization is designated as a bureau in enacted legislation

attributes.name: BudgetAccountCode
attributes.documentation: A budget account generally covers an organized set of activities, programs, or services directed toward a common purpose or goal. Used in conjunction with the Agency Identifier and the Budget Bureau Code, uniquely represents a budget account, which is an administrative or functional subdivision of an agency and sometimes a budget bureau.  This is generally the same code as the Main Account code shown as part of the TAS unless it represents a consolidated account (more than on TAS).

attributes.name: BudgetSubfunctionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: OMB assigns each expenditure and offsetting receipt account a three-digit code that corresponds to the account's sub-functional classification (e.g., national defense, income security, agriculture).  Annually, OMB consults with CBO and other relevant budget and appropriation committee staff members regarding functional and sub-functional classification. This process, which is required by statute, typically occurs from October through December.

attributes.name: Chapter
attributes.documentation: Chapter used in the Treasury Combined Statement to represent a reporting agency.

attributes.name: ExtendedDisbursingAuthorityYear
attributes.documentation: Indicates the year beyond the 5th expired year that the TAS legally can disburse funds.  If no Extended Disbursing Authority, this field should be blank (four blanks/spaces).

attributes.name: FundBalanceWithTreasuryAmount
attributes.documentation: Amount representing the pre-closing undisbursed or unexpended balance as of the month-end. This amount will agree with the ending balance shown on the GWA Account Statement for the corresponding period and year. It should also agree with the Fund Balance with Treasury, prior to posting closing entries. Note: The FACTS II calls this the "Undisbursed Balance" while the printed version of the Fiscal Service Form 2108 calls this amount the "Pre-closing Unexpended Balance".

attributes.name: NetOutlaysAmount
attributes.documentation: The amount representing the net of collections and disbursements reported to date for the current fiscal year for the TAS.

attributes.name: ReportingTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates at the TAS level activity related to non-Federal ownership interest or statutory dedication of specifically identified revenues to designated activities.

attributes.name: FirstYearIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether or not the current year is the first year of the TAS.

attributes.name: FinancialReportEntityCode
attributes.documentation: The Reporting Entity Code identifies a Government entity for financial statement purposes. It captures all of the Treasury Account Symbols that are reported for that entity's financial statements.

attributes.name: BackdatedTransactionIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether or not a transaction has been backdated to a previous fiscal year in Treasury's Central Accounting System.

attributes.name: BorrowingAuthorityFromTreasuryCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the TAS has the authority to borrow from Treasury.  Borrowing authority from Treasury is a form of budget authority provided in law that authorizes obligations and outlays to be financed by borrowing from the Treasury.

attributes.name: BorrowingAuthorityFromPublicCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the TAS has the authority to borrow from the public.  Borrowing authority from the public is a form of budget authority provided in law that authorizes obligations and outlays to be financed by borrowing from the Public.

attributes.name: ContractAuthorityCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the TAS has contract authority. Contract authority is a form of budget authority provided in authorizing laws that permit a TAS to incur obligations in advance of an appropriation, offsetting collections or receipts that will be used to liquidate the obligations.

attributes.name: CertifyCount
attributes.documentation: Indicates the number of times an ATB has been certified. The number of times increases with each replacement ATB submitted and certified.

attributes.name: DebitCreditIndicator
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the balance reported is a debit or credit.

attributes.name: AgentCommentText
attributes.documentation: The comments that an agent or depositary associates with processing.

attributes.name: CoinCurrencyTotalAmount
attributes.documentation: The total value of coins contained within a deposit.

attributes.name: CurrencyTotalAmount
attributes.documentation: The total value of coin and paper currency contained within a deposit.

attributes.name: PartialIndicator
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the details associated represent a partial summarization.

attributes.name: ServicedALC
attributes.documentation: The Agency Location Code (ALC) of the agency that receives services from another agency.

attributes.name: VoucherHandlingCode
attributes.documentation: The code that denotes how the voucher information should be handled in downstream reporting.

attributes.name: VoucherDate
attributes.documentation: The date that a depositary or agent uses for Fiscal Service reconciliation.

attributes.name: VoucherFormCode
attributes.documentation: The type of voucher record, e.g., 215, 215A, 5515.

attributes.name: VoucherIdentifier
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for a voucher.

attributes.name: RTN
attributes.documentation: The routing number is used synonymously as ABA routing number and routing transit number.  The routing number consists of 9 digits, for example XXXXYYYYC where XXXX is Federal Reserve Routing Symbol, YYYY is ABA Institution Identifier, and C is the Check Digit.  The first two digits of the nine digit routing number must be in the ranges 00 through 12, 21 through 32, 61 through 72, or 80.  The digits are assigned as follows: 00 is used by the United States Government; 01 through 12 are the normal routing numbers; 21 through 32 were assigned only to thrift institutions (e.g. credit unions and savings banks) through 1985, currently are still used by the thrift institutions, or their successors; 61 through 72 are used for electronic transactions; 80 is used for traveler's checks.  The first two digits correspond to the 12 Federal Reserve Banks.  [reference: http://www.tfp.com/text/aba_policy.pdf]

attributes.name: AcctbBusLnCd
attributes.documentation: The business line of a transaction's content (as opposed to the business line of the program that processes the transaction, which is not always the same).

attributes.name: TaxClsCd
attributes.documentation: The classification code that represents a category of a tax transaction, as specifically defined by the IRS.

attributes.name: ACH_TypCd
attributes.documentation: The code thatidentifies the general categorization for the type of ACH transaction, e.g., credit, debit, prenote, etc.

attributes.name: ACH_CoDescDtTxt
attributes.documentation: The date an originator establishes to describe a transaction, e.g., invoice date or due date.

attributes.name: CoDscnyDtaTxt
attributes.documentation: The reference information an originator includes to enable specialized handling of the entry.

attributes.name: DscnyDtaCd
attributes.documentation: The code that an originator includes to enable specialized handling of the entry.

attributes.name: OrgntrStatCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies whether an originator is bound by certain ACH rules.

attributes.name: EntyDtlSeqNr
attributes.documentation: The ascending sequence number section of the Entry Detail or Corporate Entry Detail Record's trace number. This number is the same as the last seven digits of the trace number of the related Entry Detail Record or Corporate Entry Detail Record.

attributes.name: AddnTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code identifying the specific interpretation and format of the addendum information contained in the same record.

attributes.name: ACH_PmtRelatInfoTxt
attributes.documentation: The additional information an originator supplies about ACH entry detail records.  This term is a standard field in an ACH item and its use is not limited to disbursements.

attributes.name: AddrTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of address, e.g., shipping or billing.

attributes.name: CtyNm
attributes.documentation: The name of the city.

attributes.name: PostalCd
attributes.documentation: The 5-digit (ZIP) code that geographically identifies individual Post Offices or metropolitan area delivery stations associated with every mailing address.

attributes.name: PostalCdExt
attributes.documentation: The 4-digit code (ZIP+4) addition to a postal code that identifies a specific range of delivery addresses.

attributes.name: FrgnPostalCd
attributes.documentation: The code added to a foreign address line, typically for the purpose of sorting mail.

attributes.name: StateName
attributes.documentation: Territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation.

attributes.name: StCd
attributes.documentation: The US state code and Canadian province code.

attributes.name: StateCodeText
attributes.documentation: Region codes or province codes (an example of US state codes are here: http://www.usps.com/ncsc/lookups/usps_abbreviations.html).

attributes.name: RgnNm
attributes.documentation: The foreign state, territory, or province name.

attributes.name: CountryName
attributes.documentation: Contains the name of a country.

attributes.name: CntryCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies a country.

attributes.name: CountryCodeText
attributes.documentation: Contains the textual representation for the code for a country.

attributes.name: CnsulrCd
attributes.documentation: The predefined code used between Treasury and USPS for mailing bulk check shipments to non-US countries via the consulate.

attributes.name: PostNetBrcdDelPnt
attributes.documentation: The PostNet barcode that is applied to the check for obtaining postage discounts.

attributes.name: USPS_IntelMlBarCd
attributes.documentation: The field used for all intelligent barcode data elements. An agency must work with their Treasury payment servicing center and the US Postal Service to arrange for this service.

attributes.name: AgcyBillNm
attributes.documentation: The name an agency assigns to an agency bill or invoice.

attributes.name: AgcyCmtTxt
attributes.documentation: The comments an agency associates with processing.

attributes.name: AgcyFormNm
attributes.documentation: The name an agency assigns to an agency form.

attributes.name: AgcyFormNr
attributes.documentation: The number an agency assigns to an agency form.

attributes.name: AgcyID
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the department, agency or establishment of the U.S. Government that is responsible for the TAS.  Agency Identifier is also used apart from the TAS to identify a major department or independent agency of the Federal government.

attributes.name: ALC
attributes.documentation: The identifier for an accounting office within an agency that reports disbursements and collections to Treasury.

attributes.name: OfcLocCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies an agency location more specifically than an Agency Location Code.

attributes.name: AgcySiteID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the agency site that processes a transaction.

attributes.name: AgcySiteNm
attributes.documentation: The name of the agency site that processes a transaction.

attributes.name: AgtBnkAcctNr
attributes.documentation: The account number of a deposit account at a financial agent or depositary that the bank uses for transactions involving public money.

attributes.name: AgtRTN
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) associated with an agent or depositary.

attributes.name: Amt
attributes.documentation: The transaction amount.

attributes.name: BnkAcctNr
attributes.documentation: The account number for the financial institution involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: BnkAcctTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of account associated with the transaction, such as checking or savings.

attributes.name: TransferMechanismCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates the financial instrument used to concentrate funds into the Treasury's General Account.

attributes.name: DFI_AccountNumber
attributes.documentation: The account number of the payment recipient at the receiving bank.

attributes.name: BeneficiaryIdentifier
attributes.documentation: An ISO identification code for both financial and non-financial institutions that is used when transferring money, particularly for international wire transfers.  It is also used for the exchange of non-monetary messages.

attributes.name: BankName
attributes.documentation: The name of the financial institution.

attributes.name: BurNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a bureau.

attributes.name: BETC
attributes.documentation: Identifies the type of activity (gross disbursement, offsetting collection, investment in Treasury securities, etc.) and the effect of a transaction on the Fund Balance With Treasury (FBWT).  Is used in combination with the Treasury Account Symbol to classify transactions reported to Treasury through all Governmentwide Accounting (GWA-compliant) financial management systems.

attributes.name: BusEvnTypNm
attributes.documentation: The name associated with a Business Event Type Code value.

attributes.name: ChannelBatchIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Identifies the input batch in which the transaction was reported to the channel application.

attributes.name: CshFlwID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a class of agency transactions that share the same purpose, assigned on a program-specific basis. For example, collections associated with an agency form constitute a cash flow.

attributes.name: CshFlwNm
attributes.documentation: The name for the class of agency transactions that share the same purpose, assigned on a program-specific basis. For example, collections associated with an agency form constitute a cash flow.

attributes.name: ChnlInitnDt
attributes.documentation: The date that the public or an agency (on behalf of a public remitter or as a remitter itself) initiates or sends a transaction to an agent or depositary.

attributes.name: ChnlRcptDt
attributes.documentation: The date that an agent or depositary receives a transaction.

attributes.name: ChnlTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the channel through which an agent or depositary receives a transaction.

attributes.name: ChkTrcNr
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for traceability within Check21 processing.

attributes.name: ChkSerNr
attributes.documentation: The serial number of a check; i.e., the number that typically resides in the top right-hand corner of a check.

attributes.name: ChkTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of check, e.g., personal, business, money order, etc.

attributes.name: IsCheckElectronic
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether the check was settled electronically via image or non-electronically via paper.

attributes.name: ProcgMthdCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies whether a check is presented by a check writer who is present at the agency location.

attributes.name: RsrhRqrdInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the transaction has been flagged for research.

attributes.name: MICR_Unprsd
attributes.documentation: The Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) information from a check, captured as a single string.

attributes.name: CkeyNm
attributes.documentation: The name associated with a Classification Key (C-Key) value. For example, the C-Key Name could be 'Tax Class', and the C-Key Values could be '01', '02', etc.

attributes.name: CkeyVal
attributes.documentation: The value associated with a Classification Key (C-Key) name. For example, the C-Key Name could be 'Tax Class', and the C-Key Values could be '01', '02', etc.

attributes.name: Code
attributes.documentation: The transaction code, for example, indicates the standard entry class codes in an ACH transaction.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.documentation: The type of transaction, for example, indicates the Fedwire type for this record.

attributes.name: CAN
attributes.documentation: The six-digit identifier representing a Central Accounts Receivable System (CARS) account profile that includes a legacy CA$HLINK account type, routing number (RTN), deposit account, deposit funds availability, and cost code information, as well as potentially other factors.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a business transaction.

attributes.name: CollTxnTyp
attributes.documentation: The high-level categorization that identifies the type of transaction activity the financial transaction represents.

attributes.name: IptBtchID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a batch of transactions received by a program.

attributes.name: InstlmInstncNr
attributes.documentation: The number denoting a particular installment within a series of installments.

attributes.name: IP_Addr
attributes.documentation: The Internet protocol (IP) address associated with a transaction.

attributes.name: IntragovInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether a payer and payee in a transaction are both federal government entities.

attributes.name: NOC_UpdtRsltTxt
attributes.documentation: The result of a notification of change (NOC) request against, for example, a payer profile.

attributes.name: RecrFreqCd
attributes.documentation: The frequency of a recurring collection.

attributes.name: RmtnCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of remittance documents.

attributes.name: TotInstlmCnt
attributes.documentation: The total count of installments in a related series of installments.

attributes.name: AgtBnkNm
attributes.documentation: The name of the agent or depositary.

attributes.name: BnkBrnchID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a financial institution branch.

attributes.name: BulkPrvrNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a payroll provider that makes tax payments through an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) compatible system.

attributes.name: ChnID
attributes.documentation: The identifier assigned to each account by a plastic card provider. Some agencies have more than one Chain to differentiate between major lines of business; ChainIdentifer is associated to DivisionIdentifier.

attributes.name: ChnlEInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the Fiscal Service program received the transactions electronically.

attributes.name: CollBusDt
attributes.documentation: The date that collections information is centralized in a data repository prior to subsequent reporting.

attributes.name: CollStatCd
attributes.documentation: The code that denotes the status of a transaction; i.e., where it is in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: DivID
attributes.documentation: The identifier assigned to each account by a plastic card provider that represents a deposit into the Collections Information Repository (CIR), when combined with a Chain.

attributes.name: InitProcgSiteID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for initial agent or depositary site that receives a transaction. For example, each lockbox processing site can have its own identifier.

attributes.name: LkbxAcctID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the lockbox activity received by a lockbox processing site.

attributes.name: MnlEntyInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an entry was captured through manual entry by an agent.

attributes.name: NonTreasCollCd
attributes.documentation: The identifier that indicates whether a collection is the responsibility of a non-governmental agency or a government agency that holds cash outside of Treasury.

attributes.name: RptPgmNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a reporting program; i.e., the name of a Fiscal Service program that reports transactions to a central repository.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the summary record. A receiving system can use this value to reconcile updates to an existing record and qualify new records. A sending system can use this value to reconcile acknowledgements for the submitted records.

attributes.name: InfoOnlyTxnCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of non-accountable transactions.

attributes.name: SumryTotInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether totals represent summarized or detailed transactions.

attributes.name: TotCrAmt
attributes.documentation: The total absolute dollar amount of credits.

attributes.name: TotCrCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of credit items.

attributes.name: TotDbtAmt
attributes.documentation: The total absolute dollar amount of debits.

attributes.name: TotDbtCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of debit items.

attributes.name: ComlBnkInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the item was settled through a commercial depositary.

attributes.name: CnfrmDt
attributes.documentation: The date that an agent or depositary electronically records or confirms a transaction.

attributes.name: CostCtrWrkUnitCd
attributes.documentation: The cost center work unit associated with FRB vouchers and transactions.

attributes.name: CUI_Ind
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether controlled unclassified information (CUI) is present, such as personally identifiable information (PII).

attributes.name: OrigCrncyCd
attributes.documentation: The code that defines the enumerated types of standard 3-letter ISO 4217 currency codes.

attributes.name: OrigCrncyCdTxt
attributes.documentation: The non-standard currency code.

attributes.name: DenominatorCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies the type of US currency.

attributes.name: ValueAmount
attributes.documentation: Represents the amount value of items of the specified denominator.

attributes.name: CrInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an item is a debit or credit.

attributes.name: BnkPostDt
attributes.documentation: The date that an agent or depositary credits or debits funds to or from a Treasury account (either a deposit account or routing number (RTN)).

attributes.name: DepDtlRTN
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) from which the funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury general Account (TGA).

attributes.name: DUNS_Number
attributes.documentation: The Dunn and Bradstreet Identification Number is a unique nine-character number that identifies an organization.

attributes.name: ElmtNm
attributes.documentation: The name which identifies the content of the data element.

attributes.name: EmlAddrTxt
attributes.documentation: The email address for the party involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: OrigAgcyTxnID
attributes.documentation: The Agency Transaction Identifier an agency assigned for the original transaction.

attributes.name: OrigBnkPostDt
attributes.documentation: The bank posting date associated with the original transaction.

attributes.name: OrigChnlTxnID
attributes.documentation: The identifier a channel assigned for the original transaction.

attributes.name: OrigSttlTxnID
attributes.documentation: The Settlement Transaction Identifier a settlement provider assigned for the original transaction.

attributes.name: OrigVchrDt
attributes.documentation: The voucher date of a voucher that a subsequent voucher adjusts, corrects, or rescinds.

attributes.name: OrigVchrID
attributes.documentation: The voucher identifier of a voucher that a subsequent voucher adjusts, corrects, or rescinds.

attributes.name: OrigVchrNr
attributes.documentation: The voucher number of a voucher that a subsequent voucher adjusts, corrects, or rescinds.

attributes.name: ExcptTypCd
attributes.documentation: The type of change to a previously reported transaction.

attributes.name: FwireTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code used to identify the type of Fedwire Message, e.g., funds transfer, foreign transfer, etc.

attributes.name: IMAD
attributes.documentation: The Input Messaging Accountability Data (IMAD) is a combination of a date, source identifier, and sequence number assigned to a Fedwire message when it is processed by the Federal Reserve Bank Funds Transfer application.

attributes.name: OMAD
attributes.documentation: The Output Messaging Accountability Data (OMAD) is a combination of a date, destination identifier, and sequence number assigned to a Fedwire message when it is processed by the Federal Reserve Bank Funds Transfer application.

attributes.name: FwireSubTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code used in combination with the FedwireType Code to identify the type of Fedwire Message.

attributes.name: BusFcnCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of business the message represents, e.g., bank transfer, drawdown response, etc.

attributes.name: OrigIMAD
attributes.documentation: The original Input Messaging Accountability Data (IMAD) associated with an earlier Fedwire Message, also known as 'Previous IMAD'.

attributes.name: IncmgTxnInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the Fedwire message represents a transaction received into the Treasury's Fedwire account or sent from the Treasury's Fedwire account.

attributes.name: BankText
attributes.documentation: The text supplied by the financial institution, in addition to the agency supplied text.

attributes.name: FundsAvailableDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the date the deposited funds can be immediately disbursed or otherwise withdrawn.

attributes.name: AgcyTxnID
attributes.documentation: The identifier an agency provides for a transaction.

attributes.name: SttlTxnID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a transaction within the settlement service.

attributes.name: ChnlTxnID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a transaction within the channel.

attributes.name: PayerMchsmCd
attributes.documentation: The payment medium for the transaction.

attributes.name: GatewayReceiptDate
attributes.documentation: Indicates the date that a settlement gateway or provider receives financial data for processing.

attributes.name: SttlStatCd
attributes.documentation: The settlement status code that identifies how the transaction was settled.

attributes.name: FY
attributes.documentation: Fiscal Year is a term that is used to differentiate a budget or financial year from the calendar year. The U.S. Government's Fiscal Year runs from October 1 of the prior year through September 30 of the next year. For example, FY 2006 was from October 2005 through September 2006; FY 2007 runs from October 2006 through September 2007, and; FY 2008 is from October 2007 through September 2008.

attributes.name: FclMth
attributes.documentation: The numbered month of a fiscal year, which does not necessarily match the calendar year.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the summary record. A receiving system can use this value to reconcile updates to an existing record and qualify new records. A sending system can use this value to reconcile acknowledgements for the submitted records.

attributes.name: ExchRte
attributes.documentation: The market price for which one currency can be exchanged for another.

attributes.name: ConvMthdCd
attributes.documentation: The code indicating how a foreign currency exchange was converted.

attributes.name: FrgnCrncyAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount of currency in a foreign denomination.

attributes.name: FRB_DistCd
attributes.documentation: The code denoting the general area of coverage for a Federal Reserve Bank. The Federal Reserve System assigns district codes.

attributes.name: FRB_OfcCd
attributes.documentation: The code denoting a particular Federal Reserve Bank location within a given Federal Reserve Bank district.

attributes.name: FRB_AcctKeyCd
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a program assigned within FRB CA$H-LINK, known within that system as an account key. The FRB CA$H-LINK account key is similar to the Collections Account Number (CAN), but is only used for financial activity involving Federal Reserve Banks.

attributes.name: CustomerAccountsReceivableSystemNumber
attributes.documentation: A CARS/Bank Management Service defined number identifying an account.

attributes.name: NonTreasuryFundCode
attributes.documentation: An identifier used to indicate whether funds are a non-governmental agency or a government agency that holds cash outside of Treasury.

attributes.name: IsCommercialBank
attributes.documentation: Indicates if the item was settled through a commercial depositary.

attributes.name: AgcyGrpID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a logical grouping of similar business units.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: An identifier for the record.  For a receiving system, this value can be used to reconcile updates to an existing record and qualify new records.  For a sending system, this value can be used to reconcile acknowledgements for the submitted records.

attributes.name: ChkImgTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies whether a check image is the front or back of the check.

attributes.name: ImgAddrID
attributes.documentation: The address that provides the unique location for the image content.

attributes.name: ImgLenNr
attributes.documentation: The size of an image in bytes.

attributes.name: ImgOffstNr
attributes.documentation: The starting point in bytes for a particular image within a batch.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for an image.

attributes.name: IptSysTxt
attributes.documentation: The sending trading partner that provides information to a receiving trading partner.

attributes.name: IRS_TaxInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an item is an IRS tax transaction.

attributes.name: LglTxnAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount that should have been reported on the original transaction.  For an encoded error, this amount equals the amount of the adjustment transaction plus the OriginalRecordedAmount.

attributes.name: MrchntNr
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier of the plastic card merchant, as assigned by the settlement provider.  For collections activities this identifier currently uniquely represents an Agency within the plastic card settlement provider.

attributes.name: MrchntCatCd
attributes.documentation: The code that designates the type of merchant business (food, department store, etc.) for a plastic card transaction.

attributes.name: MrchntStrNr
attributes.documentation: The nine digit number assigned by the plastic card settlement provider to identify a merchant's store.

attributes.name: FwireTagCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies a section within a Fedwire Message and briefly describes what the Fedwire transaction represents.

attributes.name: EOD_Ind
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether a file is considered the end-of-day file.

attributes.name: RunningDailyCount
attributes.documentation: A running total count for a given day. (A day is determined from the end of day indicator of the prior day to the current end of day.)

attributes.name: RunningDailyAmount
attributes.documentation: A cumulative absolute amount, including the items within a transmission, within a given day. (A day is determined from the end of day indicator of the prior day to the current end of day.)

attributes.name: VersionIdentifier
attributes.documentation: Indicates an identifier assigned to a version for this transmission.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for a transmission.

attributes.name: StdEntyClsCd
attributes.documentation: The code identifying the NACHA payment type.

attributes.name: EffEntyDt
attributes.documentation: The intended settlement date, as provided by the originator.

attributes.name: CoEntyDesc
attributes.documentation: The description detailing the purpose of the entry or transaction.

attributes.name: SvcClsCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies whether the ACH entries in the batch are debits, credits, or both.

attributes.name: AddnCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of addendum records associated with a transaction.

attributes.name: ACH_TxnCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies various types of debit and credit ACH transactions. Portions of the code value can also be used to identify the account type associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: ACH_TrcNr
attributes.documentation: The number used to identify an individual ACH entry within a batch.

attributes.name: ACH_OrigTrcNr
attributes.documentation: The Trace Number as originally included on the entry being returned or acknowledged, or on the Prenotification being rejected or corrected.

attributes.name: NonDomInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the entity or transaction is considered non domestic.

attributes.name: NonDomBnkInd
attributes.documentation: The identifier denoting whether the Fiscal Service considers an entity to be non-domestic.

attributes.name: NonDomCollInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the transaction associated with a collection is considered non domestic.

attributes.name: NSS_RefID
attributes.documentation: The reference information in a National Settlement Service (NSS) transfer entry that assists a receiver of the entry in understanding the reason for the transfer.

attributes.name: OMB_CtlNr
attributes.documentation: The number assigned by the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to uniquely identify a government form.

attributes.name: OrgNm
attributes.documentation: The official name by which an Organization Unit of the United States Federal Government is referred.  (Title of the Agency Location)

attributes.name: IntOrgCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the entity that manages resources below the agency and bureau level, such as an office or a division.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for a particular level within an organizational unit of the Federal Government.

attributes.name: OrigRecAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount originally recorded for the transaction.

attributes.name: OthScndryRTN
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) used to segregate transaction activity, that is reported to the Treasury's Master Account through a Subaccount RTN, to accommodate reporting and operational needs. It is also referred to as an Other Secondary Customer Identification Number (CIN) by the Federal Reserve or as a Tier 3 RTN by Treasury.

attributes.name: PtyID
attributes.documentation: The identification number for the party involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: PtyNm
attributes.documentation: The name of the party involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: PtyTypCd
attributes.documentation: The party type, e.g., individual, business or government.

attributes.name: MthYrExpirDt
attributes.documentation: Indicates the month/year value of a card's expiration date.

attributes.name: CrdNr
attributes.documentation: The credit card or debit card number.

attributes.name: MskdCrdNr
attributes.documentation: The masked credit card or debit card number.

attributes.name: CrdSctyCd
attributes.documentation: The 3 or 4 digit value printed on the card or signature strip but not available on the magnetic strip.

attributes.name: OrigIntchgCd
attributes.documentation: The code assigned by the plastic card service provider that provides the business type for the transaction.

attributes.name: IntchgCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of transaction that the interchange fee applies to and dictates the interchange fee amount applied to the transaction.

attributes.name: IntchgRembrsFeeAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount that the merchant must pay to the network carrier (i.e. Visa, MasterCard, AMEX, Discover) representing the true cost of a plastic card transaction.

attributes.name: IntchgRembrsFeeAmtSgnInd
attributes.documentation: The sign of the Interchange Reimbursement Fee Amount.

attributes.name: IntchgAdjResnCd
attributes.documentation: The one character code that defines why the surcharge, downgrade or adjustment was done.

attributes.name: IntchgAdjAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount over paid or under paid for each transaction based on the base qualification rate.  If the base rate is 1.43% + $0.05 and the transaction qualifies for a rate 1.85% + $0.05 this amount would be .42% of the transaction amount, indicating overpayment by .42% because the transaction did not qualify for the optimal rate.

attributes.name: IntchgAdjAmtSgnInd
attributes.documentation: The sign of the Interchange Adjustment Amount.

attributes.name: AuthChrsCd
attributes.documentation: The code that defines if the card was presented for authorization, whether the merchant name and location were provided, or what authorization was used when the card was not provided.

attributes.name: AuthCd
attributes.documentation: The code assigned by the plastic card issuer to identify the approval for a specific authorization request.

attributes.name: AuthSrcCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the authorization source for the card transaction, such as 'Automated Referral Service Response.'

attributes.name: AVS_RspCd
attributes.documentation: The Address Verification Service (AVS) response code is the code that the merchant received when processing the transaction that is related to the processing of the address information.

attributes.name: CrdPrdctTypCd
attributes.documentation: The three character code that provides information on the type of plastic card, valid only for Visa, Discover and MasterCard, e.g., 'MDG' refers to a Gold MasterCard Debit Card.

attributes.name: ClntBtchNr
attributes.documentation: The number which identifies the sequential position of a batch within a file.

attributes.name: CshBckAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount of money that is added to the total purchase price of a transaction (paid by debit card), which the customer receives in cash along with their goods.

attributes.name: CrdNtwrkTypCd
attributes.documentation: The type of network the plastic card used for a payment, e.g., VISA, MCRD, AMEX, etc.

attributes.name: CrdPrdctCd
attributes.documentation: The type of card used for the transaction, e.g., AX (American Express).

attributes.name: NtwrkRspCd
attributes.documentation: The code detailing the card provider's response, which is formatted based on the card network.

attributes.name: CrgbkRefNr
attributes.documentation: The network reference number related to the chargeback.

attributes.name: CrdRspCd
attributes.documentation: The code used for credit and gift cards that specifies how and if the card security code was processed.

attributes.name: CrgbkRecNr
attributes.documentation: The number assigned to any single customer transaction that is questioned, used to relate all disputes and subsequent records.

attributes.name: DrftLoctNr
attributes.documentation: The number associated with data matching, supplied by the customer.

attributes.name: CAT_Cd
attributes.documentation: The code that provides the type of Cardholder Activated Terminal (CAT) used in the transaction.

attributes.name: OrdID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for plastic card order-level data.

attributes.name: POS_EntyMde
attributes.documentation: The code that defines how the authorization for the card was read.  The first two positions refer to how the card was read and the third position refers to the capture of the PIN.

attributes.name: RgstrNr
attributes.documentation: The number which identifies the register where the plastic card transaction occurred.

attributes.name: StrPrsnID
attributes.documentation: The idenitifier, supplied by the merchant, that represents the person who originated the transaction.

attributes.name: TaxblAmt
attributes.documentation: The taxable amount of the transaction.

attributes.name: TrmNr
attributes.documentation: The number which identifies the terminal where the plastic card transaction occurred.

attributes.name: TxnTmZnCd
attributes.documentation: The code representing the time zone of the merchant. For example, 'EST' represents 'Eastern Standard Time'.

attributes.name: TxnTm
attributes.documentation: The date and time the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: ChnlCtffTm
attributes.documentation: The time that determines the end of a 24 hour day for plastic card payments, when a transaction will be sent for settlement, as defined by the agency.

attributes.name: CrdEvnTypCd
attributes.documentation: The event type of the plastic card transaction, e.g., Sale, Authorization, Void Sale, etc.

attributes.name: AuthRqstRspCd
attributes.documentation: The code that indicates whether the transaction is approved or declined.  If declined, it will indicate why it was declined.

attributes.name: PlstcTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the type of plastic card medium used, e.g., credit card, gift card, etc.

attributes.name: AdjTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code identifying the type of change to a previous transaction.

attributes.name: ProcgPgmNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a source processing program; i.e., the name of a Fiscal Service program that first processes a transaction.

attributes.name: ProcgSbprgNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a subprogram or component of a source processing program.

attributes.name: BillAcctNr
attributes.documentation: The account number that links the instance of a bill to a user. Account numbers control which bills a user can view, update, and pay.

attributes.name: BillDt
attributes.documentation: The date a bill instance is created for an Agency cash flow.

attributes.name: CrspdCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of correspondence documents.

attributes.name: FormRvsnFileNm
attributes.documentation: The name that identifies the version of the form used for the transaction.

attributes.name: PgCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of pages for all documents.

attributes.name: RmtnID
attributes.documentation: The identifer for the remittance document provided.

attributes.name: RmtnNm
attributes.documentation: The name of the remittance document provided.

attributes.name: UserDtaCnt
attributes.documentation: The count of User Data occurrences for a specific remittance.

attributes.name: PgmTrcID
attributes.documentation: The identifier a financial agent provides to support traceability throughout a collection lifecycle.

attributes.name: ResnCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the reason for an exception transaction.

attributes.name: ResnTxt
attributes.documentation: The descriptive reason for an exception transaction.

attributes.name: RcptMchsmCd
attributes.documentation: The code that identifies the format of a financial instrument when a collections channel program receives it.

attributes.name: RcptFromDt
attributes.documentation: The starting date of one or more collections summarized into a voucher.

attributes.name: RcptToDt
attributes.documentation: The ending date of one or more collections summarized into a voucher.

attributes.name: RecrInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the item is a recurring transaction.

attributes.name: RefID
attributes.documentation: The reference identifier for the data record.

attributes.name: RefNm
attributes.documentation: The reference name for a data record.

attributes.name: RefNr
attributes.documentation: A reference number for a data record.

attributes.name: RptrID
attributes.documentation: The Identifier of the person or entity submitting the transaction to the channel application.

attributes.name: RptBusLnCd
attributes.documentation: The business line of the program that processes the transaction (as opposed to the business line of a transaction's content, which is not always the same).

attributes.name: RptSbprgNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a subprogram or component of a reporting program.

attributes.name: ScndryProcgPgmNm
attributes.documentation: The name of an additional processing program; i.e., the name of a Fiscal Service program that is involved in processing a transaction.

attributes.name: ScndryProcgSbprgNm
attributes.documentation: The name of a subprogram or component of an additional processing program.

attributes.name: SeqNr
attributes.documentation: The number of the item in reference to a sequential number of items.

attributes.name: SvcdALC
attributes.documentation: The Agency Location Code (ALC) of the agency that receives services from another agency.

attributes.name: SvcngALC
attributes.documentation: The Agency Location Code (ALC) of the agency that provides services to another agency.

attributes.name: SttlMchsmCd
attributes.documentation: The mechanism by which a financial institution settles a transaction.

attributes.name: SttlRcptDt
attributes.documentation: The date that a settlement gateway or provider receives financial data for processing.

attributes.name: SubAcctRTN
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) used to segregate transaction activity, that is reported directly to the Treasury Master Account, to accommodate reporting and operational needs.  It is also referred to as a SubAccount Customer Identification Number (CIN) by the Federal Reserve or as a Tier 2 RTN by Treasury.

attributes.name: SmrzdDtlCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of financial transactions represented by a summary.

attributes.name: FclSvcTaxSubClsCd
attributes.documentation: The subclass within a class of tax transactions, as defined by the Fiscal Service.

attributes.name: FclSvcTaxClsCd
attributes.documentation: The classification of a tax transaction, as defined by the Fiscal Service.

attributes.name: NAICS_Cd
attributes.documentation: The code that the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) uses to classify business establishments for the purpose of collecting, analyzing, and publishing statistical data on the U.S. economy.

attributes.name: TaxBusCnt
attributes.documentation: The total count of tax business items associated with a Tax Breakdown.

attributes.name: TaxPayerTypCd
attributes.documentation: The type of entity remitting or receiving a tax payment.

attributes.name: TaxTypCd
attributes.documentation: The four-digit code defined by the IRS that corresponds to an IRS form number.

attributes.name: TaxSubTypCd
attributes.documentation: The single alpha-numeric character defined by the IRS that reflects a reason for the tax payment.

attributes.name: TaxBkdwnCnt
attributes.documentation: The total count of Tax Breakdown items.

attributes.name: TotAmt
attributes.documentation: The total absolute dollar amount of items.

attributes.name: TotCnt
attributes.documentation: The total number of items.

attributes.name: IsProgramData
attributes.documentation: Indicates whether this record is program data.

attributes.name: TrfrAmt
attributes.documentation: The amount of funds (to be) transferred between a deposit account at an agent or depositary and a routing number (RTN) that the Federal Reserve maintains for Treasury.

attributes.name: DepDtlAcctNr
attributes.documentation: The account number from which the funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury general Account (TGA).

attributes.name: DepDtlRTN
attributes.documentation: The routing number (RTN) from which the funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury general Account (TGA).

attributes.name: ExpctFndAvlbltyDt
attributes.documentation: The date that deposited funds are expected to be available for immediate disbursement or withdrawal.

attributes.name: TrfrDt
attributes.documentation: The banking date that funds are transferred into or out of the Treasury General Account (TGA).

attributes.name: TrfrDtlCnt
attributes.documentation: The count of Transfer Detail occurrences for a specific Transfer Summary.

attributes.name: DepDtlMchsmCd
attributes.documentation: The mechanism by which funds are transferred and concentrated into the Treasury General Account (TGA).

attributes.name: SumryTypCd
attributes.documentation: The code that denotes the type of summary record.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for a Transfer Summary.

attributes.name: EchoID
attributes.documentation: Identifies the unique original Transmission message level identifier.

attributes.name: TrnsmTs
attributes.documentation: The date and time of a transmission.

attributes.name: SubLvlPrfxCd
attributes.documentation: When populated, represents a programmatic breakdown of the account for Treasury publication purposes.

attributes.name: AlctnTrfrAgcyID
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the agency receiving funds through an allocation transfer.

attributes.name: BegngPdOfAvlblty
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the first year of availability under law that an account may incur new obligations, in annual and multiyear accounts.

attributes.name: EndPdOfAvlblty
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies the last year of availability under law that an account may incur new obligations, in annual and multiyear accounts.

attributes.name: AvlbltyTypCd
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that identifies no-year accounts (X), clearing/suspense accounts (F), Treasury central summary general ledger accounts (A), and merged-surplus accounts (M).

attributes.name: ATB_AvailabilityTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Identifies no-year accounts (X), clearing/suspense accounts (F), Treasury central summary general ledger accounts (A), and merged-surplus accounts (M).  This data element adds a 'C' data type required for adjusted trial balance (ATB) reporting of canceled TAS assets.

attributes.name: MnAcctCd
attributes.documentation: The Treasury Account Symbol (TAS) component that represents the type and purpose of the fund.

attributes.name: SubAcctCd
attributes.documentation: Identifies an available receipt or other Treasury-defined subdivision of the main account.

attributes.name: UnstrdDtaInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the value element contains unstructured content.

attributes.name: UpdtInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether an item is an original transaction or an update.

attributes.name: CorrectiveTypeCode
attributes.documentation: Indicates that the transaction represents a corrective action to a previously reported transaction and categorizes the type of correction action.

attributes.name: ID
attributes.documentation: The identifier for the user data field, which corresponds to the number of the user data field within a channel application.

attributes.name: Lab
attributes.documentation: The label an agency provides that describes what the UserDataField element contains.  For example: "Claim Number" or "Name."

attributes.name: AgtCmtTxt
attributes.documentation: The comments that an agent or depositary associates with processing.

attributes.name: CoinCrncyTotAmt
attributes.documentation: The total value of coins contained within a deposit.

attributes.name: CrncyTotAmt
attributes.documentation: The total value of coin and paper currency contained within a deposit.

attributes.name: PartlInd
attributes.documentation: The indicator denoting whether the details associated represent a partial summarization.

attributes.name: SvcdALC
attributes.documentation: The Agency Location Code (ALC) of the agency that receives services from another agency.

attributes.name: VchrHndlgCd
attributes.documentation: The code that denotes how the voucher information should be handled in downstream reporting.

attributes.name: VchrDt
attributes.documentation: The date that a depositary or agent uses for Fiscal Service reconciliation.

attributes.name: VchrFormCd
attributes.documentation: The type of voucher record, e.g., 215, 215A, 5515.

attributes.name: VchrID
attributes.documentation: The unique identifier for a voucher.

attributes.name: VchrNr
attributes.documentation: The six digit number that helps identify an agency's deposit summary.

attributes.name: VoucherNumber
attributes.documentation: The six digit number that helps identify an agency's deposit summary.

specs.title: IAM_TokenManagement_PartnerOauth2AuthorizationCodeManagement_Digital_Domain_OpenAPI
specs.description:
Authorize is our implementation of the OAuth 2.0 framework. It enables secure authorization using standard methods that can easily be integrated in your app. If you're familiar with OAuth 2.0, everything should look familiar. If not, you may want to check out the OAuth 2.0 resources here. This is used for partners.< r>< r>< r>

endpoints.summary: Authorization code grant: Retrieve authorization code
endpoints.description:
To retrieve an authorization code, call the authorize endpoint by passing the required query parameters.You should end up with a relative URL similar to the below (illustrative).

/authCode/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=[Your client_id issued to you during app registration]&scope=[Space delimited scopes selected from the table below. Only request the scopes required for your app to work.]&countryCode=US&businessCode=GCB&locale=en_US&state=[The state value you create and will verify]&redirect_uri=[The redirect_uri you registered during app registration].

Your final URL should look similar to this, go ahead a try it in any browser if you are unsure if you formed it properly:

https://sandbox.apihub.citi.com/gcb/api/authCode/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=97086fae-c252-4d81-b4d9-d73cde5ea800&scope=accounts_details_transaction&countryCode=US&businessCode=GCB&locale=en_US&state=12093&redirect_uri=https://www.test.com

ScopeDescription
customers_profiles Provides customer name, email, phone number, and address
accounts_routing_numberAdding clear account/routing number added to accounts API
accounts_statementsRetrieve user account statements for customer
accounts_tax_statements Retrieve tax documentation for customer

Once credentials are verified, a consent page will be presented to the Citi customer to approve the scope requested by your app. After getting customer consent, the flow redirects to the provided redirect_uri and an authorization code will be sent back as a query component.

https://www.test.com/?code=AAJP_jIlIuuIqS-qj0ohfXLaOyhQK9y4bbyhEJWt39l5gWT-1XZmCHtESO2gcbLsPmLlERAAPj80IfLueI4WM8s_Ay1Gy8VtcwFUv8lQE4Svi9hOayu5kBP2OKLhvBwMwrZ_wz5SDHaKN96BdgScYmNEGww0IcV5gH4VBjeOPijN7CxdMRwc2H_w5RnpckbCtS4605BCp5FD0Qho4tYsfcmJ&state=12093

This authorization code is valid for a very short period of time and should be immediately exchanged for access token.

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: Value MUST be set to "code"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Client ID generated during application registration.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The set of scopes required to make the API calls. Scope is case insensitive and multiple values can be passed using space delimiter.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country code in 2 character ISO 3166 format (upper case)

parameters.name: businessCode
parameters.description: The 3 character business code. Use GCB for consumer banking (upper case)

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale identify a specific language and geographic region, it shoule follow [language[_territory]. eg - en_US, en_SG

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque value to maintain the state between request and call back. This will be used to prevent cross-site request forgery.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Absolute uri for user-agent redirection.You should provide the uri used during client registration process.

responses.description:
The authorization response contains the authorization code needed to obtain an access token. Here are the parameters included in the response.
success response
fieldnamefield typemandatorydescription
redirect_urilocationyesThis is the absolute uri provided in the request
codequeryyesThe authorization code
statequeryyesThe same value as sent by the client in the state parameter, if any

If an error occurs during authorization, two situations can occur. The first is, that the client is not authenticated or recognized. For instance, a wrong redirect URI was sent in the request. In that case the authorization server must not redirect the resource owner to the redirect URI. Instead it should inform the resource owner of the error. The second situation is that client is authenticated correctly, but that something else failed. In that case the following error response is sent to the client, included in the redirect_uri
failure response
field namefield typemandatorydescription
redirect_urilocationyesThis is the absolute uri provided in the request
statequeryyesThe same value as sent by the client in the state parameter, if any
errorqueryyes
error_descriptionqueryno
error_uriqueryno

Here is the list of errors:
error
invalid_request
unauthorized_client
unsupported_response_type
invalid_scope
access_denied

endpoints.summary: Authorization code grant: Retrieve access token
endpoints.description:
Get an access token issued by calling our token endpoint and passing the authorization code from the previous call. The issued access token will have an expiry, and it will be valid only for the scope for which the consent has been provided by the customer. You can call the APIs by passing this token in Authorization header.
You also get a refresh token that can be used to get a new access token in case the original one expires.

specs.title: PayPal APIs
specs.description: # Getting Started ## Step 1: Fork the collection using Run in Postman [](https://god.gw.postman.com/run-collection/19024122-92a85d0e-51e7-47da-9f83-c45dcb1cdf24?action=collection/fork&collection-url=entityId=19024122-92a85d0e-51e7-47da-9f83-c45dcb1cdf24&entityType=collection&workspaceId=345300e6-346e-42e0-aed1-53717919aef0#?env%5BPayPal%20Override%20Env%) [](https://god.gw.postman.com/run-collection/19024122-92a85d0e-51e7-47da-9f83-c45dcb1cdf24?action=collection/fork&collection-url=entityId=19024122-92a85d0e-51e7-47da-9f83-c45dcb1cdf24&entityType=collection&workspaceId=345300e6-346e-42e0-aed1-53717919aef0#?env%5BPayPal%20Override%20Env%) ## Step 2: Get your access token An access token is automatically generated using a default `client_id` and `secret`. PayPal recommends using your own `client_id` and `secret` from the [Developer Dashboard](https://www.paypal.com/signin?intent=developer&returnUri=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.paypal.com%2Fdeveloper%2Fapplication) by entering the values under the **Variables** tab. A pre-request script will generate and manage the `access_token` automatically. > **Note:** Your developer account `client_id` and `secret` may have a different scope than the default `client_id` and `secret`. ## Step 3: Make your first API call PayPal recommends starting with the Orders API. These steps will use the Orders API to create an order and capture payment using [sandbox accounts](https://developer.paypal.com/developer/accounts) linked to your Developer Dashboard account. To create an order: 1. In your workspace, navigate to your fork of the PayPal collection. 2. Select **Orders > Create Order**. 3. Select the **Send** button to create the order. On a successful call, the API returns a 201 order created response code. 4. In the response, find the **payer-action** link if you created an order with `payment_source.paypal` or **approve** link if you created an order without payment source. 5. Open the **approve** or **payer-action** link in a browser. 6. Log in with your Developer Dashboard Sandbox Personal Account credentials. You can find those credentials by logging into the Developer Dashboard and selecting **Sandbox > Account**. 7. Select the **Continue** button. Payment has now been made. To capture payment: 1. In the response of the order you created, find the `order_id`. 2. In the **Variables** tab, enter the `order_id` number. 3. Select **Orders > Capture payment for order**. 4. Select **Send**. On a successful call, the API returns a 201 order created response code. Your order has been created and payment has been captured. You can verify the transaction in both the sandbox personal account and the sandbox business account.

endpoints.description:
Reauthorizes an authorized PayPal account payment, by ID. To ensure that funds are still available, reauthorize a payment after its initial three-day honor period expires. Within the 29-day authorization period, you can issue multiple re-authorizations after the honor period expires.

If 30 days have transpired since the date of the original authorization, you must create an authorized payment instead of reauthorizing the original authorized payment.

A reauthorized payment itself has a new honor period of three days.

You can reauthorize an authorized payment once for up to 115% of the original authorized amount, not to exceed an increase of $75 USD.

Supports only the `amount` request parameter.
Note: This request is currently not supported for Partner use cases.

endpoints.description:
Sends or schedules an invoice, by ID, to be sent to a customer. The action depends on the invoice issue date:
  • If the invoice issue date is current or in the past, sends the invoice immediately.
  • If the invoice issue date is in the future, schedules the invoice to be sent on that date.
To suppress the merchant's email notification, set the `send_to_invoicer` body parameter to `false`. To send the invoice through a share link and not through PayPal, set the send_to_recipient parameter to false in the notification object. The send_to_recipient parameter does not apply to a future issue date because the invoice is scheduled to be sent through PayPal on that date.
Notes:
  • After you send an invoice, resending it has no effect.
  • To send a notification for updates, update the invoice and set the send_to_recipient body parameter to true.

endpoints.description:
Creates a batch payout. In the JSON request body, pass a `sender_batch_header` and an `items` array. The `sender_batch_header` defines how to handle the payout. The `items` array defines the payout items.
You can make payouts to one or more recipients.
Notes:

  • PayPal does not process duplicate payouts. If you specify a sender_batch_id that was used in the last 30 days, the API rejects the request with an error message that shows the duplicate sender_batch_id and includes a HATEOAS link to the original payout with the same sender_batch_id.

    If you receive an HTTP 5nn status code, you can safely retry the request with the same sender_batch_id.

  • The Payouts API does not support build notation (BN) codes. In a future Payouts release, you can optionally provide BN codes in the PayPal-Partner-Attribution-Id request header.

    For information about the PayPal-Partner-Attribution-Id header, see HTTP request headers. To learn about or request a BN code, contact your partner manager or see PayPal Partner Program.
