NOT_HONORED - Transaction risk analysis exemption failed validation/not honored

This field is present in API response only if the exemption was claimed and optionalResponseParameters field was set to include "RISKASSESSMENTDATA" as one of the comma separated values in the API request.

This field maps to ISO8583 Field 34 – Dataset ID 4A -Tag 89.

lowValueExemptionIndicator.description:
This field is present in API response only if the following conditions are met.

- optionalResponseParameters field was set to include "RISKASSESSMENTDATA" as one of the comma separated values in the API request.

- Low Value exemption was claimed in the acquirer request (OR) Issuer chooses to approve the transaction as the amount was below the issuer set low value and velocity counts limits

Valid Values :
HONORED - Low value exemption validated/honored
NOT_HONORED - Low value exemption failed validation/not honored

This field is present in API response only if the exemption was claimed and optionalResponseParameters field was set to include "RISKASSESSMENTDATA" as one of the comma separated values in the API request.

This field maps to ISO8583 Field 34 – Dataset ID 4A -Tag 87.

delegatedAuthenticationIndicator.description:
Delegated Authentication Indicator.

Valid Values :
HONORED - Delegated authentication request validated/honored
NOT_HONORED - Delegated authentication request failed validation/not honored

This field is present in API response only if the exemption was claimed and optionalResponseParameters field was set to include "RISKASSESSMENTDATA" as one of the comma separated values in the API request.

This field maps to ISO8583 Field 34 – Dataset ID 4A -Tag 8A.

trustedMerchantExemptionIndicator.description:
Trusted Merchant Exemption Indicator.

Valid Values :
HONORED - Trusted merchant exemption validated/honored
NOT_HONORED - Trusted merchant exemption failed validation/not honored

This field is present in API response only if the exemption was claimed and optionalResponseParameters field was set to include "RISKASSESSMENTDATA" as one of the comma separated values in the API request.

This field maps to ISO8583 Field 34 – Dataset ID 4A -Tag 84.

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by an Issuer to identify the payment instrument belonging to a consumer cardholder.
An Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder's payment instrument in their system to Visa Alias Directory Service as a guid.

One alias can be linked to more than one account. For example, one phone can be linked to three different cards with one of these cards selected as the default card to receive money. It is recommended that the Issuer use systematic naming to generate a guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3

If an issuer creates a new Alias with a guid that is already associated with another Alias, the existing record will be deleted and the new Alias will be created.

For aliases created after the September 2023 release, country will be returned in ISO3166-Alpha3 format for resolve response. For aliases created before the September 2023 release, country will be returned in whatever format was provided at the time of the Alias creation.

Maximum value: 999999999.999

Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.
If a currency has 0 minor unit, this field must carry no fractional points.
If a currency has 2 minor units, the field must carry maximum two fractional points.

This contains a code that specifies the network to be used for transmission of the message and determines the program rules that apply to the transaction.

Refer to Network ID

Note:
For ReverseFundsTransactions(AFTR) and MultiReverseFundsTransactions (MULTIAFTR) originators must populate the networkId returned in the original PullFundsTransactions(AFT) and MultiPullFundsTransactions (MULTIAFT) response.

00-Not applicable

terminalId.description: The identifier for the terminal at a card acceptor location. If sending transactions from a card not present environment, use the same value for all transactions.

If the transaction is a money transfer, pre-paid load, or credit card bill pay, and if the sender intends to fund the transaction with a non-financial instrument (for example, cash), a reference number unique to the sender is required.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement, the field is required.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format: ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year).

hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

amount.description:
The transaction amount to be delivered to the recipient.
Format:
Minimum Value: 0
Maximum value: 999999999.999
Allowed fractional digits: 3
Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.
If a currency has 0 minor unit, this field must carry no fractional points.
If a currency has 2 minor units, the field must carry maximum two fractional points.

surcharge.description: When present, this field contains the sender's surcharge as assessed by the originator. Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

senderCity.description:
If the transaction is a money transfer and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's city.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the city of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's city.

senderName.description:
Conditional.

If the transaction is a money transfer and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's name.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the name of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's name.
Required, if the transaction will be routed to Maestro & STAR networks via Visa Push Payments Gateway Service (PPGS). If this field is sent and transaction is not routed over Maestro & STAR the field is still sent to the other networks as an optional field. PPGS uses senderName if all the following fields are available: senderName, senderFirstName, senderLastName and senderMiddleName

Recommended Format: Last Name/Family Surname 1 + Space + Last Name/Family Surname 2 (optional) + Space + First Name/Given Name + Space + Middle Initial or Middle name (optional) + space

Example: Doe John A

accountType.description:

00-Not applicable
10-Saving account
20-Checking account
30-Credit card account
40-Universal account

Default is set to "00" if not provided.

name.description:
If the transaction is a money transfer, the field must contain the sender's name.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement, the field must contain either the name of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load, the field must contain either the name of the load partner providing the reload service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels

If the transaction is a credit card bill pay, the field must contain either the name of the entity providing the credit card bill pay service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the country code of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's country code.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load, the field is required if the transaction is non-U.S. domestic.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and an Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format : ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year). hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

pointOfInitiationMethod.description:
In this two-digit field, the first character indicates the method by which the data is presented by the merchant. The second character indicates whether the data is static or dynamic. Static data refers to a situation wherein same data is presented for every transaction unlike a dynamic data wherein the information is specific to a transaction.
1st character
'1' = QR
'2' = BLE
'3' = NFC
'4' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use
2nd character
'1' = Static
'2' = Dynamic
'3' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use.
Example: '11' indicates QR static code, '12' indicates QR dynamic code.

encAgentName.description: Contains Agent’s Doing Business as name (25 characters only). If the name is greater than 25 characters then the first 25 characters are populated. The field is sent in encrypted format using the AES GCM (i.e. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM)) algorithm for JSON Web Encryption (JWE) objects with 256-bit key (i.e. the shared secret between Visa and client for encryption and decryption of payload data).

city.description: Consumer's city belonging to the payment instrument

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by an Issuer to identify the payment instrument belonging to a consumer cardholder.
An Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder's payment instrument in their system to Visa Alias Directory Service as a guid.

One alias can be linked to more than one account. For example, one phone can be linked to three different cards with one of these cards selected as the default card to receive money. It is recommended that the Issuer use systematic naming to generate a guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3

If an issuer creates a new Alias with a guid that is already associated with another Alias, the existing record will be deleted and the new Alias will be created.

last.description: This attribute is the url to retrieve the content of last page of the report.

next.description: This attribute is the url to retrieve the content of previous page of the report if available.

self.description: This attribute is the url to retrieve the content of current page of the report.

first.description: This attribute is the url to retrieve the content of first page of the report.

previous.description: This attribute is the url to retrieve the content of previous page of the report if available.

_links.description: This contains the navigation url links of the report, i.e. 'self', 'first', 'next'(if applicable),'previous'(if applicable),'last'(if applicable).

city.description: Recipient may replace this field with the city name of merchant.  Visa settlement reports would contain the value provided by recipient.

country.description: Conditional. Recipient may replace this field with the country code of the merchant, if the country code of recipient is different from originator. Visa settlement reports would contain the value provided by recipient.

networkId.description:
This contains a code that identifies the network on which the transaction was processed.

Refer to Network ID

Note:
This field is returned only if it is anything other than networkId value 2.

Supported only in US for domestic transactions.

memberComments.description: This field can be optionally used to send and receive comments by service providers. Issuers can optionally include new text in this field in the response. If the issuer does not include this field, Visa will inject the value from the request in the response and send it back to the service provider.

enablerVerificationValue.description: This field is to allow the application of the interchange discount at the enabler level.

merchantVerificationValue.description: The concatenated Merchant Verification Value of Visa assigned and Acquirer assigned value is returned.

code.description: Error code of the unexpected error.

reason.description: Reason of the unexpected error.

message.description: Error description of the unexpected error.

type.description:
Specify the type of alias records to be contained in the report.
Valid values are CONSUMER, MERCHANT and AGENT.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records to be contained in each page of the report.
Default is set to a maximum of 20,000 records per page of a report.
Minimum value is 1, Maximum value is 20,000.

status.description:
If not provided, default report contains alias records with all valid status, i.e.
Consumer alias report will contain 'ACTIVE','INACTIVE' and 'DISABLED' records
Merchant alias report will contain 'ACTIVE' and 'DISABLED' records
Agent alias report will contain 'ACTIVE' and 'DISABLED' records.
Valid values for status are 'ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE' and 'DISABLED'.

reportStartDate.description:
The start date of a report. Follows ISO 8601, date format YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2019-01-01.
If not set, it will be default to the previous date (T-1).

GenerateReportRequest-1.description: Request payload data to generate a report.

amount.description: Transaction amount in merchant currency.

senderName.description: Please use consumer name to populate this field.  If consumer name is greater than 30 characters, use first 30 characteres.  The name must be populated using the Roman, i.e. English character set.

acquiringBin.description: BIN number identifies the originator of cash-out transaction.

senderReference.description: A reference number unique to the merchant. Field can be left blank.

acquirerCountryCode.description: Use a 3-digit numeric country code for the country where the Visa Direct solution is registered. This must match the information provided during program enrollment. Refer to [ISO Codes](/request_response_codes#iso_country_codes).

senderAccountNumber.description: Populate with consumer PAN.   If the consumer PAN is not populated or is not valid or contains extra spaces, VisaNet will reject the transaction with reject code 494 (Field or data missing or invalid)

merchantCategoryCode.description: Numeric only. Originators should populate 6012. If this field is not populated by the originator, it will automatically be set to the MCC value indicated during the API onboarding process. Recipient should populate the MCC of the merchant in the response message.

businessApplicationId.description: Use CO (cash-out). This field is populated with business application identifier for the transaction. Refer to [businessApplicationId](/request_response_codes#businessApplicationId) codes

systemsTraceAuditNumber.description: Numeric only. It is a key data element used to match a response to its request or to match a message to others for a given transaction. The value assigned to the original request should appear in all subsequent messages for that transaction

transactionCurrencyCode.description: The code in this field must always reflect the currency associated to the amount in field Amount. Use a 3-digit numeric currency code for currency. Refer to [ISO Codes](/request_response_codes#currency_codes).

enablerVerificationValue.description: Enabler Verification Value (EVV) is a Visa assigned value that is used to identify enablers that participate in certain programs. The EVV is unique to the enabler.

localTransactionDateTime.description: The date and time the transaction takes place, expressed in the local date and time of the originator.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: Numeric only. Key data element for matching a message to others within a given transaction set. The same number appears in all related messages: response, advice, reversal, chargeback, chargeback reversal, or representment. It is recommended that the client populate ydddhhnnnnnn value in this field.

recipientPrimaryAccountNumber.description: Consumer PAN. 16-digit PAN as provided by the consumer to merchant.

networkId.description:
This contains a code that identifies the network on which the transaction was processed.

Refer to Network ID

Note:
This field is returned only if it is anything other than networkId value 2.

Supported only in US for domestic transactions.

tokenAssuranceMethod.description: This field contains different category value to determine the Risk Score associated with the token and transaction.

tokenData.description: First nine digits of the cardholder primary account number (PAN) or the full cardholder PAN, in case where a token is used in the transaction.

actionCode.description:
The results of the transaction request

Refer to actionCode
Note: The VisaNet Response Code for the transaction

last4ofPAN.description: This field contains the last four digits of the cardholder primary account number (PAN)

approvalCode.description: The authorization code from the issuer.

responseCode.description:
The source for the response; typically, either the recipient issuer or a Visa system.

Refer to responseCode
Note: The VisaNet Response Source for the transaction

memberComments.description: This field can be optionally used to send and receive comments by service providers. Issuers can optionally include new text in this field in the response. If the issuer does not include this field, Visa will inject the value from the request in the response and send it back to the service provider.

givUpdatedFlag.description: Possible values are true or false

settlementServiceFlag.description:
Possible values are:
0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

givPreviouslyUpdatedFlag.description: Possible values are true or false

settlementResponsibilityFlag.description: Possible values are true or false

customerReference.description:
This field contains a value that identifies the customer.
This field needs to be populated for Argentina domestic purchase transactions where businessApplicationId is "PS".

responseReasonCode.description: This field contains the merchant advice code value received from Mastercard authorization response messages.

serviceProcessingType.description: This field will contain values that identifies the type of service assigned for the transaction.

transactionIdentifier.description:
The VisaNet reference number for the transaction.
Note:transactionIdentifier is a Visa generated field that client receives in the response message.
Note:As an exception Visa allows clients to use the transactionIdentifier received in the AFT response into the subsequent OCT message - this is to simplify matching the pull and push transaction pair and reconcilation.

additionalTokenRespInfo.description:
This field when present in the API response identifies if the transaction is eligible for token services. Valid token service values are: 1 (Token program).

This field will not be sent in the response if the transaction is ineligible for token services.

merchantVolumeIndicator.description:
Merchant Volume Indicator to identify Nano/micro merchants (Peru market)
 Values: "51" (Micromerchant), "52" (Nanomerchant).

enablerVerificationValue.description: Enabler Verification Value (EVV) is a Visa assigned value that is used to identify enablers that participate in certain programs. The EVV is unique to the enabler.

merchantVerificationValue.description: The concatenated Merchant Verification Value of Visa assigned and Acquirer assigned value is returned.

transactionLinkIdentifier.description: Transaction Link Identifier returned from other networks like MasterCard and Pulse

senderIdentificationNumberIndividual.description: This field contains the identification number issued to the individual by the government or an authorized national entity. For Argentina domestic purchase transactions, where businessApplicationId is "PS", this field contains the customer’s VAT registration number for tax identification

amount.description:
This is the transaction amount expressed in U.S. Dollars. Derived by Visa. Depending on when the transaction is processed the amount field may not be present for upto 2 hours.
Note: This field will not be present when requestType is 02 or 03.

cardType.description:
Product type of the card on which the transaction is performed.
Valid Values include*
Credit
Debit
Prepaid.
Note: This field will not be present when requestType is 02 or 03.

networkId.description:
Network ID on which the transaction was performed.
Takes the format of 000x where x is a number.
Valid Values include*
0002 - Visa/PLUS
0016 - Maestro
0003 - Interlink
0008,0010,0011,0012,0015 - Star

actionCode.description:
The results of the transaction request
Refer to actionCode
Note: The VisaNet Response Code for the transaction

reasonCode.description:
The reason code description contains the reason explaining:
  • An acquirer-generated advice, reversal, cancellation, adjustment, chargeback (validation request or advice).
  • A chargeback reversal, representment (validation request or advice).
    • etc.
    Note: This field will not be present when requestType is 02 or 03.

statusCode.description:
Specifies status of the transaction processing.
Valid values are
  • COMPLETED - Transaction was processed by Visa
  • IN_PROGRESS - Transaction is in progress, being processed by Visa
  • FAILED - Transaction was received and rejected by Visa
  • PENDING - Transaction is pending for processing by Visa

requestType.description:
00: (Not a deferred OCT). This value indicates that the request is not a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request. This acts as the default value if not provided in the request.

01: (Originator hold). This value indicates that the originating acquirer has held the OCT for a period of time before sending to Visa and is requesting for Visa to treat the transaction as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.
Note: The value of 01 is reserved for originating acquirers that meet certain conditions. Contact your regional client support representative for more information.

02: (Visa deferred OCT hold, default interval). This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the default holding period of 48 hours upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

03: (Visa deferred OCT hold, client defined interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the client defined holding period (provided in deferredDateTime field) upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

deferredDateTime.description: If exist, identifies when the transaction will be processed by Visa. Format of this value will be in CCYYMMDDHHMM.</br></br>CC - Current Century</br>YY - Year</br>MM - Month</br>DD - date</br>HH - Hour</br>MM - Minute

Interregional transactions.

2 = 7 day count or amount exceeded

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by Issuer to identify their customer (i.e. consumer cardholder).
Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder of their system to VAD as a guid.

For multiple aliases linked to the same PAN, same guid should be used except changing the field alias in the request payload. Below is an example:
guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85291112222
guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85288881111.

For selected countries, one alias can be linked to more than one account, e.g. one mobile can be linked to three different cards with a default card to receive money. It is recommended that issuer to use systematic naming to generate guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3, etc.

This attribute contains the alias data, e.g. phone number, email address, etc.
If phone number is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ITU-T E.164 (2010) number structure. Below are some examples of phone numbers with different country codes:
CountryCountry CodeExamples
United States11650xxxxxxx
Russia77495xxxxxxx
United Kingdom444478xxxxxxxx
Singapore65659xxxxxxx
Hong Kong8528529xxxxxxx
Kenya254254701xxxxxx

If IBAN (International Bank Account Number) is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ISO 13616:2007. Below is an example of IBAN:
CountryExample
IrelandIE29AIBK93115212345678
where
Country Code: IE
Check digits: 29
Bank Identifier: AIBK
Branch Identifier: 931152
Account Number:12345678

1st character

'2' = BLE
'3' = NFC
'4' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use

'2' = Dynamic
'3' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use.
Example: '11' indicates QR static code, '12' indicates QR dynamic code.

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by Issuer to identify their customer (i.e. consumer cardholder).
Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder of their system to VAD as a guid.

For multiple aliases linked to the same PAN, same guid should be used except changing the field alias in the request payload. Below is an example:
guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85291112222
guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85288881111.

For selected countries, one alias can be linked to more than one account, e.g. one mobile can be linked to three different cards with a default card to receive money. It is recommended that issuer to use systematic naming to generate guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3, etc.

alias.description:
This attribute contains the alias data, e.g. phone number, email address, etc.
If phone number is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ITU-T E.164 (2010) number structure. Below are some examples of phone numbers with different country codes:
CountryCountry CodeExamples
United States11650xxxxxxx
Russia77495xxxxxxx
United Kingdom444478xxxxxxxx
Singapore65659xxxxxxx
Hong Kong8528529xxxxxxx
Kenya254254701xxxxxx

If IBAN (International Bank Account Number) is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ISO 13616:2007. Below is an example of IBAN:
CountryExample
IrelandIE29AIBK93115212345678
where
Country Code: IE
Check digits: 29
Bank Identifier: AIBK
Branch Identifier: 931152
Account Number:12345678

merchantVerificationValue.description: Merchant Verification Value(MVV) is used to identify merchants that participate in a variety of programs. The MVV is unique to the merchant.

senderPrimaryAccountNumber.description: The primary account number of the sender's account.

settlementServiceIndicator.description:
This flag enables the originator to request for a particular settlement service to be used for settling the transaction.

Valid values are:
0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

Note: The default value is 9. This field is only relevant for specific countries where the acquirer has to select 8 in order to settle in the national net settlement service.

foreignExchangeFeeTransaction.description: When present, this field contains the sender's foreign exchange markup fee (markup above the wholesale or VisaNet exchange rate as assessed by the originator). Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

recipientIdentificationNumberBusiness.description:
Conditional.

This is an alphanumeric value that carries the recipient's identification number issued to the recipient by the government or an authorized national entity. This field is to be used if the recipient is a business (e.g. Disbursements)

If recipientIdentificationNumberIndividual is not populated, then this field needs to be populated mandatorily for Brazil domestic trasactions when businessApplicationId has any of the below values:

AA
PP
TU
BI
WT
FT

This is an alphanumeric value that carries the merchant’s value-added tax (VAT) registration number or single business reference number (SBRN) for the business issued to by the government or an authorized national entity, then this field needs to be populated for Argentina domestic transaction when businessApplicationId:PS

recipientIdentificationNumberIndividual.description:
Conditional.

This is an alphanumeric value that carries the recipient's identification number issued to the recipient by the government or an authorized national entity. This field is to be used if the recipient is an Individual (e.g. P2P payments)

If recipientIdentificationNumberBusiness is not populated, then this field needs to be populated mandatorily for Brazil domestic trasactions when businessApplicationId has any of the below values:

AA
PP
TU
BI
WT
FT

cpsAuthorizationCharacteristicsIndicator.description:
Conditional
Request for CPS authorization. If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (Transaction requests participation).

Note:Supported only in US for CPS (Custom Payment Service).

This field is required for the transaction to qualify for CPS qualified Interchange rates and to avoid the Transaction Integrity Fee.
Please reach out to your Visa representative for details.

amount.description: Amount in transaction currency.

networkId.description:
Network ID on which the transaction was performed.Takes the format of 000x where x is a number.Valid Values include*
0002 - Visa/PLUS
0016 - Maestro
0003 - Interlink
0008,0010,0011,0012,0015 - Star

acquringBin.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN) under which the Visa Direct solution is registered.

approvalCode.description: It contains the authorization code provided by the Issuer when a transaction is approved, if the approval code ISO field 38 is present in the 0210 response from Issuer, then Visa would populate the same value and send it in the advice.

name.description: Card acceptor name that was sent in the original request.

idCode.description: A unique identifier for the card acceptor that was sent in the original request.

city.description: Card acceptor city that was sent in the original request.

state.description: Card acceptor state or province code that was sent in the original request.

county.description: Card acceptor county code that was sent in the original request.

country.description: Card acceptor country code that was sent in the original request.

postalCode.description: Card acceptor postal code that was sent in the original request.

terminalId.description: The identifier for the terminal at a card acceptor location that was sent in the original request.

dateConversion.description: It contains the effective date of the conversion rate used to convert the transaction amount to the settlement amount.

cardProductCode.description: Used to identify the specific card product.

settlementAmount.description: This field contains the transaction amount converted to settlement currency.

messageReasonCode.description: 4 digits message reason code to give processing intent:9052 - Confirmation Advice

cardSequenceNumber.description: 3 digit number assigned to a card when two or more cards are associated with the same PAN.

dateReconciliation.description: This contains the date on which the transactions were settled.

originalActionCode.description:
The response code received from the recipient issuer after sending the original OCT request once the hold time expires for that transaction. Refer to actionCode
https://developer.visa.com/request_response_codes#action_code

panEntryMode.description: A 2-digit code that was sent in the original request.

motoECIIndicator.description: This 2-digit code identifies the level of security used in an electronic commerce transaction which VisaNet forwards in requests and advices to issuers that have successfully tested to receive them.

posConditionCode.description: Contains a code identifying transaction conditions that was sent in the original request.

settlementConvRate.description: This field contains the rate used by VisaNet to convert the transaction amount to settlement amount.

settlementCurrency.description: The 3-digit ISO-4217 code in this field reflects the currency associated to the settlementAmount field.

accountNumberMasked.description: Contains the masked PAN number. Populated from the primary account number (PAN) contained in the original authorization request.

feeProgramIndicator.description: This field contains an interchange reimbursement fee program indicator (FPI), which is used in assessing the fee amount that was sent in the original request.

localTransactionDate.description: It contains the month and day on which the transaction was originated by the originator. The date is in mmdd format.

localTransactionTime.description: The time the transaction takes place, expressed in the local time of the originator. The time is in hh:mm:ss format.

merchantCategoryCode.description: Contains a code describing the merchant's type of business product or service, also known as the merchant category code (MCC) that was sent in the original request.

requestType.description: This field identifies the request type that was sent in the original request.

deferredDateTime.description: If exist, identifies when transaction was processed by VisaNet in the format CCYYMMDDHHMM.</br></br>CC - Current Century</br>YY - Year</br>MM - Month</br>DD - date</br>HH - Hour</br>MM - Minute

serviceProcessingType.description: This field will contain values that identifies the type of service assigned  for the transaction.

transactionIdentifier.description: The VisaNet reference number for the transaction. This is the same transactionIdentifier previously received in the response for PushFunds  transaction API calls.Note: When stan and rrn parameters combination is not used as query parameters, this parameter must be included as a query parameter.

cardholderBillingAmount.description: Amount in card holder billing currency.

dateAndTimeTransmission.description: This field contains the date and time the request is submitted to VisaNet.

systemsTraceAuditNumber.description: A number assigned by the message initiator that uniquely identifies a transaction. This is the same as systemsTraceAuditNumber previously sent in the request for the original deferred OCT request.

prepaidLoadBalanceAmount.description:
Min Inclusive: -999999999.999.
Max Inclusive: 999999999.999.
Note: Applicable only for Top Up Transactions.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: It is a key data element for matching a message to others within a given transaction set. This is the same as retrievalReferenceNumber previously sent in the request for the original deferred OCT request.

cardHolderBillingConvRate.description: This field contains the rate used by VisaNet to convert the transaction amount to cardholder billing amount.

cardholderBillingCurrency.description: The 3-digit ISO-4217 code in this field reflects the currency associated to the cardholderBillingAmount field.

amountInTransactionCurrency.description: The 3-digit ISO-4217 code in this field reflects the currency associated to the transactionAmount field.

prepaidLoadBalanceCurrencyCode.description: The 3-digit ISO-4217 code in this field reflects the currency associated with prepaidLoadBalance

countryCodePrimaryAccountNumber.description: The 3-digit ISO-4217 code in this field reflects the currency associated to the card issuer institution.

settlementConvRateDecimalPosition.description: This is a multicurrency field. It contains the rate used by Visa to convert the transaction amount to the settlement amount.

cardHolderBillingConvRateDecimalPosition.description: This is an optional field and if conversionRateReconciliation is present, then rateDecimalPositions needs to be present.

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by issuer to identify their customer (i.e. consumer cardholder).
Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder of their system to VAD as a guid.

alias.description:
This attribute contains the alias data, e.g. phone number, email address, etc.
If phone number is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ITU-T E.164 (2010) number structure. Below are some examples of phone numbers with different country codes:
CountryCountry CodeExamples
United States11650xxxxxxx
United Kingdom444478xxxxxxxx
Singapore65659xxxxxxx
Hong Kong8528529xxxxxxx
Kenya254254701xxxxxx

If IBAN (International Bank Account Number) is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ISO 13616:2007. Below is an example of IBAN:

CountryExample
IrelandIE29AIBK93115212345678
where
Country Code: IE
Check digits: 29
Bank Identifier: AIBK
Branch Identifier: 931152
Account Number:12345678

DeleteAliasRequest-3.description:
Request payload data for deleting an alias.

Note. This API allows issuer to delete only one mapping of an alias to an account at one time. To delete
  • the mappings of multiple aliases linked to the same PAN; and/or
  • the mappings of one alias linked to multiple accounts
issuer is required to submit multiple API requests.

name.description: Originator should populate this field with 'mVisa cash-out'.

idCode.description: Originator can populate the field with any system generated reference number internal to originating client.

amount.description: Transaction amount in merchant currency. Visa's rules do not permit cross border cash deposit transactions.

senderName.description: Populate the field with merchant�s doing business as name (25 characters only). If the name is greater than 25 characters, use the first 25 characters. The name must be populated using the Roman i.e. English character set.

acquiringBin.description: BIN number identifies the originator of cash-in transaction.

senderReference.description: A reference number unique to the merchant. Field can be left blank.

acquirerCountryCode.description: Use a 3-digit numeric country code for the country where the Visa Direct solution is registered. This must match the information provided during program enrollment. Refer to [ISO Codes](/request_response_codes#iso_country_codes).

senderAccountNumber.description: This is optional field for cash-in transactions.

merchantCategoryCode.description: Numeric only. Originators should populate 6012. If this field is not populated by the originator, it will automatically be set to the MCC value indicated during the API onboarding process. Recipient should populate the MCC of the merchant in the response message.

businessApplicationId.description: Use CI (cash-in). This field is populated with business application identifier for the transaction. Refer to [businessApplicationId](/request_response_codes#businessApplicationId) codes

systemsTraceAuditNumber.description: Numeric only. It is a key data element used to match a response to its request or to match a message to others for a given transaction. The value assigned to the original request should appear in all subsequent messages for that transaction

transactionCurrencyCode.description: The code in this field must always reflect the currency associated to the amount in field Amount. Use a 3-digit numeric currency code for transaction currency. Refer to [ISO Codes](/request_response_codes#currency_codes).

enablerVerificationValue.description: Enabler Verification Value (EVV) is a Visa assigned value that is used to identify enablers that participate in certain programs. The EVV is unique to the enabler.

localTransactionDateTime.description: The date and time the transaction takes place, expressed in the local date and time of the originator.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: Numeric only. Key data element for matching a message to others within a given transaction set. The same number appears in all related messages: response, advice, reversal, chargeback, chargeback reversal, or representment. It is recommended that the client populate ydddhhnnnnnn value in this field.

recipientPrimaryAccountNumber.description: Consumer PAN. 16-digit PAN as provided by the consumer to merchant.

actionCode.description:
The results of the transaction request

Refer to Action Code
Note: : The VisaNet Response Code for the transaction

last4ofPAN.description: This field contains the last four digits of the cardholder primary account number (PAN)

approvalCode.description: The authorization code from the issuer.

responseCode.description:
The source for the response; typically, either the recipient issuer or a Visa system.

Refer to responseCode
Note: : The VisaNet Response Source for the transaction

prepaidBalance.description:
Min Inclusive: -999999999.999

Max Inclusive: 999999999.999

Applicable only for Top Up Transactions

givUpdatedFlag.description: Possible values are true or false

settlementServiceFlag.description:
Possible values are:
0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

givPreviouslyUpdatedFlag.description: Possible values are true or false

settlementResponsibilityFlag.description: Possible values are true or false

originalActionCode.description:
The action code of the original transaction request
Refer to actionCode
Note: This field is only present, when the request is identified as a duplicate.

transactionIdentifier.description:
The VisaNet reference number for the transaction

Note:
transactionIdentifier is a Visa generated field that client recieves in the response message.
Note: As an exception Visa allows clients to use the transactionIdentifier received in the AFT response into the subsequent OCT message - this is to simplify matching the pull and push transaction pair and reconciliation.
transactionIdentifier.x-variant: positive(when call does not timeout)

enablerVerificationValue.description: This field is to allow the application of the interchange discount at the enabler level.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and an Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format : ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year). hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

city.description: Merchant or agent city.

aliasId.description: This attribute is used by acquirer to uniquely identify their merchant or agent.

country.description: Merchant or agent country code as defined by ISO 3166. ISO 3166 alpha-2 is recommended to be used if alias may be used for QR.

aliasType.description:
01 – Phone number
02 – Email address
03 – USSD Payment ID
04 – BID (Bank Identification Number)
05 – National ID
06 – Custom
Null – Should start with visa assigned USSD Payment ID

merchantId.description: A 16 digit-number as per Mobile Push Payment Program Implementation Guide to receive payment by merchant or agent.

isAgentAlias.description: Optional and applicable for agent alias use only. If set as 'Y', agent alias to be created.

recipientName.description: Merchant or agent name.

convenienceFeeAmount.description: The convenience fee of a fixed amount. Applicable only for merchant alias.

merchantCategoryCode.description: Merchant Category Code. Numeric only.

payloadFormatIndicator.description: Defines the format of the merchant data payload. Payload Format Indicator must be set to '01' as per EMVCo Merchant Presented QR specifications.

pointOfInitiationMethod.description:
In this two-digit field, the first character indicates the method by which the data is presented by the merchant. The second character indicates whether the data is static or dynamic. Static data refers to a situation wherein same data is presented for every transaction unlike a dynamic data wherein the information is specific to a transaction.
1st character
'1' = QR
'2' = BLE
'3' = NFC
'4' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use
2nd character
'1' = Static
'2' = Dynamic
'3' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use.
Example: '11' indicates QR static code, '12' indicates QR dynamic code.

transactionCurrencyCode.description: As defined by ISO 4217.  This is the transaction currency code that a merchant can accept for payment. 3-digit numeric presentation of the currency is recommended to be used if alias may be used for QR.

convenienceFeePercentage.description: Applicable only for merchant alias. The percentage convenience fee, specified as numeric value from “00.01” (for 00.01%) to “99.99” (for 99.99%).

tipConvenienceFeeIndicator.description: Tip or Convenience Fee Indicator. This shall contains a value of '01', '02' or '03' as per EMVCo Merchant Presented QR specifications. Applicable only for merchant alias.

CreateMerchantAliasRequest.description: Request payload data for creating a merchant or agent alias.

aliasId.description: Identifier uniquely assigned by Acquirer to a merchant.  This identifier of a merchant or agent of acquirer is returned if alias operation in Alias Directory is successful

MerchantAliasResponse.description: Response if a merchant or agent is successfully created,updated or deleted.

amount.description:
The transaction amount to be delivered to the recipient.
Format:
Minimum Value: 0
Maximum value: 999999999.999
Allowed fractional digits: 3
Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.
If a currency has 0 minor unit, this field must carry no fractional points.
If a currency has 2 minor units, the field must carry maximum two fractional points.

vauFlag.description: If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (will cause VAU to be performed)

surcharge.description: When present, this field contains the sender's surcharge as assessed by the originator. Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

senderCity.description:
Conditional.

If the transaction is a money transfer and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's city.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the city of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's city.

This field is also conditionally required for domestic Colombia transactions

senderName.description:
Conditional.

Please do not use this field for non Visa transactions and for domestic Colombia transactions. Use senderFirstName, senderLastName & senderMiddleName instead.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement, provide the name of merchant or government entity sending the funds.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, provide the cardholder's name.

Recommended Format: Last Name/Family Surname 1 + Space + Last Name/Family Surname 2 (optional) + Space + First Name/Given Name + Space + Middle Initial or Middle name (optional) + space

Example: Doe John A

accountType.description:
This is used to identify the account type of the recipientPrimaryAccountNumber in the request. Below are the possible values.

00-Not applicable
10-Saving account
20-Checking account
30-Credit card account
40-Universal account

Default is set to "00" if not provided.

secondaryId.description: secondaryId is used for C2B use case in the CEMEA region where payee initiates the OCT to the payer. The merchant or acquirer may use this field to obtain an Agreement Id in order to process the request.

acquiringBin.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN) under which the Visa Direct solution is registered. This must match the information provided during enrollment.

name.description:
For P2P payments, must contain the sender name.

For a funds disbursement, must contain either the name of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

For pre-paid loads, must contain either the name of the load partner providing the reload service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

For credit card bill payment, must contain either the name of the entity providing the credit card bill pay service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

For more details refer to the OCT Global Implementation Guide and VIP technical specifications.

taxID.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the identifier of the acceptor issued by a taxation authority.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

idCode.description: An identifier for the card acceptor (Visa Direct Originator). This value should be unique for each originator for whom you are sending transactions.

city.description: City of the Merchant/Originator.

state.description: Conditional. State or province of the Merchant/Originator. Required if the cardAcceptor:address:country is "US" or "CA", for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia, and for all MasterCard transactions. Note: For "US" or "CA", this field can contain either the full name of the state or the 2 character code of the state. For rest of the countries, if applicable, the field contains the state code of a maximum 6 characters length.

county.description:
Conditional.

Must be the county of the Merchant/Originator. Required if cardAcceptor:address:country is "US".

country.description:
Valid inputs (US example in brackets [])

ISO country code (2 alpha) [example: "US"]

ISO country code (3 alpha) [example: "USA"]

ISO country code (3 numeric) [example: "840"].

Refer to ISO Codes

zipCode.description: Conditional. Zip/Postal code of the Merchant/Originator. Required if the cardAcceptor:address:country is "US" or "CA", for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia, and for all MasterCard transactions. Note: For "US", "CA", and US territories (Puerto Rico/Guam/US Virgin Island/American Samoa/Northern Mariana Island), the maximum length of the field is 9 characters. For rest of the countries, the maximum length of the field is 8 characters.

addressLine.description: Conditional. Street address of the Merchant/Originator. This field is conditionally required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia and for all MasterCard transactions.

terminalId.description: The identifier for the terminal at a card acceptor location. If sending transactions from a card not present environment, use the same value for all transactions.

urlAddress.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the web address of the acceptor.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

partnerIDCode.description:
Conditional.

This field identifies a specific partnership agreement, generally between specific acceptors and issuers. may be used for transactions on accounts issued under co-branding agreements when one of the co-branding partners originates the transaction.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

legalBusinessName.description: Conditional. Acceptor’s legal business name associated with the card acceptor identification code for OCT transactions. This field is conditionally required for all Money Transfer OCTs and for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia.

phoneNumber.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the business phone number of the acceptor, if different from the acceptor customer service phone number.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

additionalContactDetails.description:
Conditional.

This field contains additional information for contacting the acceptor, such as an additional phone number or a contact name.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

customerServicePhoneNumber.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the customer service phone number of the acceptor that should be used for transaction inquiries.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

id.description:
Conditional.

Payment Facilitator ID or Marketplace ID (MasterCard). This field is conditionally required when a payment facilitator is involved or for all MasterCard transactions.

name.description: Payment facilitator name in OCTs. This field is conditionally required when a payment facilitator is involved.

city.description: City Name

state.description: State/province Code

country.description: Alpha Country Code

postalCode.description: Postal code or zip code

subMerchantId.description:
Conditional.

Sub-Merchant ID containing the sponsored merchant ID. This field is conditionally required when a payment facilitator is involved or for all MasterCard transactions.

ids.description: Multiple ids can be provided for additional Acceptor. Duplicate instance of same idType is not allowed eg. One instance of Gateways and RampProvider can be present in the same request but multiple instances of same idType like Gateways is not allowed.

idType.description:
Defines type of card Acceptor.

Duplicate instances of same idType is not allowed

Marketplace - Marketplace that facilitated the digital currency sale/purchase.
Gateways - Payment gateway that facilitated the digital currency sale/purchase.
StageDigitalWallet - Staged Digital Wallet that facilitated the digital currency sale/purchase.
RampProvider - Ramp provider that facilitated the digital currency sale/purchase.

idValue.description: Value of idType provided for additional acceptor

foreignRetailerIndicator.description:
Identifies a foreign retailer under a marketplace and/or payment facilitator.
May also Identify a foreign Conversion Affiliate under a Ramp
This tag must contain either:

A – Conversion Affiliate is located in the same country as Ramp provider
B – Conversion Affiliate is located in a different country as Ramp provider

independentSalesOrganizationID.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the "Company ID" that is assigned during the time of registration with Mastercard Connect as a service provider and must be provided by the acquirer.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

city.description: Conditional. This field contains the name of the city where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

state.description: Conditional. This field contains the ISO code of the State/Province or country subdivision where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

postalCode.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the postal code of the country where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

countryCode.description:
Conditional. This field contains the 3 character alpha ISO country code of the country where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

Refer to ISO Codes

sourceAmount.description:
Conditional.

Source Amount is required in certain markets to identify the transaction amount entered in the sender's currency code prior to FX conversion by the originating entity.

cardCvv2Value.description: The cardCvv2Value provided by the account holder for the recipientPrimaryAccountNumber in the request. cardCvv2Value is required for Mastercard transaction with BAI=GP(Gambling Payout)

recipientCity.description:
Conditional

This field contains the city name of the recipient address.
Note:
It is required for cross-border transactions that are originating from or destined to Canada and for domestic Colombia transactions.

recipientName.description:
Conditional.

Please do not use this field for non Visa transactions and for domestic Colombia transactions. Use recipientFirstName, recipientLastName & recipientMiddleName instead.

This field contains the recipient's name and is required for cross-border enhanced money transfer done with Visa cards.

Recommended Format: Last Name/Family Surname 1 + Space + Last Name/Family Surname 2 (optional) + Space + First Name/Given Name + Space + Middle Initial or Middle name (optional) + space

Example: Doe John A

senderAddress.description:
Conditional.

If the transaction is a money transfer and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's address.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the address of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's address.

Note:
This field is not applicable for domestic Colombia transactions

recipientState.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the state or province (ISO 3166-2 subdivision) code of the recipient address.
Note:
It is required for cross-border transactions either originating from or destined to Canada with recipientCountryCode of 840(USA) or 124(CAN).
It is also required for Push Payments transactions associated with Gateway Service when recipientCountryCode is either 124(CAN) or 840(USA). (Refer to Mastercard data processing requirements)

Note:
This field is not applicable for domestic Colombia transactions

senderLastName.description:
Conditional

This field contains sender's last name

Required for transaction routed over non Visa networks through Push Payment Gateway Service.

Maybe needed for Visa transactions for certain markets. Please check with your Visa contact.

Maps to the following ISO 8583 field
- Field 56, Tag 85

senderFirstName.description:
Conditional

This field contains sender's first name

Required for transaction routed over non Visa networks through Push Payment Gateway Service.

This may also be required for Visa transactions for certain markets. Please check with your Visa contact.

Maps to the following ISO 8583 field
- Field 56, Tag 83

senderReference.description:
Conditional.

Required, if the transaction is a money transfer, pre-paid load, or credit card bill pay, and if the sender intends to fund the transaction with a non-financial instrument (for example, cash), a reference number unique to the sender is required.
Required, if the transaction is a funds disbursement, the field is required.
Required, if the transaction will be routed to STAR networks via Visa Push Payments Gateway Service. If this field is sent and transaction is not routed over STAR the field is still sent to the other networks as an optional field.

This field is required if senderAccountNumber is not sent.

senderStateCode.description:
Conditional.

Required if senderCountryCode is either 124(CAN) or 840(USA)

Note:
This field not applicable for domestic Colombia transactions

purposeOfPayment.description:
Conditional.

This is an alphanumeric value.
Purpose of payment is required in certain markets to clearly identify the purpose of the payment based on the standard values defined for respective market.

schemeIdentifier.description:
Defines the card scheme selected of a co-badged cards for the transaction.Only 2 values supported.
01-Visa
02-Other
The values will expand in future.

senderEntityType.description:
Optional.

This field identifies if the sender is a business or an individual. The valid value are: 'B' for Business and 'I' for Individual.

Note:
This field is only applicable for domestic Colombia transactions. For other transactions, if the field is provided, it will be dropped.

senderMiddleName.description:
This field contains sender's middle name

Used when transaction is routed over non Visa networks through Push Payment Gateway Service.

Maybe needed for Visa transactions for certain markets. Please check with your Visa contact.

Maps to the following ISO 8583 field
- Field 56, Tag 84

senderOccupation.description: Account Owner Occupation. Only alpha-numeric data is accepted

senderPostalCode.description:
Conditional.

When present, this field contains the sender's postal code
Note: Required when cardAcceptor:address:country is US or CA

Note: For domestic Colombia transactions, the maximum length of this field is 16 characters. For other transactions, the entered value should be between 5 and 10 characters.

senderStreetName.description:
Optional.

This field contains the street name of the sender address.

Note:
This field is only applicable for domestic Colombia transactions. For other transactions, if the field is provided, it will be dropped.

sharingGroupCode.description:
This field is optionally used by Push Payments Gateway participants (merchants and acquirers) to specify the network access priority.

requestType.description:
00: (Not a deferred OCT). This value indicates that the request is not a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request. This acts as the default value if not provided in the request.

01: (Originator hold). This value indicates that the originating acquirer has held the OCT for a period of time before sending to Visa and is requesting for Visa to treat the transaction as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.
Note: The value of 01 is reserved for originating acquirers that meet certain conditions. Contact your regional client support representative for more information.

02: (Visa deferred OCT hold, default interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the default holding period of 48 hours upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

03: (Visa deferred OCT hold, client defined interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the client defined holding period (provided in deferredDateTime field) upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

deferredDateTime.description: This field is conditionally required for requestType 03. This field identifies when the transaction needs to be processed by Visa. Format of this value will be in CCYYMMDDHHMM (GMT). The provided deferredDateTime should be within 24 to 48 hours of receipt of the request by Visa.

nationalReimbursementFee.description:
When present, this field contains the IRF fees.
Format:
Minimum Value: 0
Maximum value: 999999999.999
Allowed fractional digits: 3.
Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and an Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format : ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year). hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

mvvAcquirerAssigned.description: Visa assists the acquirer in assigning the last four. E.g. 98FC

merchantVerificationValue.description: Merchant Verification Value(MVV) is used to identify merchants that participate in a variety of programs. The MVV is unique to the merchant.

irfType.description:

0 - Unknown/default
1 - Fixed
2 - Ad valorem (%)
3 - Composite (fixed amount and ad valorem)

accountType.description:

CO - Commercial products
CR - Credit
DB - Debit
PL - Private label
PP - Prepaid

irfCategoryCode.description: This field optionally contains any value from 00 to 99.

merchantFiscalId.description: This field contains RFC for the merchant. This is an alphanumeric field. The RFC format can be AAAANNNNNNAAA, where A is alphanumeric value and N is a numeric value.

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Client-Calculated Interchange Reimbursement Fee in the same currency as the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

reimbursementFeeTax.description: This field contains the VAT calculated for the IRF applicable to the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

settlementServiceIndicator.description:

0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

Note: The default value is 9. This field is only relevant for specific countries where the acquirer has to select 8 in order to settle in the national net settlement service.

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Argentina member supplied reimbursement fee. It should be set to 0 for Argentina Domestic Purchase transactions.

reimbursementFeeTax.description:
Conditional.

argentinaNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Argentina required if transaction indicates Argentina national settlement.

recipientPrimaryAccountNumber.description: This is a 16-digit PAN or token for the account of the recipient of push payment.

recipientSubDivisionMinorCode.description:

Note:
This field is not applicable for domestic Colombia transactions

masterCardMerchantPaymentGatewayId.description: This field contains merchant payment gateway ID assigned by Mastercard, provided by the acquirer when a registered merchant payment gateway service provider participates in the transaction. Value is right-justified and zero-filled.

senderIdentificationNumberBusiness.description:
Conditional.

This is an alphanumeric value that carries the sender's identification number issued to the sender by the government or an authorized national entity. This field is to be used if the sender is a business (e.g. Disbursements)

Note: If senderIdentificationNumberIndividual is not populated, then this field needs to be populated mandatorily for Brazil domestic transactions.

senderIdentificationNumberIndividual.description:
Conditional.

amount.description:
The transaction amount to be delivered to the recipient.
Format:
Minimum Value: 0
Maximum value: 999999999.999
Allowed fractional digits: 3
Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.
If a currency has 0 minor unit, this field must carry no fractional points.
If a currency has 2 minor units, the field must carry maximum two fractional points.

vauFlag.description: If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (will cause VAU to be performed)

surcharge.description: When present, this field contains the sender's surcharge as assessed by the originator. Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

senderCity.description:
Conditional.

If the transaction is a money transfer and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's city.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the city of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's city.

This field is also conditionally required for domestic Colombia transactions

senderName.description:
Conditional.

Please do not use this field for non Visa transactions and for domestic Colombia transactions. Use senderFirstName, senderLastName & senderMiddleName instead.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement, provide the name of merchant or government entity sending the funds.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, provide the cardholder's name.

Recommended Format: Last Name/Family Surname 1 + Space + Last Name/Family Surname 2 (optional) + Space + First Name/Given Name + Space + Middle Initial or Middle name (optional) + space

Example: Doe John A

accountType.description:
This is used to identify the account type of the recipientPrimaryAccountNumber in the request. Below are the possible values.

00-Not applicable
10-Saving account
20-Checking account
30-Credit card account
40-Universal account

Default is set to "00" if not provided.

secondaryId.description: secondaryId is used for C2B use case in the CEMEA region where payee initiates the OCT to the payer. The merchant or acquirer may use this field to obtain an Agreement Id in order to process the request.

acquiringBin.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN) under which the Visa Direct solution is registered. This must match the information provided during enrollment.

name.description:
For P2P payments, must contain the sender name.

For a funds disbursement, must contain either the name of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

For pre-paid loads, must contain either the name of the load partner providing the reload service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

For credit card bill payment, must contain either the name of the entity providing the credit card bill pay service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

For more details refer to the OCT Global Implementation Guide and VIP technical specifications.

Note: For "US" or "CA", this field can contain either the full name of the state or the 2 character code of the state. For rest of the countries, if applicable, the field contains the state code of a maximum 6 characters length.

For rest of the countries, the maximum length of the field is 8 characters.

addressLine.description: Conditional. Street address of the Merchant/Originator. This field is conditionally required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia and for all MasterCard transactions.

requestType.description:
00: (Not a deferred OCT). This value indicates that the request is not a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request. This acts as the default value if not provided in the request.

01: (Originator hold). This value indicates that the originating acquirer has held the OCT for a period of time before sending to Visa and is requesting for Visa to treat the transaction as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.
Note: The value of 01 is reserved for originating acquirers that meet certain conditions. Contact your regional client support representative for more information.

02: (Visa deferred OCT hold, default interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the default holding period of 48 hours upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

03: (Visa deferred OCT hold, client defined interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the client defined holding period (provided in deferredDateTime field) upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

deferredDateTime.description: This field is conditionally required for requestType 03. This field identifies when the transaction needs to be processed by Visa. Format of this value will be in CCYYMMDDHHMM (GMT). The provided deferredDateTime should be within 24 to 48 hours of receipt of the request by Visa.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and an Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format : ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year). hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

accountType.description:

Default is set to "00" if not provided.

secondaryId.description: secondaryId is used for C2B use case in the CEMEA region where payee initiates the OCT to the payer. The merchant or acquirer may use this field to obtain an Agreement Id in order to process the request.

name.description:

For P2P payments, must contain the sender name.

For a funds disbursement, must contain either the name of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

For pre-paid loads, must contain either the name of the load partner providing the reload service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

For credit card bill payment, must contain either the name of the entity providing the credit card bill pay service or the bank designated service name, if offered over bank channels.

For standalone tip transfers, name must include word TIP.

For more details refer to the OCT Global Implementation Guide and Merchant Data Standards Manual.

requestType.description:
00: (Not a deferred OCT). This value indicates that the request is not a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request. This acts as the default value if not provided in the request.

01: (Originator hold). This value indicates that the originating acquirer has held the OCT for a period of time before sending to Visa and is requesting for Visa to treat the transaction as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.
Note: The value of 01 is reserved for originating acquirers that meet certain conditions. Contact your regional client support representative for more information.

02: (Visa deferred OCT hold, default interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the default holding period of 48 hours upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

03: (Visa deferred OCT hold, client defined interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the client defined holding period (provided in deferredDateTime field) upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

deferredDateTime.description: This field is conditionally required for requestType 03. This field identifies when the transaction needs to be processed by Visa. Format of this value will be in CCYYMMDDHHMM (GMT). The provided deferredDateTime should be within 24 to 48 hours of receipt of the request by Visa.
