recipientDateOfBirth.description: Account Owner Date of Birth.(format YYYY-MM-DD)

recipientNationality.description: ISO country code of nationality in alphabets.

identificationList.description:
Identification list of sender.
For domestic Colombia and Ukraine transactions, we will send all the instances of ID information received to the issuer.
For other transactions, we have a current limitation that sender ID and recipient ID information are mutually exclusive. If both sender ID and recipient ID are sent in the same request, only sender ID related information will be sent to the issuer. Additionally, only 1 instance of ID per sender or recipient is currently supported. If more than one instance is provided, only the first instance will be forwarded to the issuer.

idType.description:
This field will contain the type of sender identification. The valid values are: 
 BTHD - Date of birth 
 CUID - Customer identification - unspecified 
 NTID - National identification
 PASN - Passport number
 DRLN - Driver license
 TXIN - Tax identification 
 CPNY - Company registration number
 PRXY - Proxy identification 
 SSNB - Social security number 
 ARNB - Alien registration number 
 LAWE - Law enforcement identification 
 MILI - Military identification 
 TRVL - Travel identification - non-passport 
 EMAL - Email
 PHON - Phone number 
For a given instance of identificationList[], a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will not be forwarded to the issuer.

idNumber.description:
This field will contain an acquirer-populated value associated with the Identification Type in field idType 
When idType contains the value of BTHD (Date of birth), this tag must contain a date of birth in ccyymmdd format where: cc = century, yy = year,  mm = month, dd = day 
For a given instance of identificationList[] , a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will dropped and not be forwarded to the issuer.

idOwnerType.description:

idIssueCountry.description: This tag will contain the 3-alpha or 3-digit ISO country code of the ID issuing country.

For Money Transfer, AA applies to transactions where the sender and recipient are the same person and PP applies to transactions where the sender and recipient are not the same person.

For Argentina domestic purchase transactions the value should be "PS".

Conditional.

This field is required to identify whether a transaction is merchant-initiated

Note: Merchants must link the Merchant-Initiated Transaction with the original transaction using the Transaction Identifier that was generated for the original cardholder initiated transaction. However, for standing-instruction MITs (i.e., recurring, installment, and unscheduled COF), acquirers can use the Transaction Identifier generated for the previous transaction in the series to link the subsequent transactions.

Conditional
Postal Code for address verification. For US, contains 5 or 9 digit ZIP code. This field is required for the transaction to qualify for CPS qualified Interchange rates and to avoid Transaction Integrity Fee.

systemsTraceAuditNumber.description: A unique value should be used for each API method. However, when passing the (AFTR) method, this value must match the systemsTraceAuditNumber previously passed with the AFT method for the current transaction.

chipConditionCode.description:
This field applies to magnetic stripe read transactions where the card and terminal are chip capable. The field does not apply to VSDC transactions where the chip is read; it is used only when the chip card's magnetic stripe is read instead of the chip.
Valid values include:

0 - Not applicable to fallback transactions. For chip read transactions this field must contain a 0 or be excluded from the message.
1 - This value applies to fallback transactions. Transaction was initiated from a magnetic stripe with a service code beginning with 2 or 6 and the last read at VSDC terminal was a successful chip read or was not a chip transaction.
2 - This value applies to fallback transactions. Transaction was initiated at a chip-capable terminal from a magnetic stripe that contains service code 2 or 6, and the previous transaction initiated by that terminal was an unsuccessful chip read.

chipTransactionIndicator.description: This 1-digit code is set by full VSDC data acquirers when they receive a message from the terminal that indicates a chip-based transaction.

chipAuthenticationReliabilityIndicator.description: This 1-digit code can be set and sent in by the full VSDC data acquirer or set by Visa when the acquirer or issuer is inactive for Card Authentication.

enablerVerificationValue.description: Enabler Verification Value (EVV) is a Visa assigned value that is used to identify enablers that participate in certain programs. The EVV is unique to the enabler.

localTransactionDateTime.description:
This field contains the local date and time of the transaction takes place originated from merchant, service provider or acquirer.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
Example: 2011-12-30T21:32:52
localTransactionDateTime.x-variant: | YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

nationalReimbursementFee.description: If present, this field should contain the IRF fees.

posTerminalType.description:
This 1-digit code identifies the basic POS electronic terminal category.

Valid Values :
0-Unspecified
3-Unattended cardholder-activated, authorized transaction Use to indicate that the transaction has all following characteristics: Occurs in an unattended cardholder-activated environment.Is authorized online or approved offline.Examples are: Movie and game rentals and Automated retail
4-Electronic cash register
5-Unattended customer terminal (intended for use in the LAC region only)
7-Telephone device (including Visa dial terminals)
8-Reserved
9-Use to identify that an mPOS device is used to originate a transaction on an open network

Note: For a CardPresent Transactions, this field is required.

posTerminalEntryCapability.description:
This 1-digit code identifies the capability of the terminal to electronically read account numbers (and expiration dates) from cards.

Valid Values :
0-Unknown codes
1-Terminal not used
2-Magnetic stripe read capability
3-QR code
4-OCR read capability
5-Contact chip, magnetic-stripe, or proximity-capable terminal, indicating that the terminal can read the chip and the magnetic stripe on the card.
If contact chip is supported, a 5 should be used regardless of whether Visa Contactless is also supported.
6-Reserved for future use
7-Reserved for future use

Note: For a CardPresent Transactions, this field is required.

acceptsPartialAuthorizations.description:
This field is optional. This field is sent only to participating issuers. Participating originators/acquirers may submit a value of TRUE in this field  if the POS systems can accept partially approved transactions. 
Valid values: 
FALSE -  Terminal does not support partial authorization. 
TRUE - Terminal accepts partial authorization responses. 

 Note: If a value is entered in this field, the posTerminalEntryCapability and posTerminalType fields must be provided.

pointOfServiceCapability.description: Note: This object and the nested fields are required for CardPresent Transaction and Partial Authorizations transactions.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format: ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year).

hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

mvvAcquirerAssigned.description: Visa assists the acquirer in assigning the last four. E.g. 98FC

merchantVerificationValue.description: Merchant Verification Value(MVV) is used to identify merchants that participate in a variety of programs. The MVV is unique to the merchant.

irfType.description:
This field contains one of the following values:
0 - Unknown/default
1 - Fixed
2 - Ad valorem (%)
3 - Composite (fixed amount and ad valorem)

accountType.description:
This field contains one of the following values:
CO - Commercial products
CR - Credit
DB - Debit
PL - Private label
PP - Prepaid

irfCategoryCode.description: This field optionally contains any value from 00 to 99.

merchantFiscalId.description: This field contains RFC for the merchant. This is an alphanumeric field. The RFC format can be AAAANNNNNNAAA, where A is alphanumeric value and N is a numeric value.

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Client-Calculated Interchange Reimbursement Fee in the same currency as the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

reimbursementFeeTax.description: This field contains the VAT calculated for the IRF applicable to the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

mexicoNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Mexico required if transaction indicates Mexico national settlement.

transactionLinkIdentifier.description: Transaction Link Identifier returned from other networks like MasterCard and Pulse

mastercardWalletIdentifier.description: This field contains the Wallet Program Data generated by the PayPass Online platform or MasterPass platform.

optionalResponseParameters.description:
Originators may choose to specify any or all of the following optional parameters to receive as part of the API response.

E.g. Originators may specify comma-separated, optional parameters such as optionalResponseParameters (motoECIIndicator), if they want to receive motoECIIndicator in the API response.

motoECIIndicator: Identifies the level of security used in an electronic commerce transaction over an open network (for example, the Internet) or the type of mail or telephone order. Acquirers supply indicator values, which V.I.P. forwards in requests and advices to issuers that have successfully tested to receive them. The subfield is dropped if issuers have not successfully completed testing or choose not to receive it.

Refer to Moto ECI Codes

E.g. optionalResponseParameters (motoECIIndicator)

settlementServiceIndicator.description:
This flag enables the originator to request for a particular settlement service to be used for settling the transaction.

Valid values are:
0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

Note: The default value is 9. This field is only relevant for specific countries where the acquirer has to select 8 in order to settle in the national net settlement service.

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by Issuer to identify their customer (i.e. consumer cardholder).
Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder of their system to VAD as a guid.

For multiple aliases linked to the same PAN, same guid should be used except changing the field alias in the request payload. Below is an example:
guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85291112222
guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85288881111.

For selected countries, one alias can be linked to more than one account, e.g. one mobile can be linked to three different cards with a default card to receive money. It is recommended that issuer to use systematic naming to generate guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3, etc.

Singapore65659xxxxxxx
Hong Kong8528529xxxxxxx

If IBAN (International Bank Account Number) is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ISO 13616:2007. Below is an example of IBAN:
CountryExample

where
Country Code: IE

Bank Identifier: AIBK
Branch Identifier: 931152
Account Number:12345678

accountLookUp.description:
Retrieve the attributes that determine the key characteristics of a recipient payment account before initiating a funds transfer by providing the Primary Account Number (PAN).
If such attributes are required, set the value as 'Y'. Default is set as 'N'

amount.description: The transaction amount to be sent by sender to the recipient.  Format: digits with or without decimal point, e.g. 100 or 123.45. If not provided, system will use generic word (e.g. 'money transfer') for the notification message.

language.description: Language for the notification message if originator prefers to override the default language to be used for an originator. This should be provided in accordance with ISO 639-2 standard, e.g. 'en' for sending an English notification message to a receiver in a market such as Russia where Russian is set as the default language to be used for originators from Russia.

senderName.description: Name of the sender who initiates the transaction. If not provided, system will use default word (e.g. 'Someone') for the notification message.

requestType.description:
00 : (Not a deferred OCT). This value indicates that the request is not a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request. This acts as the default value if not provided in the request.

01 : (Originator hold). This value indicates that the originating acquirer has held the OCT for a period of time before sending to Visa and is requesting for Visa to treat the transaction as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.
Note: The value of 01 is reserved for originating acquirers that meet certain conditions. Contact your regional client support representative for more information.

02 : (Visa deferred OCT hold, default interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the default holding period of 48 hours upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

03 : (Visa deferred OCT hold, client defined interval).This value indicates that the originating acquirer is requesting Visa to apply the client defined holding period (provided in deferredDateTime field) upon receipt and process the request as a deferred OCT. Visa will send this value to the recipient issuer in the request.

1st character

'2' = BLE
'3' = NFC
'4' - '9' = Reserved for Future Use

'2' = Dynamic

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and an Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format : ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year). hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

nationalNetMiscAmount.description: This is an amount field that contains an airport charge, cashback or a tip.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: This field contains a number that is used with other data elements as a key to identify and track all messages related to a given cardholder transaction; that is, to a given transaction set. Recommended format: ydddhhnnnnnn. The first four digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year), hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed, nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number. A unique value should be used for each API invocation.

fastFundsIndicator.description:

billingCurrencyCodeMinorDigits.description: Identifies the number of decimal positions that should be present in any amounts for the requested card's billing currency.

guid.description:

Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder of their system to VAD as a guid.

alias.description:
This attribute contains the alias data, e.g. phone number, email address, etc.
If phone number is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ITU-T E.164 (2010) number structure. Below are some examples of phone numbers with different country codes:
CountryCountry CodeExamples
United States11650xxxxxxx
Russia77495xxxxxxx
United Kingdom444478xxxxxxxx
Singapore65659xxxxxxx
Hong Kong8528529xxxxxxx
Kenya254254701xxxxxx

If IBAN (International Bank Account Number) is used for alias, this should be provided in accordance with ISO 13616:2007. Below is an example of IBAN:

CountryExample
IrelandIE29AIBK93115212345678
where
Country Code: IE
Check digits: 29
Bank Identifier: AIBK
Branch Identifier: 931152
Account Number:12345678

Request payload data for deleting an alias.

Note. This API allows issuer to delete only one mapping of an alias to an account at one time. To delete
  • the mappings of multiple aliases linked to the same PAN; and/or
  • the mappings of one alias linked to multiple accounts
issuer is required to submit multiple API requests.

acquirerCountryCode.description: Use a 3-digit numeric country code for the country. This must match the information provided during program enrollment.

feeProgramIndicator.description: Originators can leave this field blank.

transactionIdentifier.description: Conditional. If originator submits merchant payment transaction using MerchantPushPayments API, they should submit the same value of transactionIdentifier in API request. Otherwise, do not use this field in the API request.

systemsTraceAuditNumber.description: Numeric only. This value must match with the systemsTraceAuditNumber previously sent in the original refund transaction.

localTransactionDateTime.description:
This should be +/- 3 days from the current date.

The date is in yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss format

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: Numeric only. This value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously sent in the original refund transaction.

This flag enables the originator to request for a particular settlement service to be used for settling the transaction.

0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide

cavv.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV) is a value generated by an Access Control Server (ACS) and signed by the Issuer using account and password information of cardholders registered for the Verified by Visa (also known as Visa Secure) program. This field should be in hexabinary format.

tavv.description:
The Token Authentication Verification Value (TAVV) is a value generated using tokenized PAN by Visa Token Service (VTS) and signed by the Issuer. This field should be in hexabinary format.

Note: A token should be send (instead of a PAN) in senderPrimaryAccountNumber field while sending a TAVV cryptogram.

amount.description:
The amount of the transaction, inclusive of all fees you assess for the transaction, including currency conversion fees. If the originator is populating the surcharge or foreignExchangeFeeTransaction field, they must be included in the amount field.
Format:
Minimum Value: 0
Maximum value: 999999999.999
Allowed fractional digits: 3
Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.
If a currency has 0 minor unit, this field must carry no fractional points.
If a currency has 2 minor units, the field must carry maximum two fractional points.

pinDataBlock.description: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

zoneKeyIndex.description: Note: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

pinBlockFormatCode.description: Note: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

vauFlag.description: If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (will cause VAU to be performed)

surcharge.description: When present, this field contains the sender's surcharge as assessed by the originator. Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

senderCity.description: When present, this field contains sender's city

senderName.description:
Conditional.

The Sender Name can be up to 30 characters long and must be the sender's legal name. If the sender's name is greater than thirty (30) characters, use only the first 30 characters of the name.
Please do not use this field for non Visa transactions and for domestic Colombia transactions. Use senderFirstName, senderLastName & senderMiddleName instead.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement, provide the name of merchant or government entity sending the funds.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, provide the cardholder's name.

Recommended Format: Last Name/Family Surname 1 plus space | Last Name/Family Surname 2(optional) plus space | First Name plus space | Middle Initial or Middle Name(optional)
Note:

- This field must not contain a ? (Question mark) or any special characters
- Only a valid and legal recipient name must be populated in this field

Example: Doe John A

accountType.description:
This is used to identify the account type of the senderPrimaryAccountNumber in the request. Below are the possible values.

00-Not applicable
10-Saving account
20-Checking account
30-Credit card account
40-Universal account

Default is set to "00" if not provided.

name.description:
name of the originator/money transfer operator.

taxID.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the identifier of the acceptor issued by a taxation authority.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

idCode.description: An identifier for the card acceptor (Visa Direct Originator). This value should be unique for each originator for whom you are sending transactions.

city.description: Conditional. City of the Merchant/Originator. Required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia. Note: Visa defaults this to "VISA DIRECT" if city is not provided.

state.description: Conditional. State or province of the Merchant/Originator. Required if the cardAcceptor:address:country is "US" or "CA", for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia, and for all MasterCard transactions. Note: For "US" or "CA", this field can contain either the full name of the state or the 2 character code of the state. For rest of the countries, if applicable, the field contains the state code of a maximum 6 characters length.

county.description:
Conditional

Note:It contains 3-digit numeric FIPS county code of the money transfer operator/Originator.

Required if cardAcceptor:address:country is "US".

This field must contain the 3-character alpha country code for the country of the originator or money transfer operator.

zipCode.description:
Conditional.

Zip/Postal code of the Merchant/Originator.

Required if the cardAcceptor:address:country is "US" or "CA", for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia, and for all MasterCard transactions.

Note: For "US", "CA", and US territories (Puerto Rico/Guam/US Virgin Island/American Samoa/Northern Mariana Island), the maximum length of the field is 9 characters. For rest of the countries, the maximum length of the field is 8 characters.

terminalId.description: The identifier for the terminal at a card acceptor location. If sending transactions from a card not present environment, use the same value for all transactions.

urlAddress.description:

This field is conditionally required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia.

phoneNumber.description:

additionalContactDetails.description:

chipConditionCode.description:
This field applies to magnetic stripe read transactions where the card and terminal are chip capable. The field does not apply to VSDC transactions where the chip is read; it is used only when the chip card's magnetic stripe is read instead of the chip.
Valid values include:

0 - Not applicable to fallback transactions. For chip read transactions this field must contain a 0 or be excluded from the message.
1 - This value applies to fallback transactions. Transaction was initiated from a magnetic stripe with a service code beginning with 2 or 6 and the last read at VSDC terminal was a successful chip read or was not a chip transaction.
2 - This value applies to fallback transactions. Transaction was initiated at a chip-capable terminal from a magnetic stripe that contains service code 2 or 6, and the previous transaction initiated by that terminal was an unsuccessful chip read.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format: ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year).

hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Client-Calculated Interchange Reimbursement Fee in the same currency as the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

reimbursementFeeTax.description: This field contains the VAT calculated for the IRF applicable to the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

mexicoNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Mexico required if transaction indicates Mexico national settlement.

mastercardWalletIdentifier.description: This field contains the Wallet Program Data generated by the PayPass Online platform or MasterPass platform.

optionalResponseParameters.description:

motoECIIndicator: Identifies the level of security used in an electronic commerce transaction over an open network (for example, the Internet) or the type of mail or telephone order. Acquirers supply indicator values, which V.I.P. forwards in requests and advices to issuers that have successfully tested to receive them. senderPrimaryAccountNumber.description: This is a 16-digit PAN or token of the sender's account.

settlementServiceIndicator.description:

Valid values are:
0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

Note: The default value is 9. This field is only relevant for specific countries where the acquirer has to select 8 in order to settle in the national net settlement service.

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Argentina member supplied reimbursement fee. This value should be greater than 0 for Argentina Domestic Purchase transactions.

reimbursementFeeTax.description:

argentinaNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Argentina required if transaction indicates Argentina national settlement.

mastercardAuthenticationData.description:

foreignExchangeFeeTransaction.description: When present, this field contains the sender's foreign exchange markup fee (markup above the wholesale or VisaNet exchange rate as assessed by the originator). Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

recipientSubDivisionMinorCode.description:

Note:
This field is not applicable for domestic Colombia transactions

remoteCommerceAcceptorIdentifier.description: This field contains a merchant identifier encoded as Base64. For example website URL or reverse domain name.

value.description: The value of the payment instrument. For 'PCI_TOKEN_REFID', length is 1-75 and must accompany with 'merchantId'. For 'PAYMENT_CREDENTIAL_ID' length is 1-36 characters.

merchantId.description:

masterCardUCAFCollectionIndicator.description: E-commerce indicator that Mastercard Universal Cardholder Authentication data is included in the message.

masterCardMerchantPaymentGatewayId.description: This field contains merchant payment gateway ID assigned by Mastercard, provided by the acquirer when a registered merchant payment gateway service provider participates in the transaction. Value is right-justified and zero-filled.

recipientAccountIdentifierValue.description:

recipientAccountIdentifierTypeCode.description:

- Field 56, DSI01 Tag 84

This field should be in hexabinary format.

tavv.description:
The Token Authentication Verification Value (TAVV) is a value generated using tokenized PAN by Visa Token Service (VTS) and signed by the Issuer. This field should be in hexabinary format.

amount.description: The amount of the transaction, inclusive of all fees you assess for the transaction, including currency conversion fees. If the originator is populating the surcharge or foreignExchangeFeeTransaction field, they must be included in the amount field.

pinDataBlock.description: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

zoneKeyIndex.description: Note: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

pinBlockFormatCode.description: Note: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

vauFlag.description: If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (will cause VAU to be performed)

surcharge.description: When present, this field contains the sender's surcharge as assessed by the originator. Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

senderCity.description: When present, this field contains sender's city

senderName.description:
Conditional.

If the transaction is a money transfer and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's name.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement and cross-border or U.S. domestic, this field must contain either the name of the merchant or government entity sending the funds disbursement.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, this field must contain the sender's name.

senderMiddleName.description: This field contains sender's middle name

senderPostalCode.description: When present, this field contains the sender's postal code

 PASN - Passport number
 DRLN - Driver license
 TXIN - Tax identification 
 CPNY - Company registration number
 PRXY - Proxy identification 
 SSNB - Social security number 
 ARNB - Alien registration number 
 LAWE - Law enforcement identification 
 MILI - Military identification 
 TRVL - Travel identification - non-passport 
 EMAL - Email
 PHON - Phone number 
For a given instance of identificationList[], a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will not be forwarded to the issuer.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year).

hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

AA
PP
TU
BI
WT
FT

cpsAuthorizationCharacteristicsIndicator.description:
Conditional
Request for CPS authorization. If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (Transaction requests participation)

Note: Supported only in US for CPS (Custom Payment Service).

This field is required for the transaction to qualify for CPS qualified Interchange rates and to avoid the Transaction Integrity Fee.

Please reach out to your Visa representative for details.

cavv.description: The Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV) is a value generated by an Access Control Server (ACS) and signed by the Issuer using account and password information of cardholders registered for the Verified by Visa (also known as Visa Secure) program. This field should be in hexabinary format.

tavv.description:
The Token Authentication Verification Value (TAVV) is a value generated using tokenized PAN by Visa Token Service (VTS) and signed by the Issuer. This field should be in hexabinary format.

Note: A token should be send (instead of a PAN) in senderPrimaryAccountNumber field while sending a TAVV cryptogram.

amount.description:
The amount of the transaction, inclusive of all fees you assess for the transaction, including currency conversion fees. If the originator is populating the surcharge or foreignExchangeFeeTransaction field, they must be included in the amount field.
Format:
Minimum Value: 0
Maximum value: 999999999.999
Allowed fractional digits: 3
Note: If a currency has three decimal places, the last digit of this field must be zero.
If a currency has 0 minor unit, this field must carry no fractional points.
If a currency has 2 minor units, the field must carry maximum two fractional points.

pinDataBlock.description: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

zoneKeyIndex.description: Note: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

pinBlockFormatCode.description: Note: For a CardPresent with PIN Data scenario, this field is required.

vauFlag.description: If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (will cause VAU to be performed)

surcharge.description: When present, this field contains the sender's surcharge as assessed by the originator. Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

senderCity.description: When present, this field contains sender's city

senderName.description:
Conditional.

Please do not use this field for non Visa transactions and for domestic Colombia transactions. Use senderFirstName, sendertLastName & senderMiddleName instead.

If the transaction is a funds disbursement, provide the name of merchant or government entity sending the funds.

If the transaction is a pre-paid load or credit card bill pay and U.S. domestic, provide the cardholder's name.

Recommended Format: Last Name/Family Surname 1 + Space + Last Name/Family Surname 2 (optional) + Space + First Name/Given Name + Space + Middle Initial or Middle name (optional) + space

Example: Doe John A

accountType.description:
This is used to identify the account type of the senderPrimaryAccountNumber in the request. Below are the possible values.

00-Not applicable
10-Saving account
20-Checking account
30-Credit card account
40-Universal account

Default is set to "00" if not provided.

acquiringBin.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN) under which your Visa Direct is registered. This must match the information provided during enrollment.

name.description:
name of the originator/money transfer operator.
The Merchant Name field must conform to the format detailed in the Visa Direct Account Funding Transactions Processing Guide AFT Implementation Guide

taxID.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the identifier of the acceptor issued by a taxation authority.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

idCode.description: An identifier for the card acceptor (Visa Direct Originator). This value should be unique for each originator for whom you are sending transactions.

city.description: Conditional. City of the Merchant/Originator. Required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia. Note: Visa defaults this to "VISA DIRECT" if city is not provided.

state.description: Conditional. State or province of the Merchant/Originator. Required if the cardAcceptor:address:country is "US" or "CA", for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia, and for all MasterCard transactions. Note: For "US" or "CA", this field can contain either the full name of the state or the 2 character code of the state. For rest of the countries, if applicable, the field contains the state code of a maximum 6 characters length.

county.description:
Conditional

Note:It contains 3-digit numeric FIPS county code of the money transfer operator/Originator.

Required if cardAcceptor:address:country is "US".

country.description:
This field must contain the 3-character alpha country code for the country of the originator or money transfer operator.

Refer to ISO Codes

zipCode.description:
Conditional.

Zip/Postal code of the Merchant/Originator.

Required if the cardAcceptor:address:country is "US" or "CA", for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia, and for all MasterCard transactions.

Note: For "US", "CA", and US territories (Puerto Rico/Guam/US Virgin Island/American Samoa/Northern Mariana Island), the maximum length of the field is 9 characters. For rest of the countries, the maximum length of the field is 8 characters.

addressLine.description: Conditional. Street address of the Merchant/Originator. This field is conditionally required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia and for all MasterCard transactions.

terminalId.description: The identifier for the terminal at a card acceptor location. If sending transactions from a card not present environment, use the same value for all transactions.

urlAddress.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the web address of the acceptor.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

partnerIDCode.description:
Conditional.

This field identifies a specific partnership agreement, generally between specific acceptors and issuers. may be used for transactions on accounts issued under co-branding agreements when one of the co-branding partners originates the transaction.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

legalBusinessName.description:
Acceptor’s legal business name associated with the card acceptor identification code for AFT transactions.

This field is conditionally required for all cross border transactions when issuer is in Canada or Australia.

phoneNumber.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the business phone number of the acceptor, if different from the acceptor customer service phone number.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

additionalContactDetails.description:
Conditional.

This field contains additional information for contacting the acceptor, such as an additional phone number or a contact name.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

customerServicePhoneNumber.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the customer service phone number of the acceptor that should be used for transaction inquiries.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

id.description: Marketplace ID or Payment Facilitator's ID. This field is conditionally required when a payment facilitator is involved and for all MasterCard transactions.

name.description: Payment facilitator name in AFTs. This field is conditionally required when a payment facilitator is involved.

subMerchantId.description: Sub-Merchant ID containing the sponsored merchant ID. This field is conditionally required when a payment facilitator is involved and for all MasterCard transactions.

independentSalesOrganizationID.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the "Company ID" that is assigned during the time of registration with Mastercard Connect as a service provider and must be provided by the acquirer.

This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

city.description: Conditional. This field contains the name of the city where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

state.description: Conditional. This field contains the ISO code of the State/Province or country subdivision where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

postalCode.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the postal code of the country where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

countryCode.description:
Conditional. This field contains the 3 character alpha ISO country code of the country where the cardholder received the services. This field is conditionally required for all MasterCard transactions.

Refer to ISO Codes

cardCvv2Value.description: The cardCvv2Value value provided by the account holder for the senderPrimaryAccountNumber in the request.

chipConditionCode.description:
Optional.
This field applies to magnetic stripe read transactions where the card and terminal are chip capable. The field does not apply to VSDC transactions where the chip is read; it is used only when the chip card's magnetic stripe is read instead of the chip.
Valid values include:
0- Not applicable to fallback transactions. For chip read transactions this field must contain a 0 or be excluded from the message.
1 - This value applies to fallback transactions. Transaction was initiated from a magnetic stripe with a service code beginning with 2 or 6 and the last read at VSDC terminal was a successful chip read or was not a chip transaction.
2- This value applies to fallback transactions. Transaction was initiated at a chip-capable terminal from a magnetic stripe that contains service code 2 or 6 , and the previous transaction initiated by that terminal was an unsuccessful chip read.

motoECIIndicator.description:
Identifies the level of security used in an electronic commerce transaction over an open network (for example, the Internet) or the type of mail or telephone order. Acquirers supply indicator values, which V.I.P. forwards in requests and advices to issuers that have successfully tested to receive them. The subfield is dropped if issuers have not successfully completed testing or choose not to receive it.

Refer to Moto ECI Codes

posConditionCode.description:

Refer to POS Condition Codes

specialConditionIndicatorMerchant.description: Cryptocurrency indicator with the value of “7” can be used to identify the purchase of cryptocurrency, thereby providing greater visibility to the issuers.

pointOfServiceData.description:

scpExemptionIndicator.description:
Secure Corporate Payment (SCP) Indicator.

Valid Values :
FALSE - Secure corporate payment exemption not claimed/requested
TRUE - Secure corporate payment exemption claimed/requested

If this exemption does not apply to the transaction, the value of "FALSE" is optional and the field may be omitted entirely.

This field maps to ISO8583->TLV Field 34, Dataset ID 4A, Tag 88.

traExemptionIndicator.description:
Transaction Risk Analysis (TRA) Exemption Indicator.

Valid Values :
FALSE - Transaction risk analysis exemption not claimed/requested
TRUE - Transaction risk analysis exemption claimed/requested

If this exemption does not apply to the transaction, the value of "FALSE" is optional and the field may be omitted entirely.

This field maps to ISO8583->TLV Field 34, Dataset ID 4A, Tag 89.

lowValueExemptionIndicator.description:
Low Value Exemption Indicator.

Valid Values :
FALSE - Low value exemption not claimed/requested
TRUE - Low value exemption claimed/requested

If this exemption does not apply to the transaction, the value of "FALSE" is optional and the field may be omitted entirely.

This field maps to ISO8583->TLV Field 34, Dataset ID 4A, Tag 87.

scaEnvironmentOutageIndicator.description:
Acceptance Environment Authentication Outage Indicator.

Valid Values :
FALSE - No authentication outage
TRUE - Authentication outage

If this exemption does not apply to the transaction, the value of "FALSE" is optional and the field may be omitted entirely.This field maps to ISO8583 Field 34 – Dataset ID 02 -Tag 87.

delegatedAuthenticationIndicator.description:
Delegated Authentication Indicator.

Valid Values :
FALSE - Delegated authentication not claimed/requested
TRUE - Delegated authentication claimed/requested

If this exemption does not apply to the transaction, the value of "FALSE" is optional and the field may be omitted entirely.
Clients requesting this exemption should also provide the the following request parameters:
1. visaMerchantIdentifier value, which is an unique identifier assigned by Visa for each merchant included in the identification program.Issuers can obtain a list of Visa-assigned merchant identifiers from Visa Online (VOL).
2. Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (CAVV) OR Token Authentication Verification Value (TAVV)

Program Qualification: Acquirers that choose to participate will identify and qualify potential Delegates that meet the qualification criteria and work with them to evidence how their authentication capabilities are compliant and to obtain their agreement to the requirements of the Program through the Readiness Questionnaire. Token requestors may submit their Readiness Questionnaire directly to Visa. On a per transaction basis, the delegated entity will flag to the Issuer that SCA was performed through EMV 3DS (2.2 only) or VTS.

This field maps to ISO8583->TLV Field 34, Dataset ID 4A, Tag 8A.

trustedMerchantExemptionIndicator.description:
Trusted Merchant Exemption Indicator.

Valid Values :
FALSE - Trusted merchant exemption not claimed/requested
TRUE - Trusted merchant exemption claimed/requested

If this exemption does not apply to the transaction, the value of "FALSE" is optional and the field may be omitted entirely.

This field maps to ISO8583->TLV Field 34, Dataset ID 4A, Tag 84.

identificationList.description:
Identification list of sender.
For domestic Colombia transactions, we will send all the instances of ID information received to the issuer.
For other transactions, we have a current limitation that sender ID and recipient ID information are mutually exclusive. If both sender ID and recipient ID are sent in the same request, only sender ID related information will be sent to the issuer. Additionally, only 1 instance of ID per sender or recipient is currently supported. If more than one instance is provided, only the first instance will be forwarded to the issuer.

idType.description:
This field will contain the type of sender identification. The valid values are: 
 BTHD - Date of birth 
 CUID - Customer identification - unspecified 
 NTID - National identification
 PASN - Passport number
 DRLN - Driver license
 TXIN - Tax identification 
 CPNY - Company registration number
 PRXY - Proxy identification 
 SSNB - Social security number 
 ARNB - Alien registration number 
 LAWE - Law enforcement identification 
 MILI - Military identification 
 TRVL - Travel identification - non-passport 
 EMAL - Email
 PHON - Phone number 
For a given instance of identificationList[], a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will not be forwarded to the issuer.

idNumber.description:
This field will contain an acquirer-populated value associated with the Identification Type in field idType 
When idType contains the value of BTHD (Date of birth), this tag must contain a date of birth in ccyymmdd format where: cc = century, yy = year,  mm = month, dd = day 
For a given instance of identificationList[] , a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will dropped and not be forwarded to the issuer.

idOwnerType.description:

The valid values are :

 PRXY - Proxy identification 
 SSNB - Social security number 
 ARNB - Alien registration number 
 LAWE - Law enforcement identification 
 MILI - Military identification 
 TRVL - Travel identification - non-passport 
 EMAL - Email
 PHON - Phone number 
For a given instance of identificationList[], a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will not be forwarded to the issuer.

idNumber.description:
This field will contain an acquirer-populated value associated with the Identification Type in field idType. 
When idType contains the value of BTHD (Date of birth), this tag must contain a date of birth in ccyymmdd format where: cc = century, yy = year,  mm = month, dd = day. 
 For a given instance of identificationList[], a minimum of idType and idNumber fields should be provided, else the ID information will be dropped and not forwarded to the issuer.

idOwnerType.description:
This field denotes whether the Tax ID is a business or individual's Tax ID when idType contains the value of TXIN (Tax identification).
The valid values are : 
B (Business) 
I (Individual)

idIssueCountry.description: This tag will contain the 3-alpha or 3-digit ISO country code of the ID issuing country.

contactInformationList.description:
Contact Information list of recipient.

Note: This information is only applicable for domestic Colombia transactions. For other transactions, if the information is provided, it will be dropped.

entityType.description: This field identifies if the contact information is for a business or an individual. The valid value are: 'B' for Business and 'I' for Individual.

contactType.description:
This field identifies the type of contact information. The valid value is: "PHONE" for phone number.

Note:
For a given instance of contactInformationList[], a minimum of contactType and contactValue fields should be provided, else the contact information will not be forwarded to the issuer.

contactValue.description:
This field contains the contact value for provided contact type.

Note:
For a given instance of contactInformationList[], a minimum of contactType and contactValue fields should be provided, else the contact information will not be forwarded to the issuer.

ancillaryRecipientDetails.description:
Ancillary recipient details.

Note: This information is only applicable for domestic Colombia transactions. For other transactions, if the information is provided, it will be dropped.

city.description: This field contains the city of the ancillary recipient's address.

postalCode.description: This field contains the postal code of the ancillary recipient's address.

streetName.description: This field contains the street name of the ancillary recipient's address.

countryCode.description:
This field contains the 3 char alpha ISO country code of the ancillary recipient's address.

Refer to ISO Codes

addressLine1.description: This field contains the first line of the ancillary recipient's address.

addressLine2.description: This field contains the second line of the ancillary recipient's address.

buildingNumber.description: This field contains the building number or house number of the ancillary recipient's address.

lastName.description: This field contains ancillary recipient's last name

firstName.description: This field contains ancillary recipient's first name

entityType.description: This field identifies if the ancillary recipient is a business or an individual. The valid value are: 'B' for Business and 'I' for Individual.

middleName.description: This field contains ancillary recipient's middle name

recipientBuildingNumber.description:
Optional.

This field contains the house or building number of the recipient address.

systemsTraceAuditNumber.description: A unique value should be used for each API method. However, when passing the (AFTR) method, this value must match the systemsTraceAuditNumber previously passed with the AFT method for the current transaction.

enablerVerificationValue.description: This field is to allow the application of the interchange discount at the enabler level.

localTransactionDateTime.description:
This field contains the local date and time of the transaction takes place originated from merchant, service provider or acquirer.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
Example: 2011-12-30T21:32:52
localTransactionDateTime.x-variant: | YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

nationalReimbursementFee.description: If present, this field should contain the IRF fees.

posTerminalType.description:
This 1-digit code identifies the basic POS electronic terminal category.

Valid Values :
0-Unspecified
3-Unattended cardholder-activated, authorized transaction Use to indicate that the transaction has all following characteristics: Occurs in an unattended cardholder-activated environment.Is authorized online or approved offline.Examples are: Movie and game rentals and Automated retail
4-Electronic cash register
5-Unattended customer terminal (intended for use in the LAC region only)
7-Telephone device (including Visa dial terminals)
8-Reserved
9-Use to identify that an mPOS device is used to originate a transaction on an open network

posTerminalEntryCapability.description:
This 1-digit code identifies the capability of the terminal to electronically read account numbers (and expiration dates) from cards.

Valid Values :
0-Unknown codes
1-Terminal not used
2-Magnetic stripe read capability
3-QR code
4-OCR read capability
5-Contact chip, magnetic-stripe, or proximity-capable terminal, indicating that the terminal can read the chip and the magnetic stripe on the card.
If contact chip is supported, a 5 should be used regardless of whether Visa Contactless is also supported.
6-Reserved for future use
7-Reserved for future use

acceptsPartialAuthorizations.description:
This field is optional. This field is sent only to participating issuers. Participating originators/acquirers may submit a value of TRUE in this field  if the POS systems can accept partially approved transactions. 
Valid values: 
FALSE -  Terminal does not support partial authorization. 
TRUE - Terminal accepts partial authorization responses.

pointOfServiceCapability.description: Note: For a CardPresent Transactions, this field is required.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description:
A value used to tie together service calls related to a single financial transaction. When passing Account Funding Transaction (AFT) and Original Credit Transaction (OCT) methods, this value must differ between the two methods. When passing the Account Funding Transaction Reversal (AFTR) method, this value must match the retrievalReferenceNumber previously passed with the AFT method for this transaction.

Recommended Format: ydddhhnnnnnn

The first fours digits must be a valid yddd date in the Julian date format, where the first digit = 0-9 (last digit of current year) and the next three digits = 001-366 (number of the day in the year).

hh can be the two digit hour in a 24 hour clock (00-23) during which the transaction is performed.

nnnnnn can be the systemsTraceAuditNumber or any 6 digit number.

countryCodeTerminal.description:
Conditional.

This field identifies the country where the merchant terminal is located.

Refer to ISO Codes

formFactorIndicator.description:
Conditional.

This tag is fixed length, 4 bytes, and is personalized on the card or device and carries additional information about the contactless device, its security features, and the technology used to acquire the transaction. This tag may be present in contactless transactions and is treated as supplemental data by V.I.P.

unpredictableNumber.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the number used in the generation of the cryptogram for VSDC full transactions and contactless magnetic stripe transactions. It provides variability and uniqueness to the cryptogram.

applicationCryptogram.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the chip application cryptogram (Authorization Request Cryptogram (ARQC), Transaction Certificate (TC), or an Application Authentication Cryptogram (AAC)). Since this data element represents the cryptogram itself, acquirers must provide the cryptogram value generated by the card at the point of service without modification.

customerExclusiveData.description:
Conditional.

This tag is variable length 1 byte binary to 32 bytes hexadecimal with a maximum 33 bytes and can be contained in U.S. contactless transactions and contains issuer proprietary information in TLV format. The tag is personalized on the card or device.

issuerApplicationData.description:
Conditional.

Contains proprietary application data for transmission to the issuer in an online transaction.

derivationKeyIndexVIS.description:
Conditional.

This is a two-hexadecimal digit, subfield. It contains an index into the issuer's list of keys used in the Online Card Authentication Method (Online CAM), Issuer Authentication, and validation of the clearing cryptogram.

cardVerificationResultsVIS.description:
Conditional.

The card records the results of offline and online processing by setting a series of indicators in this field. These indicators are available to clients in the online message and clearing transaction. The length subfield specifies the number of bytes present in this field.

cryptogramVersionNumberVIS.description:
Conditional.

This is a two- hexadecimal digit subfield used to calculate the cryptogram contained in the message. It indicates which version of the cryptogram algorithm was used for ARQC, TC, AAC, or ARPC generation.

dateTerminalTransaction.description:
Conditional.

This field is carried in chip-card transactions and contains the local date at the terminal on which the transaction was authorized. This field is used in the calculation of the cryptogram.
The format is yymmdd, where: yy = 00–99, mm = 01–12, dd = 01–31

chipTransactionIndicator.description:
Conditional.

This 1-digit code is set by full VSDC data acquirers when they receive a message from the terminal that indicates a chip-based transaction.

terminalCapabilityProfile.description:
Conditional.

This field is carried in VSDC transactions and indicates the card data input, the Cardholder Verification Method (CVM), and the security capabilities supported by the terminal.

interfaceDeviceSerialNumber.description:
Conditional.

Unique and permanent serial number assigned to the IFD (Interface Device) by the manufacturer.

terminalVerificationResults.description:
Conditional.

This field is carried in VSDC transactions and contains indicators from a terminal perspective. The terminal records the results of offline and online processing by setting a series of indicators in this field. These indicators are available to clients in the online message and clearing transaction.

amountCryptogramCurrencyCode.description:
Conditional.

Indicates the currency code of the transaction according to ISO 4217.

Refer to ISO Codes

applicationInterchangeProfile.description:
Conditional.

This field contains a series of indicators that reflect the functions supported by the chip card account, for example, whether cardholder verification is supported.

applicationTransactionCounter.description:
Conditional.

This field contains a count of the transactions performed within the card application. The count is incremented by one each time a transaction is initiated. Multiple authorization requests for the same transaction will have the same ATC; for example, when online PIN fails and the next authorization represents a different PIN try for the same transaction, the ATC will be the same. For reversals and advices, the ATC is the value from the original message.

cryptogramTransactionTypeCode.description:
Conditional.

This field in VSDC transactions indicates the type of financial transaction (as in Field 3- processing code) provided by the terminal, to ensure that the issuer and the card are using the same value to compute the cryptogram.

chipAuthenticationReliabilityIndicator.description:
Conditional.

This 1-digit code can be set and sent in by the full VSDC data acquirer or set by VisaNet Integrated Payment (V.I.P.)VisaNet Integrated Payment (V.I.P.) when the acquirer or issuer is inactive for Card Authentication.

integratedCircuitCardData.description: This field contains integrated circuit card (ICC)-related data that is transmitted in contact and contactless VSDC transactions from the ICC to the card issuer.

mvvAcquirerAssigned.description: Visa assists the acquirer in assigning the last four. E.g. 98FC

merchantVerificationValue.description: Merchant Verification Value(MVV) is used to identify merchants that participate in a variety of programs. The MVV is unique to the merchant.

irfType.description:
This field contains one of the following values:
0 - Unknown/default
1 - Fixed
2 - Ad valorem (%)
3 - Composite (fixed amount and ad valorem)

accountType.description:
This field contains one of the following values:
CO - Commercial products
CR - Credit
DB - Debit
PL - Private label
PP - Prepaid

irfCategoryCode.description: This field optionally contains any value from 00 to 99.

merchantFiscalId.description: This field contains RFC for the merchant. This is an alphanumeric field. The RFC format can be AAAANNNNNNAAA, where A is alphanumeric value and N is a numeric value.

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Client-Calculated Interchange Reimbursement Fee in the same currency as the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

reimbursementFeeTax.description: This field contains the VAT calculated for the IRF applicable to the transaction. It must not contain zeros.

mexicoNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Mexico required if transaction indicates Mexico national settlement.

transactionLinkIdentifier.description: Transaction Link Identifier returned from other networks like MasterCard and Pulse

optionalResponseParameters.description:
Originators may choose to specify any or all of the following optional parameters to receive as part of the API response.

E.g. Originators may specify comma-separated, optional parameters such as optionalResponseParameters (motoECIIndicator), if they want to receive motoECIIndicator in the API response.

motoECIIndicator: Identifies the level of security used in an electronic commerce transaction over an open network (for example, the Internet) or the type of mail or telephone order. Acquirers supply indicator values, which V.I.P. forwards in requests and advices to issuers that have successfully tested to receive them. The subfield is dropped if issuers have not successfully completed testing or choose not to receive it.

Refer to Moto ECI Codes

E.g. optionalResponseParameters (motoECIIndicator)

senderPrimaryAccountNumber.description: This is a 16-digit PAN or token of the sender's account.

settlementServiceIndicator.description:
This flag enables the originator to request for a particular settlement service to be used for settling the transaction.

Valid values are:
0 - International Settlement
9 - VIP to decide
8 - National Settlement

Note: The default value is 9. This field is only relevant for specific countries where the acquirer has to select 8 in order to settle in the national net settlement service.

addValueTaxAmount.description: This is the national government tax for added value of good or service.

addValueTaxReturn.description: This is base value of the IVA (Sales tax). Optional.  This field indicates base value of the IVA ( Sales tax which is part of the benefit of the tax legislations for the 2% sale tax return to the cardholder.

taxAmountConsumption.description: This is the national consumption tax amount.

nationalNetMiscAmount.description: This is an amount field that contains an airport charge, cashback or a tip.

emvTransactionIndicator.description:
Contains one of the below valid values:
0 - Does not apply to EMV
1 - EMV transaction
2 - Fallback transaction

costTransactionIndicator.description:
Contains one of the below valid values:
0 - Not a cost inquiry amount
1 - Cost inquiry transaction

nationalChargebackReason.description: Contains a domestic chargeback reason code.

nationalReimbursementFee.description: Numeric entry indicating a fee for a National Settlement transaction. It must be zeros unless the transaction is a National Settlement transaction for a country using this capability. Two decimal positions are implied.

nationalNetMiscAmountType.description:
It identifies the type of the miscellaneous amount â€“ i.e. whether it is one of:
A - Airport charge
C - Cashback
T - Tip

Must be one of the above valid values if nationalNetMiscAmount > 0.

Must be skipped if nationalNetMiscAmount = 0.

countryCodeNationalService.description: The acquirer's country code. Must be 170 for Colombia.

nationalNetReimbursementFeeBaseAmount.description: The client supplied interchange reimbursement amount expressed in the transaction currency. This must be less than the transaction amount.

colombiaNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Colombia required if transaction indicates Colombia national settlement

reimbursementFee.description: This field contains the Argentina member supplied reimbursement fee. This value should be greater than 0 for Argentina Domestic Purchase transactions.
reimbursementFee.x-variant: | Length: totalDigits 10, fractionDigits 2 (minimum value is 0, maximum value is 99999999.99)

reimbursementFeeTax.description:
Conditional.

This field contains the VAT calculated for the IRF applicable to the transaction.
reimbursementFeeTax.x-variant: | Length: totalDigits 10, fractionDigits 2 (minimum value is 0, maximum value is 99999999.99)

argentinaNationalServiceData.description: Settlement Service Data object for Argentina required if transaction indicates Argentina national settlement.

foreignExchangeFeeTransaction.description: When present, this field contains the sender's foreign exchange markup fee (markup above the wholesale or VisaNet exchange rate as assessed by the originator). Values in this field must be in the same currency and format as defined in the amount field.

recipientSubDivisionMinorCode.description:
Optional.

This field contains the ISO subdivision minor code (for e.g. a county within a state) of the recipient address.

Note:
This field is not applicable for domestic Colombia transactions

recipientAccountIdentifierValue.description:
Conditional.
This field contains the account identifier value for recipient account identifier type.

Required for transaction routed over non Visa networks through Push Payment Gateway Service.

Maps to the following ISO 8583 field
- Field 56, DSI01 Tag 83

recipientAccountIdentifierTypeCode.description:
Conditional.
This field will contain the account identifier type.

Refer to Account Identifier Type Codes codes.

Required for transaction routed over non Visa networks through Push Payment Gateway Service.

Maps to the following ISO 8583 field
- Field 56, DSI01 Tag 84

recipientIdentificationNumberBusiness.description:
Conditional.

This is an alphanumeric value that carries the recipient's identification number issued to the recipient by the government or an authorized national entity. This field is to be used if the recipient is a business (e.g. Disbursements)

If recipientIdentificationNumberIndividual is not populated, then this field needs to be populated mandatorily for Brazil domestic trasactions when businessApplicationId has any of the below values:

AA
PP
TU
BI
WT
FT

For Argentina domestic purchase transactions this field contains the merchant’s value-added tax (VAT) registration number or single business reference number (SBRN).

recipientIdentificationNumberIndividual.description:
Conditional.

This is an alphanumeric value that carries the recipient's identification number issued to the recipient by the government or an authorized national entity. This field is to be used if the recipient is an Individual (e.g. P2P payments)

If recipientIdentificationNumberBusiness is not populated, then this field needs to be populated mandatorily for Brazil domestic trasactions when businessApplicationId has any of the below values:

AA
PP
TU
BI
WT
FT

cpsAuthorizationCharacteristicsIndicator.description:
Conditional
Request for CPS authorization. If present, a valid value is required. Spaces or special characters are not allowed. Possible values are : Y (Transaction requests participation)

Note: Supported only in US for CPS (Custom Payment Service).

This field is required for the transaction to qualify for CPS qualified Interchange rates and to avoid the Transaction Integrity Fee.

Please reach out to your Visa representative for details.

encAgentPAN.description: Agent PAN. 16-digit PAN as created from the mVisa agent ID captured by the consumer from agent information display option. The field is sent in encrypted format using the AES GCM (i.e. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM)) algorithm for JSON Web Encryption (JWE) objects with 256-bit key (i.e. the shared secret between Visa and client for encryption and decryption of payload data). The field data type will be string(16-19) after decryption.

originatorBIN.description: This BIN number identifies the originator of Cash-Out payment transaction.

encConsumerPAN.description: Consumer PAN. This is a 16-digit PAN. The field is sent in encrypted format using the AES GCM (i.e. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM)) algorithm for JSON Web Encryption (JWE) objects with 256-bit key (i.e. the shared secret between Visa and client for encryption and decryption of payload data). The field data type will be string(16-19) after decryption.

encConsumerName.description: Consumer name. If consumer name is greater than 30 characters, then only first 30 characters will be expected. The field is sent in encrypted format using the AES GCM (i.e. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM)) algorithm for JSON Web Encryption (JWE) objects with 256-bit key (i.e. the shared secret between Visa and client for encryption and decryption of payload data).

otherPhoneNumber.description: Conditional. When present, this field contains the sender's phone number. This field is applicable only for merchant payment transaction. Originator should populate the consumer mobile number if captured on the mobile app for this transaction. Data should not exceed 16 alphanumeric characters.

otherEmailAddress.description: Conditional. When present, this field contains the sender's email address. This field is applicable only for merchant payment transaction. Originator should populate the consumer email address if captured on the mobile app for this transaction. Data should not exceed 99 alphanumeric characters.

transactionAmount.description: Transaction amount in agent on currency. In case the agent currency is not the same as the consumer currency, then originator will perform currency conversion before submitting the transaction.

visaTransactionId.description: Numeric. It contains a right-justified, VisaNet generated Transaction Identifier (TID) that is unique for each request. The identifier links original messages to subsequent messages, such as those for exception item processing and clearing record.

localTransactionDate.description: It contains the local month and day on which the transaction was originated. The date is in mmdd format.

localTransactionTime.description: The time the transaction takes place, expressed in the local time of the originator. The time is in hhmmss format.

transmissionDateTime.description: The date and time the request was submitted to Visa. Format: MMDDhhmmss.

originatorCountryCode.description:
A 3-digit ISO-4217 code that identifies the country of the originating BIN.
Refer to ISO codes.

systemTraceAuditNumber.description: Numeric. It is a key data element used to match a response to its request or to match a message to others for a given transaction.

velocityLimitIndicator.description:
Conditional. This field contains the velocity limit related information that Acquirer can use in making the authorization decision:
  • 1 = 1-day count or amount exceeded.
  • 2 = 7-day count or amount exceeded.
  • 3 = 30-day count or amount exceeded.
The field is populated with priority of 1, 2 and then 3.
This field is sent if recipient has opted for VisaNet to forward them the OCT when a velocity limit has been exceeded.
This field will be sent as NULL if it is not populated.

transactionCurrencyCode.description: The 3-digit ISO-4217 code in this field reflects the currency associated to the transactionAmount field.

decimalPositionIndicator.description: Indicates the number of decimal positions following the amount field. This field is to be sent as NULL if it is not populated.

enablerVerificationValue.description: This field is to allow the application of the interchange discount at the enabler level.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: Numeric. It is a key data element for matching a message to others within a given transaction set. The same number appears in all related messages: response, advice, reversal, chargeback, chargeback reversal, or representment. The format is recommended to be ydddhhnnnnnn.

GetReportResponse-1.description: Response data when a merchant or agent alias is successfully resolved.

city.description: Consumer’s city belonging to the payment instrument

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by an Issuer to identify the payment instrument belonging to a consumer cardholder.
An Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder's payment instrument in their system to Visa Alias Directory Service as a guid.

One alias can be linked to more than one account. For example, one phone can be linked to three different cards with one of these cards selected as the default card to receive money. It is recommended that the Issuer use systematic naming to generate a guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3

If an issuer creates a new Alias with a guid that is already associated with another Alias, the existing record will be deleted and the new Alias will be created.

This attribute contains the alias data, e.g. phone number, email address, etc.

address2.description: Address line 2 belonging to the payment instrument

“01” – Phone number
“02” – Email address

expiryDate.description: Consumer's card expiration date. Format: YYYY-MM.

issuerName.description: This is the Issuer name of recipient’s card

postalCode.description: Postal code belonging to the payment instrument of the consumer

contactEmail.description: Consumer’s contact email for communications

consentDateTime.description: Date & time when consumer has provided their consent to Issuer about the use of their personal data for the Visa Alias Directory Service. Format: YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.  Local date and time should be converted to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) before submitting this value in API request.

recipientLastName.description: Consumer’s last name. Issuers in Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Moldova, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan must use only the first letter of a customer’s last name followed by a dot symbol to create or modify an alias record. recipientFirstName.description: Consumer’s first name

recipientLastNameLocal.description: Consumer’s last name in local language, Issuers in Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Moldova, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan must use only the first letter of a customer’s last name followed by a dot symbol to create or modify an alias record. For example, the alias record for customer John Smith should be created or modified by the Issuer with first and last name fields as 'John S.'

recipientFirstNameLocal.description: Consumer’s first name in local language

recipientMiddleNameLocal.description: Consumer’s middle name in local language

actionCode.description:
Contains a code that defines the response to a request.
Refer to actionCode

approvalCode.description: Conditional. Contains the authorization code provided by the participant when a transaction is approved.

responseCode.description: It is added by VisaNet and contains the response source/reason code that identifies the source of the field actionCode response decision.

statusIdentifier.description: Required when the API response times out.

originalActionCode.description:
The action code of the original transaction request
Refer to actionCode
Note: This field is only present, when the request is identified as a duplicate.

transmissionDateTime.description: The value in response must match the value in the request.

transactionIdentifier.description: It is added by VisaNet. It contains a right-justified, VisaNet generated Transaction Identifier (TID) that is unique for each request. The identifier links original messages to subsequent messages, such as those for exception item processing and clearing record.

enablerVerificationValue.description: Enabler Verification Value (EVV) is a Visa assigned value that is used to identify enablers that participate in certain programs. The EVV is unique to the enabler.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: Numeric only. Key data element for matching a message to others within a given transaction set. Value will be the same as what has been provided in the request.

city.description: Consumer’s city

guid.description:
This attribute is uniquely used by Issuer to identify their customer (i.e. consumer cardholder).
Issuer may pass their existing unique identifier of a cardholder of their system to VAD as a guid.

For multiple aliases linked to the same PAN, same guid should be used except changing the field alias in the request payload. Below is an example:

guid abcd12345678z01, alias 85288881111.

For selected countries, one alias can be linked to more than one account, e.g. one mobile can be linked to three different cards with a default card to receive money. It is recommended that issuer to use systematic naming to generate guid for easy maintenance. Below is an example of one mobile number linking to three different PANs:
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z01 for PAN1 (default)
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z02 for PAN2
alias 85291112222, guid abcd12345678z03 for PAN3, etc.

This attribute contains the alias data, e.g. phone number, email address, etc.

expiryDate.description:
Conditional. Consumer's card expiration date. Format: YYYY-MM.

This is a consumer email address for communications and matching purposes.
